zh: 扫描到某个数时，假设它是答案里靠右的那一个，那么靠左的那个数必须等于多少？问题于是变成：这个值在前面出现过没有？
用哈希表记录“已经扫过的值及其下标”。目标值减去当前数得到的差如果在表里，答案就找到了。
从左到右遍历：先算出需要的搭档并查表，查到就返回两个下标；查不到再把当前值和它的下标放进表里。先查后存，可以避免同一个元素和自己配对。
en: When you reach a number, suppose it is the right half of the answer. What must the left half equal? The question becomes: has that value appeared earlier?
Use a hash map from already-scanned values to their indices. If target minus the current value is in the map, you're done.

Walk left to right: compute the needed partner and look it up; if found, return both indices; otherwise store the current value with its index. Looking up before inserting stops an element pairing with itself.

zh: 链表是低位在前，这正好和手算竖式加法从个位算起的顺序一致。
每一位的结果只取决于两条链的当前位和上一位的进位；把“某条链已经走完”看作该位是零，一个循环就能统一处理长度不同和最后多出的进位。
建哑节点和尾指针，进位设为零；只要任一链还有节点或进位不为零：取两位（缺的记为零）加上进位，新节点存个位，进位存十位，移动各个指针；返回哑节点的下一个。
en: Digits are stored lowest first, which is exactly the order you add columns by hand, starting from the ones place.
Each output digit depends only on the two current digits plus the incoming carry. Treat a finished list as zeros, and a single loop covers unequal lengths and a leftover carry.

Start with a dummy, a tail and carry 0. While either list has nodes or carry is non-zero, add the digits (missing ones count as 0) and the carry, append the ones digit, keep the tens as carry, advance.

zh: 随着右端点向右推进，以它结尾的最长无重复子串的左端点只会右移，永远不需要往回退。
维护一个字符互不相同的窗口；新字符已经在窗口里时，把左边界直接跳到它上次出现位置的后一位，前提是那个位置在当前左边界的右侧。
记录每个字符最后一次出现的下标；右指针逐个扫描，若该字符上次出现的位置不在左边界之前，就把左边界移到它后一位；更新该字符的位置，并用窗口长度更新答案。
en: As the right end advances, the best left end for substrings ending there only moves right; it never needs to go back.
Keep a window of distinct characters. When the new character is already inside, jump the left edge just past its last occurrence, but only if that lies right of the current left edge.
Store each character's last index. For each right index, if that char's last index is at or after the left edge, move the left edge past it. Update the index and the best length.

zh: 中位数相当于把全部元素分成个数固定的左右两半，并且左半每个数都不大于右半。试着只考虑每个数组分别贡献几个元素给左半。
在一个数组里定下切分位置后，另一个数组的切分位置就被总数唯一确定。是否合法只看两处切口附近的四个值，而且随切分位置单调变化，可以二分。
在较短数组上二分切分点，推出另一个数组的切分点；若某侧左边界大于对侧右边界，就朝相应方向收缩。合法后按总长奇偶从边界值取中位数，越界位置视为正负无穷。
en: The median splits all elements into a left and right half of fixed sizes, with every left value no larger than every right one. Think only about how many elements each array gives to the left half.
Fixing the cut in one array fixes the cut in the other. Validity depends only on the four values around the two cuts, and it changes monotonically with the cut, so binary search applies.

Binary search the cut in the shorter array and derive the other. If a left boundary exceeds the opposite right boundary, move toward it. Once valid, read the median from the boundaries; out-of-range is ±infinity.

zh: 每个回文都关于自己的中心对称。长度为奇数和偶数时，中心分别落在哪里？从中心往两边看，回文在什么时候结束？
用中心扩展：中心共有 n 个落在字符上、n−1 个落在两字符之间，分别对应奇数和偶数长度。从每个中心往外扩，直到两端字符不相等。
枚举所有奇偶中心，向两侧扩展到失配，记下这段回文的起点和长度，比当前最优更长就替换；最后按记录的起点和长度从原串截取返回。
en: Every palindrome is symmetric about its center. Where does the center sit for odd and even lengths? Looking outward from the center, when does the palindrome end?
Use center expansion: n centers on characters and n−1 between them cover odd and even lengths. Expand each center until the two ends differ.
For every odd and even center, expand to the first mismatch and record the start and length. Keep the longest seen. Slice that range from the original string and return it.

zh: 题目描述的其实是一个按顺序执行的解析过程。把输入可能出现的情况按先后分成几个阶段，逐段处理。
依次处理：跳过前导空格、读取至多一个正负号、连续读取数字直到遇到非数字。关键是在追加每一位数字之前就判断会不会越界，越界就立刻截断到边界值。
用下标逐字符前进：先跳过空格；再看有没有符号并记下来；然后循环读数字，追加前检查当前值是否已超过“最大值除以 10”，或恰好相等但新数字太大，满足就按符号返回边界值；最后乘上符号返回。
en: The statement really describes a sequential parsing process. Split the possible inputs into stages and handle them one after another.
In order: skip leading spaces, read at most one sign, then read digits until a non-digit. The key is checking for overflow before appending each digit and clamping right away.

Advance an index: skip spaces, record an optional sign, then loop over digits. Before appending, check whether the value exceeds max/10, or equals it with too large a digit; if so, return the clamped bound.

zh: 负数一定不是回文；末尾是 0 的正数也不可能是回文，因为它的首位不会是 0。
不必反转整个数字，只反转后一半：不断从原数末尾取一位接到反转数后面，当反转数不小于剩下的原数时，正好处理了一半，也不会溢出。
先排除负数和末尾为 0 的非零数。循环把原数最后一位移到反转数上，直到反转数大于等于剩余原数。若两者相等（偶数位），或剩余原数等于反转数去掉最后一位（奇数位），就是回文。
en: Negative numbers are never palindromes, and neither is a positive number ending in 0, since it can't start with 0.
Don't reverse the whole number, only the back half: move digits from the end onto a reversed number until it is no smaller than what remains. That's exactly halfway and avoids overflow.

Reject negatives and nonzero numbers ending in 0. Move last digits onto a reversed number until it reaches the remainder. Palindrome if they match, or if the remainder equals the reversed number without its last digit.

zh: 面积由两条线中较短的那条和它们之间的距离共同决定。从最宽的一对开始往里收，宽度只会变小。
如果移动较高的那条线，新面积的高度仍被原来的短边卡住，宽度却变小了，面积不可能更大。所以短边在当前位置已经用尽，可以直接淘汰。
双指针从两端出发，算出当前面积并更新最大值；每次把较短的一侧向内移动一步，直到两指针相遇。
en: Area depends on the shorter of the two lines and the distance between them. Start from the widest pair; moving inward always shrinks the width.
Moving the taller line can't help: height stays capped by the shorter line while width drops. So the shorter line has already given its best area and can be discarded.
Start pointers at both ends, compute the area and update the maximum, then move the pointer at the shorter line inward. Stop when the pointers meet.

zh: 答案里的三元组不能重复。如果规定每组三个数都按从小到大的顺序选出，同一组合就只会出现一次。怎样让这个顺序容易维持？
排序后枚举最小的那个数，另外两个在它右侧的有序区间里找。区间两端之和偏小，只能增大左端；偏大，只能减小右端。这就是相向双指针。
排序；从左到右枚举第一个数（与前一个相同则跳过，已大于 0 就可结束）；在它右侧放左右指针，和小于 0 左指针右移，大于 0 右指针左移，等于 0 时记录并跳过重复值。
en: Triplets must not repeat. If every triple is picked in ascending order, each combination shows up only once. How can you make that order easy to keep?

After sorting, enumerate the smallest number and search its right side for the other two. If the two ends sum too small, only raising the left helps; too large, only lowering the right. That's two pointers.
Sort. For each first number (skip repeats; stop once it exceeds 0), move two pointers on its right: below 0 move left up, above 0 move right down, at 0 record and skip duplicates.

zh: 要的不是恰好等于目标，而是离目标最近。假如数组已经有序，固定其中一个数后，另外两个数的和会随着选择怎样变化？
排序后固定第一个数，在它右侧用相向双指针。每算出一个三数之和都先和当前最优比较；指针怎么移只看和比目标大还是小，这两件事分开处理。
排序；枚举第一个数，在其右侧放左右指针；每次算和，与目标的距离更小就更新答案；和小于目标左指针右移，大于目标右指针左移，相等直接返回。
en: You want the sum nearest the target, not an exact hit. If the array were sorted and one number fixed, how would the sum of the other two change with your choices?
Sort, fix the first number, and run inward pointers to its right. Compare every triple sum with the best so far; pointer moves depend only on whether the sum is above or below the target.
Sort. For each first number, put pointers on its right. Compute the sum and update the best if it is closer; if below the target move left up, if above move right down, if equal return it.

zh: 每个数字对应 3 到 4 个字母，答案就是各位候选字母的笛卡尔积：先为第一位选一个字母，再为第二位选一个，一直选到最后一位。
用回溯，状态是“处理到第几位数字”加上已拼好的前缀；每层只从这一位数字对应的字母里选，不需要任何去重。
先建好数字到字母的映射，空输入直接返回空列表；从第 0 位开始，把该位的每个字母依次拼到前缀后递归下一位，前缀长度等于输入长度时收集结果。
en: Each digit maps to 3-4 letters, so the answer is the Cartesian product of those sets: pick a letter for the first digit, then one for the second, and so on to the last.
Backtrack with state: the index of the current digit and the prefix built so far. Each level chooses only among that digit's letters, so no dedup is needed.
Build the digit-to-letters map; empty input returns empty. From index 0, append each letter of the current digit and recurse; collect when the prefix is full length.

zh: 四重循环太慢。如果数组已经有序，先定下最小的两个数，剩下的两个数需要满足什么条件、该到哪一段里去找？
最后两个数在剩余区间里用相向双指针找。两层枚举都要跳过重复值；剪枝看当前能取到的最小和是否已超过目标、最大和是否仍不够。四个数相加可能超出 32 位整数范围。
排序；外层枚举第一个数、内层枚举第二个数，各自跳过重复并剪枝；剩余区间用相向双指针找和为“目标减去前两数”的组合，命中后跳过重复值；求和用 64 位整数。
en: Four nested loops are too slow. If the array were sorted and the two smallest numbers fixed, what must the remaining two satisfy, and where would you look for them?

Find the last two with inward pointers on the remaining range. Skip duplicates at both enumeration levels; prune when the smallest possible sum exceeds the target or the largest falls short. Mind 32-bit overflow.
Sort. Enumerate the first and second numbers, skipping repeats and pruning. On the rest, run inward pointers for the remaining target, skip duplicates after a hit, and sum in 64-bit.

zh: 倒数第 n 个节点，就是离链表末尾恰好 n 步的那个。只扫一遍、不预先数长度，怎么知道某个节点离末尾还有几步？
用快慢双指针：先让前指针领先 n 步，再两个一起走；前指针走到最后一个节点时，后指针正好停在要删节点的前一个。从哑节点出发能把删除头节点的情况统一进来。
建哑节点指向头，两个指针都从哑节点出发；前指针先走 n 步；然后两者同步前进，直到前指针的下一个为空；让后指针跳过它的下一个节点；返回哑节点的下一个。
en: The nth node from the end is exactly n steps from the tail. In one pass, without counting the length first, how can you tell how far a node is from the end?

Use two pointers: give the lead an n-step head start, then move both together; when the lead reaches the last node, the trailing one sits just before the target. Starting at a dummy covers deleting the head.

Put a dummy before head and start both pointers there. Move the lead n steps. Then move both until the lead's next is null. Make the trailing pointer skip its next node. Return the node after the dummy.

zh: 最后打开的括号必须最先被关闭。这种后进先出的匹配顺序，提示你该用哪种数据结构？
遇到右括号时，它只能和最近一个还没配对的左括号配对，而且类型必须一致。
从左到右扫描：左括号放入容器；遇到右括号时，若容器为空或顶部类型不符就判无效，否则取出顶部。扫描结束后容器必须为空才合法。
en: The bracket opened last must be closed first. Which data structure naturally follows this last-in, first-out order?
A closing bracket can only pair with the most recent still-unmatched opening bracket, and their types must agree.
Scan left to right: push openers; on a closer, fail if nothing is pending or the top has another type, otherwise pop. At the end the string is valid only if nothing remains.

zh: 两条链都已有序，所以结果里的下一个节点，一定是两条链当前头部中较小的那个。
用哑节点作为结果链的起点，再维护一个尾指针；每次把较小的头接到尾后面，只让被选中的那条链前进一步，另一条不动。
建哑节点和尾指针；两链都非空时比较头部，把较小者接到尾后，并移动该链和尾指针；循环结束后，把还剩下的那条整段接到尾后；返回哑节点的下一个。
en: Both lists are sorted, so the next node of the result is always the smaller of the two current heads.
Use a dummy node as the result's start and keep a tail pointer. Each step attaches the smaller head to the tail and advances only the list it came from.
Create a dummy and a tail. While both lists are non-empty, attach the smaller head and advance that list and the tail. Then attach the leftover list in one go. Return the node after the dummy.

zh: 不需要先生成所有长度为 2n 的串再检查，只要在逐个放字符时保证前缀始终“还可能合法”就行。
用已放的左括号数和右括号数做状态：左括号少于 n 时可以放；右括号只有在比左括号少时才能放。这两条规则保证每个前缀都合法。
从空串开始递归：长度到 2n 就记录；左括号数小于 n 时加一个左括号递归；右括号数小于左括号数时加一个右括号递归；每次返回后撤销。
en: Don't generate every length-2n string and filter. Build character by character and keep every prefix potentially valid.
Track how many opens and closes are placed. An open is allowed while opens < n; a close only while closes < opens. These two rules keep every prefix valid.
Recurse from an empty string: at length 2n, record. If opens < n, add an open and recurse; if closes < opens, add a close and recurse; undo after each.

zh: 结果的下一个节点，一定是 k 条链当前头节点中最小的那个。每取走一个，候选里只换掉一个。怎样反复取最小值，才不必每次都比较 k 次？
用最小堆保存每条链当前的头，每次弹出最小的接到结果后面，再把它的后继放回堆；或者两两分治合并，每个节点只参与大约 log k 次合并。
把所有非空链表的头放进最小堆（按值比较，值相同时用编号区分）；建哑节点和尾；堆不空时弹出最小节点接到尾后，若它有后继就入堆；返回哑节点的下一个。
en: The next result node is always the smallest of the k current heads. Each pick replaces just one candidate. How can you take the minimum repeatedly without k comparisons each time?
Keep each list's current head in a min-heap: pop the smallest, append it, push its successor. Or merge pairwise with divide and conquer so each node takes part in about log k merges.
Push every non-empty head into a min-heap keyed by value (break ties by index). With a dummy and a tail, repeatedly pop the min, append it, and push its next if any. Return the node after the dummy.

zh: 每次交换都牵涉三处连接：前面的节点、这一对节点、以及后面剩下的部分。先想清楚交换前后它们分别指向谁。
让一个指针停在“当前这一对的前驱”上；交换之后，原来的第一个节点变成这一对的第二个，它恰好就是下一对的前驱。
建哑节点，前驱指针指向它；后面还有两个节点时：记为第一和第二，前驱指向第二，第一指向第二原来的后继，第二指向第一；前驱移到第一；返回哑节点的下一个。
en: Each swap touches three links: the node before, the pair itself, and the rest of the list. Work out who points to whom before and after the swap.
Keep a pointer on the node just before the current pair. After swapping, the pair's original first node becomes the second, and it is exactly the predecessor of the next pair.

Create a dummy and set prev to it. While two nodes follow, call them first and second; point prev to second, first to second's old next, and second to first. Move prev to first. Return the node after the dummy.

zh: 这题就是“反转一段链表”重复做很多次。在动手反转一组之前，先要确认什么？
每组开始前先往后数 k 个，不够就保持原样直接结束；够的话反转这一组，并记住组前驱和这组原来的第一个节点，后者反转后会成为下一组的前驱。
建哑节点作为组前驱；循环：从组前驱往后找第 k 个节点，找不到就结束；记下它后面的节点；反转这 k 个节点，把组前驱接到新的组头，把原组头接到刚记下的节点；组前驱移到原组头。
en: This is "reverse a segment" repeated many times. Before reversing a group, what must you check first?

Before each group, count k nodes ahead; if there aren't enough, leave them and stop. Otherwise reverse the group, tracking the node before it and the group's original first node, the next predecessor.

Use a dummy as the predecessor. Loop: find the kth node after it, else stop; note the node after it; reverse the k nodes; link the predecessor to the new head and the old head to the noted node; move to the old head.

zh: 题目只要求前 k 个位置是正确的去重结果。想象在原数组上从头“重写”一遍：每读到一个元素，它该被写下还是扔掉？
因为数组有序，一个元素该保留，当且仅当它和最后写下的值不同，不必回头查更早的元素。写的位置永远不会超过读的位置。
慢指针指向下一个写入位置，快指针从左到右扫描；遇到与已保留末尾不同的值，就写到慢指针处并让慢指针前进。扫描结束时慢指针的值就是新长度。
en: Only the first k slots must hold the deduplicated result. Imagine rewriting the array from the front: for each element you read, should it be written down or dropped?
Since the array is sorted, keep an element exactly when it differs from the last value written; nothing earlier matters. The write position never overtakes the read position.
Use a write index and a read index. Scan with the read index; when the value differs from the last kept one, copy it to the write index and advance. Return the write index.

zh: 最终长度就是不等于 val 的元素个数。能不能不开新数组，把这些元素直接挪进数组开头的那几个位置？
读写分离：读指针扫过所有元素，写指针只在遇到要保留的值时前进；写永远不超过读，不会覆盖还没读的内容。val 很少时，也可以拿末尾元素填空位，减少写入。
做法一：扫描时把不等于 val 的元素依次写到前面。做法二：左指针遇到 val 就用末尾元素覆盖并收缩右端，此时左指针先别前进，因为换来的元素还没检查。
en: The final length is just the count of elements not equal to val. Can you move those elements into the first slots directly, without a new array?
Separate reading from writing: the reader visits everything, the writer advances only on kept values and never passes the reader. When val is rare, filling holes with the last element saves writes.

Option A: copy every non-val element forward to a write index. Option B: when the left pointer sees val, overwrite it with the last element and shrink the end; don't advance, since the new value is unchecked.

zh: 朴素匹配一失配就把模式串退回开头重来。可已经匹配过的那段文本你其实是知道的，能不能利用它少退一点？
对模式串的每个前缀，预先算出“既是前缀又是后缀”的最长真子串长度。失配时模式指针直接跳到这个长度处继续比较，文本指针始终不回退。
先让模式串和自己匹配来构建前缀表：失配就沿着表往回跳，匹配就加一。再用同样的方式扫描文本，模式指针走到末尾时说明找到了，返回这次匹配的起始下标；扫完都没找到返回 -1。
en: Naive matching restarts the pattern after a mismatch. But you already know the text you just matched. Can you use that to back up less?
For each pattern prefix, precompute the length of its longest proper prefix that is also a suffix. On a mismatch, jump the pattern pointer to that length; the text pointer never moves back.

Build the prefix table by matching the pattern against itself: on mismatch, fall back through the table; on match, extend. Scan the text the same way; when the pattern pointer reaches the end, return that match's start.

zh: 所有单词等长，合法子串可以切成若干等长的块。把每个块当成一个整体的“字母”，问题就变成：找一段连续的块，恰好是给定单词的某种排列。
起点的偏移只有单词长度那么多种。对每种偏移，按单词长度一步步滑动，窗口里维护单词计数；某个词超出需求时，从左边按整词收缩。
统计 words 的词频；对每个起始偏移，左右指针都按单词长度移动；读到不在表里的词就清空窗口跳过它；某词超量时从左边移出词直到不超；窗口词数等于总词数时记录左端点。
en: All words share one length, so a valid substring splits into equal chunks. Treat each chunk as one letter: you need a run of chunks that is exactly some arrangement of the given words.
There are only word-length many start offsets. For each, slide one word at a time, keeping word counts in the window; when a word exceeds its quota, shrink from the left a whole word at a time.
Count words. For each offset, step pointers by word length. Unknown word: reset the window past it. Over quota: drop words from the left. Window holds every word: record its left end.

zh: 旋转有序数组无论从哪里切成两半，至少有一半是完全有序的。
比较中点和左端点就能知道哪一半有序。在有序的那一半里，看两个端点就能判断 target 在不在其中：在就进去，不在就去另一半。
用左右边界二分，命中直接返回。左半有序且 target 落在左端到中点之间就收右边界，否则移左边界；右半有序时对称处理。搜完返回 -1。
en: However you split a rotated sorted array into two halves, at least one half is fully sorted.
Comparing the middle with the left end tells you which half is sorted. In that half, its two endpoints tell you whether the target lies inside; if so go there, otherwise go to the other half.
Binary-search with lo and hi, returning on a hit. If the left half is sorted and holds target's range, shrink hi, else move lo. Mirror this when the right half is sorted. Return -1 if not found.

zh: 随便找到一个 target 再向两边扩，遇到大量重复值时会退化成线性。
把问题拆成两次边界查找：第一个不小于 target 的位置，和第一个大于 target 的位置；后者往前一位就是最后一次出现。
写一个“找第一个满足条件的下标”的二分。先用它找左边界，确认该位置确实是 target，否则返回两个 -1；再找第一个大于 target 的位置，减一得到右边界。
en: Finding any match and expanding outward degrades to linear time when there are many duplicates.
Split it into two boundary searches: the first index not less than target, and the first index greater than target. The slot before the latter is the last occurrence.
Write one binary search for the first index meeting a condition. Use it for the left boundary and confirm it holds target, else return -1s. Use it again for the first greater index and subtract one.

zh: 目标存在时返回它的下标，不存在时返回插入位置，这两者其实是同一个位置。
要找的就是第一个不小于 target 的下标。维持不变量：左边界左侧都小于 target，右边界及其右侧都不小于 target。
搜索范围取整个数组再加末尾一个位置；中点值小于 target 就把左边界移到中点右边，否则把右边界收到中点；两者相遇处即答案。
en: If the target exists, return its index; if not, return where it would go. These are actually the same position.
You want the first index whose value is not less than the target. Maintain: everything left of lo is smaller than target, and everything from hi onward is not.
Let the range cover the whole array plus one slot past the end. If the middle value is smaller than target, move lo past it; otherwise move hi to it. Where they meet is the answer.

zh: 每个空格的可选数字由它所在的行、列和宫共同限制。如果某个空格只剩一个候选，或者一个候选都没有，分别说明什么？
用回溯：三组布尔表或位掩码记录每行、每列、每宫已用的数字，候选判断就是 O(1)。每次优先填候选最少的空格，错误分支会更早暴露，搜索量大幅下降。
根据已有数字初始化三组记录并收集空格；递归：没有空格就成功；否则选候选最少的空格，依次尝试每个候选，更新记录后递归，成功就返回，失败则撤销；全部失败就返回失败。
en: Each blank's options are limited by its row, column and box. What does it tell you when a blank has exactly one candidate left, or none at all?
Backtrack. Track used digits per row, column and box with boolean tables or bitmasks for O(1) checks. Always fill the blank with the fewest candidates next, so dead ends surface early.
Initialize the trackers and list the blanks. Recurse: no blanks means solved. Else pick the blank with fewest options, try each, update trackers, recurse, return on success, undo otherwise.

zh: 同一个数可以选无限次，但 [2,3] 和 [3,2] 算同一个组合，所以要让组合只按某个固定顺序被生成。
递归时带一个起始下标：下一个数只能从当前下标或之后选。允许停在当前下标就是“可重复选”，从不往回看就杜绝了不同顺序。
可以先排序；带着起始下标和剩余目标递归：剩余为 0 就记录；从起点往后遍历，候选超过剩余值就停止，否则加入路径、从同一下标递归、回来撤销。
en: Each number can be reused without limit, yet [2,3] and [3,2] are the same combination, so generate combinations in one fixed order only.
Pass a start index: the next pick comes from this index or later. Staying on the same index allows reuse; never looking back prevents reordered duplicates.
Optionally sort. Recurse with a start index and remaining target: at 0, record. Loop from start, stop once a candidate exceeds the remainder, else append, recurse from the same index, pop.

zh: 每个位置最多用一次，但候选里有相等的值：两个不同的 1 各自和 7 组成 8，算同一个组合。这种重复是在搜索的哪一步产生的？
下一层从下一个下标开始，保证每个位置只用一次；同一层里相等的值只取第一个，避免重复组合。排序后还能在候选超过剩余目标时直接截断循环。
先排序；带起点和剩余目标递归：剩余为 0 时记录；从起点往后遍历，跳过本层与前一个相等的值，候选超过剩余就跳出，否则加入、从下一个下标递归、撤销。
en: Each position is used at most once, but values repeat: two different 1s each paired with 7 make the same combination. At which step of the search do such duplicates arise?
The next level starts at the following index, so each position is used once; within a level only the first of equal values branches. Sorting lets you stop once a value exceeds the remaining target.

Sort. Recurse with start and remainder: record at 0. Loop from start, skip a value equal to the previous one in this loop, break when it exceeds the remainder, else append, recurse from the next index, pop.

zh: 长度为 n 的数组，答案一定落在 1 到 n+1 之间。超出这个范围的数会影响答案吗？
理想状态下，值 v 应该放在下标 v-1 处。把每个范围内的数都换到它“该在”的位置，第一个放错的位置就暴露了答案。
依次处理每个位置：只要当前值在 1 到 n 之间，且它的目标位置上还不是它，就交换过去，并继续处理换回来的值。最后从左找第一个“下标 i 处不是 i+1”的位置返回 i+1，全部正确则返回 n+1。
en: For an array of length n, the answer must lie between 1 and n+1. Do values outside that range matter at all?
Ideally value v sits at index v-1. Swap each in-range value into its home slot; the first slot holding the wrong value reveals the answer.
At each index, while the value is in 1..n and its home slot doesn't already hold it, swap it there and recheck what came back. Then return i+1 for the first slot i not holding i+1, or n+1 if none.

zh: 单独看某一根柱子上方能存多少水：它取决于它左边最高的柱子和右边最高的柱子。
某位置的水位由左右两侧最高柱中较矮的那个决定。用双指针时，如果左侧最高值小于右侧最高值，左边当前位置的水量就已经确定，不需要知道右侧的确切最大值。
左右指针从两端出发，分别记录两侧见过的最高值；每次处理最高值较小的那一侧，用该侧最高值减去当前高度累加水量，再向内移动。也可以先预处理前后缀最大值逐位计算。
en: Look at one bar at a time: how much water sits above it depends on the tallest bar to its left and the tallest bar to its right.
A cell's water level is set by the lower of those two maxima. With two pointers, if the left max is below the right max, the left cell's water is known without the exact right max.

Move pointers inward from both ends, tracking the max seen on each side. Process the side with the smaller max: add that max minus the current height, then step inward. Prefix and suffix max arrays also work.

zh: 跳 1 次能到达的位置是从起点开始的一段连续区间，跳 2 次能到达的也是。相邻两段之间是什么关系？
这相当于按层做广度优先搜索，每层是一段区间：当前层所有位置能跳到的最远处，就是下一层的右边界。不必决定具体从哪格起跳，只在走完当前层时记一次跳跃。
维护当前层的右边界和下一层的最远可达位置；从左往右遍历到倒数第二格，不断更新最远可达位置；下标走到当前层边界时，跳跃次数加一，边界换成最远可达位置。
en: Positions reachable in one jump form a contiguous stretch from the start; so do those reachable in two. How does each stretch relate to the one before it?
This is a layer-by-layer BFS where each layer is an interval: the furthest reach from the current layer is the next layer's right edge. Don't pick launch cells; count a jump when a layer ends.
Track the current layer's end and the furthest reach. Scan up to the second-to-last index, updating the reach; when the index hits the layer's end, add a jump and move the end to the reach.

zh: 排列讲究顺序：第一个位置可以放任何元素，第二个位置可以放除它以外的任何元素，依此类推。怎样知道当前还剩哪些元素可选？
需要一个“已使用”标记（布尔数组或原地交换）来记录哪些元素已在路径中；路径长度达到 n 就是一个完整排列。
每层递归负责填一个位置：遍历所有元素，跳过已用的；选中后标记并加入路径，递归下一层，回来后取消标记并弹出。
en: Order matters: the first slot can take any element, the second any element except that one, and so on. How do you know which elements are still available?
Keep a used marker (boolean array, or in-place swaps) to know which elements are already on the path. A path of length n is a full permutation.
Each level fills one position: loop over all elements, skip used ones, mark and append the choice, recurse, then unmark and pop.

zh: 相等的数互换位置，得到的是同一个排列。重复究竟出在哪：是同一个位置先后试了相等的值，还是不同位置用了相等的值？
先排序让相等的值相邻。同一层里相等的值只让第一个展开；不同位置用相等的值完全合法。判断方法：前一个相等的值当前“未被使用”，说明它是同层兄弟，当前值应跳过。
排序并准备使用标记；每层遍历所有下标：已用的跳过；值与前一个相同且前一个未被使用时也跳过；否则标记、加入、递归、撤销。路径满 n 个时记录。
en: Swapping two equal values yields the same permutation. Where do duplicates really come from: trying equal values for the same slot, or using equal values in different slots?
Sort so equal values sit together. At one level only the first of equal values may branch; equal values in different slots are fine. If the previous equal value is unused, it's a sibling here: skip.
Sort and keep a used array. At each level loop over indices: skip used ones; skip if equal to the previous value while that one is unused; else mark, append, recurse, undo. Record at length n.

zh: 先在纸上画一画：顺时针转 90 度后，原来第 i 行第 j 列的元素跑到了哪里？能否拆成几个更简单的对称变换？
顺时针旋转等价于先沿主对角线转置，再把每一行左右翻转。这两步都只需要原地交换。
第一步，把主对角线一侧的每个元素与它的对称位置交换，完成转置。第二步，每一行用左右双指针向中间交换。转置时只能遍历一半，否则会把换过去的元素又换回来。
en: Sketch where the element at row i, column j lands after a 90-degree clockwise turn. Can that move be broken into simpler symmetric operations?
A clockwise rotation equals a transpose across the main diagonal followed by reversing each row. Both steps are in-place swaps.
First swap each cell on one side of the diagonal with its mirror to transpose. Then reverse every row with two pointers. Only loop over half the matrix when transposing, or you'll undo your swaps.

zh: 互为异位词的字符串，字母完全相同，只是顺序不同。能不能给每个字符串算一个“与顺序无关”的标识？
同组字符串的标识必须相同，不同组的必须不同。把字母排序后的字符串，或者 26 个字母各自的出现次数，都可以当这个标识。
建一个哈希表，键是标识，值是字符串列表。遍历每个字符串，算出标识后放进对应列表，最后输出所有列表。用次数做键时，要用分隔符把次数拼起来，避免不同组合拼出同一个键。
en: Anagrams contain exactly the same letters in different orders. Can you compute an identifier for each string that ignores order?
Strings in a group must share the key, and different groups must not. The sorted string, or the counts of all 26 letters, both work as keys.

Make a hash map from key to a list of strings. For each string, compute its key and append it to that list; return all lists. With count keys, join the counts with a separator so they stay unambiguous.

zh: 每行恰好放一个皇后，所以可以一行一行地放，每一步只需决定这一行的皇后放在哪一列。
判断冲突不必扫描棋盘：同一条主对角线上“行减列”相同，同一条副对角线上“行加列”相同。用三个集合或布尔数组分别记录被占用的列和两类对角线，就能 O(1) 判断。
从第 0 行递归：行号等于 n 时把每行的列号转成字符串棋盘记录；否则遍历每一列，列和两条对角线都空闲时就占用它们、记下列号、递归下一行，回来后释放。
en: Each row holds exactly one queen, so place them row by row; each step only chooses a column for the current row.
No board scan needed: one diagonal family shares row − col, the other shares row + col. Track used columns and both diagonal families in sets or boolean arrays for O(1) checks.
Recurse from row 0: at row n, turn the column choices into board strings and record. Else for each column free in all three trackers, mark them, store the column, recurse, unmark.

zh: 只问有多少种摆法，不用输出棋盘。每行恰好放一个皇后，所以可以一行一行决定列号，每一步要知道哪些列和斜线已被占用。
状态是当前行加上被占用的列和两类对角线（同一条对角线上行减列或行加列相同）。把这三类占用压成三个整数位掩码，进入下一行时两个对角线掩码各移一位。
从第 0 行递归，返回从这一行开始能完成的方案数：到第 n 行返回 1；否则对每个可用列，占用后递归并累加返回值，再释放占用，最后返回累加结果。
en: Only the count is asked, not the boards. Each row holds exactly one queen, so choose columns row by row; at each step you need to know which columns and diagonals are taken.
State: the current row plus taken columns and both diagonal families (row − col or row + col is constant on one). Pack them into three bitmasks; on the next row, shift each diagonal mask by one bit.
Recurse from row 0 and return how many completions exist: at row n return 1; else for each free column, occupy, add the recursive result, release, and return the sum.

zh: 任何子数组的和都等于两个前缀和之差。固定右端点时，想让差最大，左边应该选哪个前缀？
对每个右端点，最优的左侧就是它之前出现过的最小前缀和。换个角度也可以：维护“以当前位置结尾的最大和”，前面的累计和一旦为负就丢掉。
扫描时维护当前前缀和以及之前出现过的最小前缀和，先用两者之差更新答案，再更新最小值。答案的初始值要取第一个元素或负无穷，这样全是负数时也能得到正确结果。
en: Any subarray sum is the difference of two prefix sums. For a fixed right end, which earlier prefix should you subtract to maximize it?
For each right end, the best left side is the smallest earlier prefix sum. Equivalently, track the best sum ending here and drop the running total once it turns negative.
Keep the running prefix sum and the minimum earlier prefix. Update the answer with their difference first, then the minimum. Start the answer at the first element (or −∞) so all-negative input works.

zh: 不需要关心具体怎么跳，只要知道哪些位置能到。注意能到达的位置一定是从起点开始连续的一段。
维护到目前为止能到达的最远下标。只要当前下标没超过它，当前位置就可达，并且可以用它把这个最远值继续往后推。
从左到右遍历：当前下标已经超过最远可达位置就返回不能；否则用当前下标加上它的跳跃长度更新最远值；一旦最远值覆盖最后一个下标，就可以提前返回能。
en: You don't need the exact jumps, only which positions are reachable. Note that reachable positions always form a contiguous stretch from the start.
Track the furthest index reachable so far. As long as the current index does not exceed it, the current position is reachable and can push that frontier further.
Scan left to right: if the index passes the frontier, return false; otherwise extend the frontier with the index plus its jump length. Return true as soon as the frontier covers the last index.

zh: 区间是乱序给的，先想办法让可能重叠的区间挨在一起。
按起点排序后，下一个区间的起点不超过当前合并块的终点就能并入；并入时终点取两者较大值，因为后来的区间可能被完全包含。
排序后先放入第一个区间；依次看后面的区间，与结果末尾重叠就延长末尾的终点，否则作为新区间追加。
en: The intervals arrive unordered; first arrange them so any intervals that could overlap end up next to each other.
After sorting by start, an interval joins the current block iff its start is no greater than the block's end. Keep the larger end when merging, since a later interval may be fully contained.
Sort by start and push the first interval. For each next one, if it overlaps the last result interval, extend that end; otherwise append it as a new block.

zh: 原有区间已经有序且互不重叠，新区间只会影响其中连续的一小段。
所有区间可以分成三类：完全在新区间左边、与它相交、完全在右边。相交的那批可以全部吸收进新区间，不断扩大它的左右端点。
先原样放入终点小于新区间起点的区间；再把起点不超过新区间终点的逐个合并进去；放入合并后的新区间；最后追加剩下的。
en: The existing intervals are already sorted and disjoint, so the new interval can only affect one contiguous run of them.
Every interval is entirely left of the new one, overlapping it, or entirely right. All overlapping ones can be absorbed by stretching the new interval's start and end.
Copy intervals ending before the new start. Merge every interval whose start is no greater than the new end into it. Add the merged interval, then copy the rest.

zh: 向右旋转 k 次，其实就是把末尾若干个节点整体搬到前面。k 特别大的时候，转多少次会回到原样？
先求出链长 n，实际只需要转 k 除以 n 的余数次；把尾巴接回头形成一个环，再在合适的位置断开，断点之后的节点就是新头。
空链直接返回；遍历得到长度和尾节点；k 对长度取余，为零就直接返回；把尾接到头成环；从头走 n-k-1 步到达新尾，记它的下一个为新头，再把新尾断开；返回新头。
en: Rotating right by k just moves the last few nodes to the front. If k is huge, after how many rotations is the list back where it started?
Find the length n; only k mod n rotations matter. Link the tail back to the head to form a ring, then cut it at the right spot; the node after the cut is the new head.
Return early for an empty list. Walk to get the length and tail. Reduce k mod n; if it's zero, return. Close the ring. Step n-k-1 times from head to the new tail; its next is the new head; cut there.

zh: 机器人只能向右或向下，所以进入任何一个格子的最后一步，只能来自它的上方或左方。
定义“到达 (i, j) 的路径数”，它是上方格子和左方格子的路径数之和；第一行和第一列的每个格子都只有一条路。
用一行数组，初始全为 1 表示第一行；从第二行开始，每个格子用自己的旧值（代表上方）加上左边刚更新的新值；最后返回末尾元素。也可以直接用组合数计算。
en: The robot only moves right or down, so the last move into any cell comes from above or from the left.
Let the state be the number of paths to cell (i, j): the sum of the counts above and to the left. Every cell in the first row and first column has exactly one path.

Use one row array of 1s for the first row. For each later row, set each cell to its old value (from above) plus the freshly updated left neighbor. Return the last entry. A binomial coefficient also works.

zh: 障碍格谁也进不去，相当于把所有经过它的路线切断。如果障碍出现在第一行，它右边的格子还有路可走吗？
以“到达每个格子的路径数”为状态：进入一个格子只能来自上方或左方，所以它等于两者之和；障碍格强制为 0，起点是障碍时答案直接为 0。
用一维数组，起点非障碍记 1，否则记 0；逐行逐列扫描：障碍格设为 0；否则若左边有格子，就把左边的值加到当前值上（当前旧值代表上方）；最后返回末尾元素。
en: No path can enter an obstacle, so it cuts every route through it. If an obstacle sits in the first row, can any cell to its right still be reached?
Let the state be the number of paths into each cell. You enter only from above or the left, so it's their sum; obstacles are forced to 0, and a blocked start means the answer is 0.

Use a 1D array with the start set to 1 unless blocked. Sweep the grid: obstacles become 0; otherwise add the left neighbor's value to the current entry, which holds the value from above. Return the last entry.

zh: 只能向右或向下走，到达一个格子的最优路径，一定是从它上方或左方的最优路径延伸过来的。
定义“到达 (i, j) 的最小路径和”：等于当前格的值加上上方和左方两者中较小的那个；越界方向视为无穷大，不参与比较。
第一行只能从左边来，依次累加；第一列只能从上面来，依次累加；其余格子按“当前值加上、左中较小者”填写，可以在原网格或一维数组上完成；返回右下角的值。
en: Moving only right or down, the best path into a cell must extend the best path into its upper or left neighbor.
Let the state be the minimum sum to reach (i, j): the cell's value plus the smaller of the states above and to the left. Treat out-of-bounds neighbors as infinity.
The first row accumulates from the left and the first column from above. Fill the rest with the cell value plus the smaller of up and left, in place or with one row. Return the bottom-right value.

zh: 合法数字的结构很清楚：可选符号、整数或小数部分、可选的指数部分。试着把这些规则拆开，逐条检查。
扫描时记录几个标志：是否见过数字、小数点、指数符号。小数点只能出现一次且必须在指数之前；指数前后都必须有数字；正负号只能出现在开头或紧跟在 e 之后。
逐字符处理：数字则标记见过数字；符号要求在开头或紧跟 e；小数点要求之前没有点也没有 e；遇到 e 要求之前有数字且没有 e，并重置“见过数字”；其他字符直接判为非法。最后要求见过数字。
en: A valid number has clear structure: an optional sign, an integer or decimal part, and an optional exponent. Try splitting the rules apart and checking them one by one.
Track flags for seen digit, seen dot, and seen exponent. A dot appears at most once and only before the exponent; the exponent needs digits on both sides; a sign appears only first or right after e.

Per character: a digit sets seen-digit; a sign must be first or follow e; a dot needs no earlier dot or e; e needs a prior digit and no earlier e, then resets seen-digit; anything else fails. End with seen-digit.

zh: 每一行放哪些单词可以贪心决定：尽量多放，放不下就换行。真正的难点在于放好之后怎么分配空格。
一行确定后，总空格数等于行宽减去这一行字母的总长度。把空格平均分到单词之间的缝隙里，除不尽时，多出来的空格从最左边的缝隙开始每个多给一个。
从左到右分组：累计单词长度，再加上每个缝隙至少一个空格，超过行宽就结束本行。普通行按上面的规则分配空格；只有一个单词的行和最后一行改为左对齐：单词间一个空格，行尾用空格补满。
en: Which words go on a line can be decided greedily: keep adding until the next one won't fit. The hard part is distributing spaces afterward.
Once a line is fixed, its total spaces equal the width minus the letters. Split them evenly across the gaps, giving one extra to the leftmost gaps when it doesn't divide evenly.

Group words left to right, counting letters plus one space per gap, and close the line when the next word overflows. Justify normal lines as above; single-word lines and the last line are left-aligned and padded.

zh: 答案是“平方不超过 x”的最大整数，而平方随数字单调增大，所以这其实是在一段整数区间里找一个分界点。
在整数区间上二分：mid 的平方不超过 x，答案至少是 mid；否则答案更小。为了避免平方溢出，可以改成比较 mid 和 x 除以 mid 的大小。
x 小于 2 时直接返回 x。左右边界设为 1 和 x 的一半，循环二分：若 mid 不超过 x 除以 mid，就记下 mid 并往右收缩，否则往左收缩。循环结束返回记下的值。
en: The answer is the largest integer whose square is at most x. Squares grow monotonically, so you are looking for a boundary point in an integer range.
Binary-search integers: if mid squared is at most x, the answer is at least mid; otherwise it is smaller. To avoid overflow, compare mid with x divided by mid instead of squaring.
If x is below 2, return x. Search between 1 and x/2: when mid is at most x/mid, record mid and move right; otherwise move left. Return the recorded value when the loop ends.

zh: 先手算几个小情况：1 阶、2 阶、3 阶、4 阶分别有几种走法？把这串数写出来，看看它们之间有什么关系。
规律来自最后一步：踏上第 i 阶，要么从 i−1 阶跨一步，要么从 i−2 阶跨两步，两类互不重叠，所以方法数是前两阶之和。地面算作 1 种。
第 0 阶和第 1 阶的方法数都设为 1；从第 2 阶依次推到第 n 阶，每阶由前两阶相加得到；只保留两个滚动变量即可。
en: Work out small cases by hand: how many ways are there for 1, 2, 3 and 4 steps? Write the numbers down and look at how they relate.
The pattern comes from the last move: you reach step i from i−1 with one stair or from i−2 with two. These never overlap, so the count is the sum of the previous two. The ground counts as 1 way.
Set the ways for steps 0 and 1 to 1, then build up to n, each step adding the previous two. Two rolling variables are enough.

zh: 先按斜杠把路径切成若干段，连续斜杠会产生空段。每一段只可能是少数几种角色之一，想想它们分别会对当前所在目录做什么。
规范路径就是从根往下的一串目录名。“..” 只撤销最近进入的那一层（已在根目录时什么也不做），“.” 和空段没有任何影响。
逐段处理：空段和 “.” 跳过；遇到 “..” 时若还有目录就去掉最后一个；其他名字（包括 “...”）追加到末尾。最后用斜杠连接并在开头补一个斜杠，为空就返回根目录。
en: Split the path by slashes; repeated slashes produce empty pieces. Each piece plays one of only a few roles, so ask what each role does to the current directory.
The canonical path is a list of directory names from the root down. ".." undoes only the most recently entered level (no-op at root), while "." and empty pieces change nothing.
Process pieces in order: skip empty and "."; on ".." drop the last name if any; append everything else, including "...". Join with slashes, add a leading slash, and return "/" if empty.

zh: 只盯着两个字符串的末尾字符看。不管怎么操作，总有一步要处理这两个末尾，如果它们本来就相等，就省了一步。
设 D[i][j] 为把 word1 前 i 个字符变成 word2 前 j 个字符的最少操作数。末尾相等可以直接沿用左上角；不等时删除、插入、替换各自对应一个更小的子问题。
第一行和第一列是空串对前缀，值等于前缀长度；逐格填写：相等取左上角，不等取三种操作对应位置中的最小值再加一；右下角就是答案。
en: Focus on the last characters of both strings. Some step has to deal with those ends, and if they already match, you get them for free.
Let D[i][j] be the min ops to turn word1's first i chars into word2's first j. A match reuses the diagonal; otherwise delete, insert, and replace each shrink to a smaller subproblem.
The first row and column compare against an empty string, so each equals its prefix length. Fill cells: match → diagonal; else 1 + the min of the three neighbors. Return bottom-right.

zh: 每行有序，且每行开头都大于上一行末尾，把各行首尾相接其实就是一个有序数组。
不必真的拼接：一维下标除以列数得到行号，余数就是列号。这样就能直接在矩阵上做普通二分。
在 0 到总元素数减一之间二分；每次把中点换算成行列去取值，与 target 比较后收缩范围；命中返回 true，范围为空返回 false。
en: Each row is sorted and starts above the previous row's end, so the rows laid end to end form one sorted array.
No need to build it: dividing a flat index by the column count gives the row, and the remainder gives the column. That lets you run plain binary search on the matrix directly.
Search flat indices from 0 to the element count minus one. Convert each midpoint to row and column, compare with target, and shrink the range. Return true on a hit, false when it empties.

zh: 只有三种取值，而且要原地完成，最好只扫一遍。能不能把数组分成几块“已经确定”的区域，再加一块“待处理”的区域？
维护三个边界：左边全是 0，中间全是 1，右边全是 2，夹在中间的是还没看过的部分。每处理一个元素，未知区就缩小一格。
当前指针遇到 0，与左边界交换，两者都前进；遇到 1，直接前进；遇到 2，与右边界交换，右边界后退，但当前指针不动，因为换过来的值还没检查过。
en: There are only three values, and you want one in-place pass. Can you split the array into several settled regions plus one unknown region?
Keep three boundaries: 0s on the left, 1s in the middle, 2s on the right, and an unscanned zone in between. Each step shrinks the unknown zone by one.
If the current value is 0, swap it with the low boundary and advance both. If 1, just advance. If 2, swap with the high boundary and shrink it, but stay put, since the swapped-in value is unseen.

zh: 假设某个子串已经覆盖了 t，把它的右端继续往后延长，它依然覆盖。那么右端固定时，左端最远能推进到哪里？右端右移之后，这个位置会往回退吗？
左端不会回退，所以左右两端都只需向右走，这就是滑动窗口。判断是否覆盖不必每次比对整张计数表：维护“还有几种字符没达标”，只在某字符数量恰好达标或恰好跌破时更新；重复字符要按次数算。
先统计 t 中各字符的需求；右端每加入一个字符就更新计数和未达标数；未达标数为零时，记录当前窗口并移出左端字符，直到某字符跌破需求为止；扫描结束后返回记录到的最短窗口，没有就返回空串。
en: If a substring already covers t, extending its right end keeps it covering. For a fixed right end, how far can the left end advance? When the right end moves on, can that limit ever move back?

The left limit never retreats, so both ends only move right: a sliding window. Skip comparing count tables; track how many chars are still short (repeats in t count fully), updating as a count meets or drops below need.

Count t's needs. Add each right-end char and update counts and the shortfall. While the shortfall is 0, record the window and drop left chars until one falls below its need. Return the shortest window seen, or "".

zh: 组合不看顺序，只要让选出的数严格递增，就能天然避免 {1,2} 和 {2,1} 重复出现。
状态是“下一个可选的最小数”加上已选个数；如果剩下的数已经不够填满 k 个位置，这条分支可以直接放弃。
从 1 开始递归：选够 k 个就记录；否则从起点往后枚举下一个数，上界取到还能凑够剩余个数为止；加入后从它的下一个数继续递归，回来撤销。
en: Order doesn't matter, so force the chosen numbers to be strictly increasing; that alone rules out {1,2} vs {2,1}.
The state is the smallest number you may pick next plus how many you have. If too few numbers remain to fill the k slots, abandon the branch.
Recurse from 1. With k picked, record. Else try each next number up to the last one that still leaves room, recurse from the number after it, then undo.

zh: 每个元素要么在子集里，要么不在，子集总数正好是 2 的 n 次方，可以把问题看成一棵二叉决策树。
递归状态只需“正在决定第几个下标”加上已选的路径；每个下标只做一次决策，就不会重复也不会遗漏。
从下标 0 出发，走到末尾时记录当前路径；否则先把当前元素加入路径递归，回来撤销后，再不加它直接递归下一个下标。
en: Each element is either in a subset or not, so there are exactly 2^n subsets. Think of it as a binary decision tree.
The state is just which index you are deciding on plus the current path. Deciding each index exactly once guarantees no duplicates and no misses.
Start at index 0. At the end, record the path. Otherwise add the current element and recurse, remove it, then recurse again without it.

zh: 单词的相邻字母必须落在相邻格子上，相当于在网格里找一条特定路径；任何与首字母相同的格子都可以作为起点。
递归状态是“当前格子 + 已匹配到第几个字母”；进入格子时临时把它标记为已访问（比如改成特殊字符），离开时恢复，保证同一条路径不重复使用格子。
遍历所有格子作为起点；递归时越界、已访问或字母不匹配就返回失败，匹配完最后一个字母返回成功；否则标记当前格，向四个方向递归，恢复格子，返回是否有方向成功。
en: Consecutive letters must sit in adjacent cells, so you're looking for a specific path in the grid; any cell matching the first letter can start it.
State: current cell plus how many letters are matched. Mark a cell visited on entry (e.g. overwrite it temporarily) and restore it on exit, so one path never reuses a cell.
Try every cell as a start. Fail on out of bounds, visited, or mismatch; succeed after the last letter. Otherwise mark the cell, try all four neighbors, restore, and return whether any worked.

zh: 数组有序，每个值最多保留两份。要判断一个新元素能不能留下，只需要看已保留部分里的哪一个位置？
已保留部分始终有序且合法。当前元素可以写入，当且仅当它和已保留部分的倒数第二个元素不同。
前两个元素直接保留。之后逐个扫描，把当前元素与写指针往前数两格的元素比较，不同就写入并让写指针前进。最后返回写指针。
en: The array is sorted and each value may stay at most twice. To decide whether a new element can be kept, which single position in the kept part do you need to check?
The kept prefix is always sorted and valid. The current element may be appended exactly when it differs from the second-to-last kept element.
Keep the first two elements as they are. For each later element, compare it with the element two slots before the write index; if different, write it and advance. Return the write index.

zh: 旋转过的数组从中点切开，总有一半是有序的，前提是你能分辨出是哪一半。可如果左端、中点、右端的值都相等，还分辨得出来吗？
这时无法判断，唯一安全的做法是左右边界各缩一格，因为它们都不是 target。其余情况照旧判断有序的一半。正因如此，最坏情况会退化到线性时间。
每轮先看中点是否命中；若两端都与中点相等，就左边界加一、右边界减一后继续；否则找出有序的那一半，target 落在它的范围内就去这一半，不然去另一半。
en: Split a rotated array at the middle and one half is always sorted, provided you can tell which. When the left end, middle, and right end are all equal, can you still tell?
You can't, so the only safe move is shrinking both ends by one, since neither is the target. Otherwise pick the sorted half as before. That is why the worst case becomes linear.

Each round, check the middle for a hit. If both ends equal the middle, step lo up and hi down and continue. Otherwise find the sorted half: search it if target lies in its range, else search the other half.

zh: 这次只要某个值重复出现，它的所有节点都要删掉，连头节点也可能被删。做判断时，指针应该站在哪个位置？
让指针停在“已确认保留部分的最后一个节点”上，向后看：如果紧跟着的两个节点值相同，就把这一整段同值节点都跳过；否则后一个节点是安全的，指针前进一步。
建哑节点，指针从哑节点开始；当后面至少还有两个节点时：若这两个值相同，记下该值，持续把等于该值的后继节点摘掉；否则指针前进一步；返回哑节点的下一个。
en: Now every node of a duplicated value must go, possibly including the head. Where should your pointer stand when making that decision?
Keep the pointer on the last node already confirmed to stay and look ahead: if the next two values match, skip that entire run; otherwise the next node is safe and you advance.

Create a dummy and start there. While at least two nodes follow: if their values match, note the value and keep unlinking following nodes that have it; else advance one step. Return the node after the dummy.

zh: 链表已经有序，相同的值一定挨在一起，所以每个节点只需要和紧挨着的下一个比较。
把当前节点当作保留下来的那一份：如果下一个值和它相同，就把下一个跳过；只有下一个值不同时，才把当前节点往后移。
从头开始；当前节点和它的下一个都存在时，若两值相同，就让当前节点直接连到下下个；否则当前节点后移；最后返回头节点。
en: The list is sorted, so equal values sit next to each other; each node only ever needs to be compared with the one right after it.
Treat the current node as the copy you keep: if the next node has the same value, skip it; only advance when the next value is different.
Walk from head. While the current node and its next exist: if their values match, link current to the node after next; otherwise move current forward. Return head.

zh: 最优矩形的高度一定等于其中某根柱子的高度。于是可以枚举以每根柱子为最矮柱的矩形，问题就变成它能往左右延伸多远。
一根柱子会向两侧延伸到第一根比它矮的柱子为止。若栈中下标对应的高度自底向上递增，某根柱子被弹出时，新栈顶和当前下标恰好就是它两侧第一根更矮的柱子。
从左到右扫描，当前柱比栈顶矮就弹出栈顶，以弹出的高度为高、当前下标与新栈顶之间的距离为宽算面积并更新答案。末尾补一根高度为零的哨兵，把剩下的柱子清算掉。
en: The best rectangle's height equals some bar's height. So enumerate rectangles where each bar is the shortest, and ask how far that bar can extend left and right.
A bar extends until the first shorter bar on each side. With indices kept in increasing height order, when a bar is popped, the new top and the current index are exactly those two shorter neighbors.

Scan left to right; while the current bar is shorter than the top, pop it and compute its height times the gap between the current index and the new top. Append a zero-height sentinel to flush the rest.

zh: 固定矩形下边所在的那一行，往上数每一列连续有几个 1，这一行就变成了一张柱状图。
每行的柱高可以由上一行递推：当前格是 1 就在上一行的高度上加一，是 0 就归零。这样每一行都只需在一维柱状图上求最大矩形。
准备一个长度等于列数的高度数组，逐行更新。每行用单调递增栈求最大矩形：柱子出栈时，以它的高度乘以当前下标与新栈顶之间的宽度算面积。所有行的结果取最大值。
en: Fix the row containing the rectangle's bottom edge. Counting consecutive 1s upward in each column turns that row into a histogram.
Each row's heights follow from the previous row: a 1 extends the column height by one, a 0 resets it. Every row then becomes a one-dimensional largest-rectangle problem.

Keep a heights array as wide as a row and update it per row. On each row use an increasing stack: when a bar pops, its area is its height times the gap between the current index and the new top. Take the max.

zh: 要求两部分内部都保持原来的相对顺序，原地交换很难做到。不如换个思路：边遍历边把节点分到两条新链里。
用两个哑节点分别作为“小于 x”链和“其余”链的起点，各自维护尾指针；按遍历顺序把节点接到对应链的尾部，相对顺序自然就保留了。
建两个哑节点和两个尾指针；遍历原链，把每个节点接到对应的尾后并移动尾；结束后先把第二条链的尾指向空，再把第一条链的尾接到第二条链的第一个真实节点；返回第一条链哑节点的下一个。
en: Both parts must keep their original relative order, which is hard with in-place swaps. Instead, sort nodes into two new chains as you walk.
Use two dummies, one for nodes less than x and one for the rest, each with a tail. Appending in traversal order preserves relative order automatically.
Create two dummies and tails. Walk the list, appending each node to the matching tail. Then end the second chain with null and link the first chain's tail to the second chain's first real node.

zh: 从前往后合并，会覆盖 nums1 里还没处理的元素。nums1 的哪一端是空着的？
从尾部开始，每次把两边剩余元素中最大的那个放进 nums1 最后一个空位。这样写入位置永远追不上 nums1 中尚未读取的元素。
三个指针分别指向 nums1 有效部分的末尾、nums2 的末尾和写入位置。每次比较两边，较大者写入并左移对应指针。nums2 用完即可停止，nums1 剩下的元素本来就在正确位置。
en: Merging front to back would overwrite values in nums1 you haven't read yet. Which end of nums1 is free?
Fill from the back: each step, put the largest remaining element into the last empty slot. The write position can never overtake the unread part of nums1.

Keep pointers at the end of nums1's data, the end of nums2, and the write slot. Write the larger value and move that pointer left. Stop when nums2 runs out; leftover nums1 values are already in place.

zh: 有重复元素时，两个相等的数选哪一个结果都一样，重复子集就是这么来的；先排序能让相同的值挨在一起。
按“每层从起点往后挑下一个元素”的方式搜索：同一层里，相等的值只让第一个开分支，后面的跳过；但更深的层仍然可以继续选同样的值。
先排序；每进入一个递归节点就记录当前路径；从起点往后遍历，若当前值和前一个相同且不是本层第一个就跳过，否则加入路径、从下一个下标递归、再撤销。
en: With duplicates, picking either of two equal values gives the same subset, which is where repeats come from. Sorting puts equal values side by side.
Use the pick-next-from-start style. Within one level, only the first of a run of equal values opens a branch; deeper levels may still take that value again.
Sort. Record the path on entering each node. Loop from start: skip a value equal to the previous one unless it's first in this loop; else append, recurse from the next index, pop.

zh: 字符串末尾的一位或两位数字会被解成最后一个字母，这把问题拆成了更短前缀上的同类子问题。
定义“前 i 个字符的解码方法数”，空前缀算 1 种。最后一位单独解码要求它不是 0；最后两位合起来解码要求组成 10 到 26 之间的数。合法的情况各自贡献方法数。
空前缀设为 1；从第 1 个字符起逐个扫描：当前字符不是 0 就加上前一个前缀的方法数；与前一字符组成的两位数在 10 到 26 之间，再加上前两个前缀的方法数；返回整串的值。
en: The last one or two digits decode into the final letter, which splits the problem into the same question on a shorter prefix.
Let the state be the number of ways to decode the first i characters, with the empty prefix as 1. A lone last digit must not be 0; a last pair must form 10-26. Each valid case adds its count.
Set the empty prefix to 1. At each position, add the previous count if the digit isn't 0, and add the count from two back if the last two digits form 10-26. Return the full-length value.

zh: 只反转中间一段时，难点不在反转本身，而在反转段的两端怎样重新接回去。先想清楚哪两个节点必须记住。
记住反转段前面的那个节点，以及反转段原来的第一个节点（反转后它会变成段尾）；可以反复把段尾后面的节点挪到前驱之后，一趟就能完成。
建哑节点，走到第 left-1 个位置作为前驱，它的下一个是段首；重复 right-left 次：取出段首的后继，让段首跳过它，再把它插到前驱的后面；返回哑节点的下一个。
en: Reversing the middle part isn't the hard bit; reconnecting both ends is. Figure out which two nodes you must keep track of.
Remember the node before the segment and the segment's original first node, which becomes its tail. Repeatedly move the node after that tail to right after the predecessor; one pass does it.

Use a dummy and walk to the node before position left; its next is the segment start. Repeat right-left times: unlink the start's successor and insert it right after the predecessor. Return the node after the dummy.

zh: IP 恰好 4 段，每段 1 到 3 位，所以每一步只需决定“下一段取几个字符”，搜索树非常浅。
状态是“当前下标 + 已切出的段数”。一段合法要求：不能有前导零（单独的 0 除外），数值不超过 255；剩余字符数也必须能被剩余段数以每段 1 到 3 位装下，否则直接剪枝。
从下标 0、段数 0 递归：凑满 4 段且字符正好用完就记录；否则依次尝试取 1、2、3 个字符作为下一段，检查前导零和大小，合法就加入并递归，回来撤销。
en: An IP has exactly 4 parts of 1-3 digits, so each step only decides how many characters the next part takes. The tree is very shallow.
State: current index plus parts made. A part is valid with no leading zero (except 0 itself) and value at most 255. Prune if the remaining length can't fit the remaining parts.
Recurse from index 0 with 0 parts: with 4 parts and nothing left, record. Else try 1, 2, or 3 chars as the next part, check zero and range, recurse if valid, undo.

zh: 中序是“左、根、右”，一个节点要等它整棵左子树处理完才能输出。迭代时，你需要把哪些节点暂时存起来？
从当前节点出发一路向左，把沿途节点都压栈；向左走到头后弹出栈顶，这时它的左子树已经完成，记录它，然后转到它的右子树重复同样的过程。
当前指针设为根；当指针非空或栈不空时：先沿左孩子一路入栈直到为空；弹出栈顶并记录值；把指针设为它的右孩子；循环结束返回结果。
en: Inorder is left, root, right: a node has to wait until its whole left subtree is done. In the iterative version, which nodes do you need to hold on to?
From the current node, push every node along the left chain. When you can't go further left, pop: its left side is finished, so record it, then repeat the process on its right subtree.
Set cur to the root. While cur is non-null or the stack isn't empty: push nodes going left until null; pop one and record it; set cur to its right child. Return the result.

zh: s3 的每个前缀都由 s1 的某个前缀和 s2 的某个前缀交错而成，两个前缀的长度和是固定的。两边字符相同时，贪心随便挑一边可能走错。
设 ok[i][j] 表示 s1 前 i 个字符和 s2 前 j 个字符能否交错拼成 s3 的前 i+j 个字符。最后一个字符要么来自 s1，要么来自 s2，两种可能都要保留。
长度和对不上直接返回否；ok[0][0] 为真；若上方格子为真且 s1 当前字符等于 s3 对应字符，或左方格子为真且 s2 当前字符匹配，就记为真；返回右下角。
en: Every prefix of s3 is woven from a prefix of s1 and a prefix of s2 whose lengths add up. When both offer the same character, greedily picking one side can fail.
Let ok[i][j] mean the first i of s1 and the first j of s2 can interleave into the first i+j of s3. The last character came from s1 or s2; keep both possibilities alive.
If lengths don't add up, return false. ok[0][0] is true. A cell is true if the cell above is true and s1's char matches s3 there, or the left cell is true and s2's char matches. Return bottom-right.

zh: 只检查每个节点和它直接孩子的大小关系是不够的，深层节点还得满足所有祖先带来的限制。
每个节点都有一个由祖先决定的合法取值区间：往左走时上界收紧为父节点值，往右走时下界收紧为父节点值。换个角度，中序遍历必须严格递增。
递归时带上上下界，初始为无穷；当前值不在区间内就返回假；否则用更新后的界分别检查左右子树。注意界值要能超出整数的极值。
en: Checking each node against its direct children is not enough; deep nodes must also satisfy constraints from every ancestor.
Each node has an allowed open interval set by its ancestors: going left tightens the upper bound, going right tightens the lower. Equivalently, inorder must strictly increase.
Recurse with bounds starting at infinity; fail if the value falls outside; otherwise check both children with updated bounds. Make sure the bounds can exceed integer extremes.

zh: 正确的 BST 中序遍历严格递增。两个节点被交换后，序列里会出现“前一个比后一个大”的位置。
若被交换的两个值在序列中不相邻，会出现两处逆序：第一个错误节点是第一处的较大者，第二个是最后一处的较小者；若相邻，只有一处逆序，两个节点都在这一处。
中序遍历并记录前驱；遇到前驱大于当前值时，若还没记第一个就记下前驱，然后每次都把第二个更新为当前节点。遍历结束后交换两个节点的值。
en: A valid BST's inorder sequence strictly increases. Swapping two nodes creates spots where an earlier value exceeds the next one.
Non-adjacent swaps make two inversions: the first wrong node is the larger in the first, the second is the smaller in the last. Adjacent swaps make one inversion holding both.
Inorder with a predecessor: on an inversion, record the predecessor as first if unset, and always set second to the current node. After traversal swap the two values.

zh: 两棵树相同，意味着根相同、左子树相同、右子树也相同。这个问题天然能拆成形式一样的子问题。
同时拿着两棵树里位置对应的一对节点比较：都为空算相同；只有一个为空或值不同就是不同；否则继续比较它们的左孩子这一对和右孩子这一对。
递归比较一对节点：两个都为空返回真；一个为空或值不等返回假；否则返回“左孩子这对相同”并且“右孩子这对相同”。
en: Two trees are the same if their roots match, their left subtrees match and their right subtrees match. The problem breaks into subproblems of the same shape.
Compare nodes in matching positions as a pair: both null means equal; one null or different values means not; otherwise compare the left pair and the right pair.
Recursively compare a pair: both null gives true; one null or unequal values gives false; otherwise return whether the left children match and the right children match.

zh: 对称并不是拿整棵树和自己比，而是看左子树和右子树是否互为镜像。镜像里，哪些位置应该互相对应？
每次成对比较两个节点：值必须相等，并且外侧对外侧（左的左对右的右）、内侧对内侧（左的右对右的左）也都要互为镜像。
写一个判断两个节点是否镜像的递归：都空为真；一个空或值不等为假；否则检查外侧一对和内侧一对。答案就是对根的左右孩子调用它。也可以用队列成对入队来迭代。
en: Symmetry isn't comparing the tree with itself; it's checking whether the left and right subtrees mirror each other. In a mirror, which positions correspond?
Compare two nodes at a time: values must match, the outer pair (left's left vs right's right) must mirror, and so must the inner pair (left's right vs right's left).
Write a recursive mirror check on two nodes: both null is true; one null or unequal is false; else check the outer and inner pairs. Call it on the root's two children. A queue of pairs works too.

zh: 按层输出时，先访问到的节点，它的孩子也应该先被访问。真正的难点在于：怎么知道一层在哪里结束、下一层从哪里开始？
用队列：每一层开始时，队列里恰好装着这一层的全部节点；先记下队列长度，再弹出这么多个，它们就是一整层，期间新加入的孩子都属于下一层。
根非空就入队；队列不空时：记下当前长度，循环这么多次，弹出节点、记录值、把左右孩子入队；把这一层的值列表加入结果；最后返回结果。
en: Output goes level by level, so nodes visited earlier should have their children visited earlier. The real question is how to tell where one level ends and the next begins.
Use a queue. At the start of each level, it holds exactly that level's nodes. Record its size and pop that many; children added meanwhile belong to the next level.
Enqueue the root if present. While the queue isn't empty: note its size, pop that many nodes while recording values and enqueueing children, then append this level's list to the result.

zh: 方向交替只影响每一层“怎么写进结果”，不一定要改变节点“怎么被访问”。
遍历仍按普通层序从左到右进行，孩子入队的顺序也不变；只用一个标记记录当前层的方向，隔一层把这一层的值倒过来放。
普通层序遍历，方向标记初始为从左到右；收集每层的值时，按标记决定追加到末尾还是插到开头（或收集完再反转）；把这一层加入结果后翻转标记。
en: Alternating direction only affects how each level is written into the result, not necessarily how the nodes are visited.
Keep the traversal a plain left-to-right level order with the usual enqueue order; just track a direction flag and write every other level in reverse.

Run a normal level-order traversal with a flag that starts left-to-right. For each level, add values at the end or the front depending on the flag (or reverse afterward). Add the level, then flip the flag.

zh: 一棵树的深度和它左右子树的深度有什么关系？试着让递归函数直接把答案“返回”上来。
空树的深度为零；非空节点的深度是左右子树深度中的较大者，再加上自己这一层。这里数的是路径上的节点数，不是边数。
写一个递归：节点为空返回零；否则分别求左、右子树的深度，返回较大者加一。也可以用层序遍历，数一共有多少层。
en: How is a tree's depth related to the depths of its two subtrees? Let your recursive function hand the answer straight back up.
An empty tree has depth zero; a node's depth is the larger subtree depth plus one for the node itself. You're counting nodes on the path here, not edges.
Recurse: return 0 for null; otherwise compute the left and right depths and return the larger plus one. Alternatively, run a level-order traversal and count the levels.

zh: 前序遍历的第一个元素一定是根；在中序遍历里找到这个根，它左边全属于左子树，右边全属于右子树。
左子树的节点个数可以从中序的切分直接数出来，用它就能在前序里切出左右子树对应的区间。用哈希表存中序下标，省去每次线性查找。
递归函数接收前序和中序的区间：取前序区间首元素建根，查它在中序的位置得到左子树大小，划分区间分别递归建左右子树，区间为空时返回空。
en: The first preorder element is always the root; locating it in inorder puts everything to its left in the left subtree and everything to its right in the right subtree.
The left subtree's size comes straight from the inorder split, which lets you cut the matching preorder ranges. Map values to inorder indices to avoid linear scans.
Recurse on preorder and inorder ranges: build the root from the preorder start, look up its inorder index for the left size, split both ranges, recurse, and return null when empty.

zh: 后序遍历的最后一个元素就是根。在中序遍历里找到它，左边全属于左子树，右边全属于右子树。
在中序中定位根得到左子树大小，就能确定后序里左右子树的区间：左子树在前，右子树紧跟其后，根在最后。
用哈希表记录中序下标；递归时取后序区间末尾建根，算出左子树长度，切分两个序列的区间分别构造。若用一个全局指针从后往前消耗后序，就得先建右子树。
en: Postorder's last element is the root. Find it in inorder: everything to its left is the left subtree, everything to its right the right subtree.
Locating the root in inorder gives the left size, which fixes the postorder ranges: left subtree first, right subtree next, root last.

Map inorder indices; build the root from the end of the postorder range, compute the left length, split both ranges and recurse. If consuming postorder backward with one pointer, build the right subtree first.

zh: 要求自底向上输出各层，但每层内部仍然是从左到右。需要改的是遍历本身，还是只是结果的组织方式？
遍历照常从上往下按层进行，只是层与层之间的输出顺序要倒过来；层内节点的顺序不变，千万别把所有节点当成一个列表整体反转。
照常做层序遍历，每层得到一个从左到右的值列表；依次追加到结果末尾，最后把各层的顺序整体反转；或者每得到一层就插到结果的最前面。
en: Levels must come out bottom to top, yet each level still reads left to right. Does the traversal itself change, or only how you assemble the output?
Traverse top-down as usual; only the order of the levels flips. Node order inside each level stays the same, so don't reverse all the nodes as one flat list.
Do a normal level-order traversal, producing one left-to-right list per level. Append each to the result and reverse the order of levels at the end, or insert each level at the front as you go.

zh: 有序数组就是某棵 BST 的中序遍历。要高度平衡，根左右两边的元素个数应该尽量相等。
取区间中点当根，左半段都比它小，右半段都比它大，两边规模相差不超过一，递归下去每一层都平衡。
写一个接收左右边界的递归：区间为空返回空；取中点建节点，用左半段递归建左子树，右半段递归建右子树。
en: A sorted array is the inorder traversal of some BST. For height balance, the root should split the elements as evenly as possible.
Pick the middle as root: the left half is all smaller, the right half all larger, and sizes differ by at most one, so balance holds at every level.
Recurse on index bounds: return null for an empty range; build a node at the midpoint, the left subtree from the left half and the right subtree from the right half.

zh: 要高度平衡，根应该取中间的元素，让左右两边个数尽量相等。但链表不能随机访问，每次找中点都要线性时间。
用快慢指针找中点，总代价是 O(n log n)；更巧的是先算出长度，按中序顺序建树，这样链表指针前进的顺序正好就是节点被创建的顺序。
中序模拟：算出链表长度；递归处理一个区间时，先递归建左半部分，再用当前链表节点建根并后移指针，最后递归建右半部分。区间为空返回空。
en: For height balance, the root should be the middle element so both sides are nearly equal. But a list has no random access, so each search for the middle costs linear time.
Fast/slow pointers give O(n log n) overall; the smarter approach builds in inorder sequence, so the list pointer advances in exactly node-creation order.
Inorder simulation: count the length; for a range, recursively build the left half, create the root from the current list node and advance it, then build the right half.

zh: 每个节点都要比较左右子树的高度。如果对每个节点单独去求高度，会有大量重复计算。
让一次后序递归同时带回高度和是否平衡，比如用 -1 这样的特殊值表示“这棵子树已经不平衡”。
先递归拿到左右子树的高度；任一侧已不平衡或两侧高度差超过 1，就向上传递失败标记，否则返回较大高度加一。最后看根的结果。
en: Every node must compare its two subtrees' heights; computing height separately for each node repeats a lot of work.
Let one postorder recursion report height and balance together, e.g. a sentinel like -1 meaning the subtree is already unbalanced.
Recurse into both children; if either reports failure or their heights differ by more than 1, propagate failure, otherwise return the larger height plus one. Check the root's result.

zh: 最小深度必须走到叶子才算。如果一个节点只有一侧有孩子，空的那一侧能算作一条路径吗？
空子树不是叶子，不能参与取最小值；节点只有一个孩子时，只能沿着那个孩子往下走。若用广度优先，第一次遇到叶子所在的层数就是答案。
递归：空返回零；左右都空返回一；只有一侧非空就返回那一侧的深度加一；两侧都有则取较小者加一。或者按层广度优先遍历，遇到第一个叶子立即返回当前层数。
en: Minimum depth has to end at a leaf. If a node has a child on only one side, does the empty side count as a path?
An empty subtree isn't a leaf, so it can't win the minimum; with one child you must go through that child. With BFS, the level of the first leaf you meet is the answer.
Recurse: null gives 0, a leaf gives 1; with one child, return that side's depth plus 1; with two, the smaller plus 1. Or go level by level with BFS and return as soon as you hit a leaf.

zh: 路径必须从根出发、在叶子结束。每往下走一步，还需要凑出的数就少了当前节点的值。
把问题改写成“这棵子树里是否有一条到叶子的路径，和等于剩余目标”。只有在叶子处才能判定成功，空节点本身不算终点。
递归时用目标减去当前值；当前是叶子就看剩余值是否为零；否则继续递归左右孩子，任一返回真即可。
en: A path must start at the root and end at a leaf. Each step down reduces what remains to be matched by the current node's value.
Reframe as: does this subtree have a path to a leaf summing to the remaining target? Success can only be declared at a leaf; a null child is not an endpoint.
Subtract the current value from the target; at a leaf check whether the remainder is zero; otherwise recurse into the children and return true if either does.

zh: 要把所有和为目标值的根到叶路径都列出来，所以走到每个叶子时，都得知道从根到这里经过了哪些节点。
用一条共享路径加回溯来枚举；在叶子处满足条件时要保存路径的拷贝，否则之后的回溯会把已保存的结果也改掉。
DFS 时把节点加入路径并从目标中减去它；到达叶子且剩余为零就存一份副本；左右子树都递归完后，把当前节点从路径末尾移除。
en: You must list every root-to-leaf path that sums to the target, so at each leaf you need to know exactly which nodes led there from the root.
Enumerate with one shared path plus backtracking; when a leaf qualifies, save a copy of the path, or later backtracking will mutate what you stored.
DFS: append the node and reduce the target; at a leaf with zero remaining save a copy; after recursing on both children remove the node from the path's end.

zh: 只看一个节点：展开后它自己排第一，接着是整棵左子树，最后才是原来的右子树。那么原右子树应该接在哪个节点后面？
不必先把左子树展开：把原右子树直接挂到左子树里一路向右走到底的节点上，再把整棵左子树移到右边。那个节点若还有左孩子，之后轮到它时会按同样方式处理，顺序不会乱。
从根开始循环：当前节点有左子树时，找到左子树的最右节点，把原右子树接到它右边，再把左子树移到右边、左指针置空；然后移到右孩子继续。
en: Look at one node: after flattening it comes first, then its whole left subtree, then its original right subtree. Which node should the original right subtree hang from?

You needn't flatten the left subtree first: hang the original right subtree on the left subtree's rightmost node, then move the left subtree to the right. If that node has a left child, it gets the same treatment later.
Loop from the root: if there is a left subtree, find its rightmost node, hang the original right subtree there, move the left subtree to the right, clear left, then advance right.

zh: 题目数的是从 s 里挑下标的方式，挑出的字符串一样但下标不同也算不同。想想在某个方案里，s 的最后一个字符是被用上了还是被跳过了。
设 W[i][j] 为 s 前 i 个字符中等于 t 前 j 个字符的子序列个数。s 的末尾总可以跳过；只有当它等于 t 的末尾时，才额外多出用它来匹配的那一类方案。
t 为空时方案数为 1，s 为空而 t 非空时为 0；逐格填写：先继承跳过 s 末尾的方案数，两末尾相等时再加上两者都去掉末尾的方案数；返回右下角，留意中间值很大。
en: You're counting choices of indices in s, so the same string picked from different positions counts separately. In any choice, is s's last character used or skipped?
Let W[i][j] count subsequences of s's first i chars equal to t's first j. You can always skip s's last char; only when it equals t's last char do you also gain the use-it option.

Empty t gives 1 way; empty s with nonempty t gives 0. For each cell, start with the skip count, and on a match add the count with both last chars removed. Return bottom-right; intermediates get large.

zh: 这是完美二叉树，每个非叶节点都有两个孩子。处理下一层时，上一层的 next 链已经连好了，可以直接拿来用。
同一父节点下，左孩子指向右孩子；父节点的右孩子则指向“父节点 next 那个节点”的左孩子。
从每层最左节点出发，沿着本层的 next 链横向走，按上面两条规则连好下一层；再移到下一层最左节点，直到叶子层。全程只需常数额外空间。
en: The tree is perfect, so every internal node has two children. When wiring a level, the level above is already linked by next pointers you can reuse.
A left child points to its sibling; a right child points to the left child of its parent's next node.
Start at each level's leftmost node, walk that level's next chain applying those two rules to the children, then drop to the next leftmost node until the leaves. Constant extra space.

zh: 孩子可能缺失，所以不能靠“左孩子连右孩子”这类固定位置关系来连接。不过只要上一层已经用 next 连好，就能沿着它横向走完那一层。
把下一层看成一条正在搭建的链表：用一个哑节点当头，再用一个尾指针指向最后接上的节点。
沿当前层的 next 链走，遇到存在的孩子就接到尾指针后面并后移尾指针；一层走完后，从哑节点的下一个节点开始处理下一层，直到它为空。
en: Children may be missing, so fixed rules like "left child links to right child" fail. But once the level above is linked by next pointers, you can walk across it.
Treat the next level as a linked list under construction: a dummy head plus a tail pointer to the last attached node.
Walk the current level's next chain; append each existing child after the tail and advance it. When the level ends, continue from the dummy's next until it is empty.

zh: 每层的位置 j 只能走到下一层的 j 或 j+1；反过来想，如果自底向上计算，每个位置只需要在下面两个位置中挑一个。
定义“从 (i, j) 出发走到底部的最小路径和”：它等于自身值加上下一层 j 和 j+1 两个状态的较小者。自底向上不需要处理边界，答案最终落在顶点。
用一个数组复制最后一行；从倒数第二行往上逐行处理，把数组第 j 项覆盖为“当前值加数组第 j 项与第 j+1 项的较小者”；结束后数组第一个元素就是答案。
en: Position j can step to j or j+1 in the next row. Flip it around: working bottom-up, each position just picks between the two below it.
Let the state be the minimum sum from (i, j) down to the bottom: its value plus the smaller of the states at j and j+1 below. Bottom-up needs no edge checks, and the answer ends at the apex.
Copy the last row into an array. From the second-to-last row upward, overwrite entry j with the cell value plus the smaller of entries j and j+1. The first entry is the answer.

zh: 必须先买后卖。如果你决定今天卖出，那么之前哪一天买入最划算？
从左往右扫描时，维护到目前为止的最低价。今天卖出最多能赚的，就是今天的价格与这个历史最低价之差。
最低价初始为第一天价格，利润初始为 0（允许不交易）；每天先用今天价格与最低价之差更新最大利润，再用今天价格更新最低价；返回最大利润。
en: You must buy before you sell. If you sell today, which earlier day would have been the best to buy?
Scanning left to right, keep the lowest price seen so far. Selling today earns at most today's price minus that historical low.
Start the min at day 0's price and profit at 0 (no trade is allowed). Each day, update profit with today minus the min, then update the min with today. Return the profit.

zh: 交易次数不限，但同一时间最多持有一股。每天结束时，你要么手里有股票，要么没有。
维护两个状态：当天结束时持股的最大资金、不持股的最大资金。换个视角：任何一段上涨都能拆成逐日的小涨幅，把每一段正的日差价都吃下就是最优。
持股初始为负的首日价格，不持股初始为 0；每天用旧值更新：不持股取保持与今天卖出的较大者，持股取保持与今天买入的较大者；返回最后的不持股值。
en: Unlimited trades, but at most one share at a time. At the end of each day, you either hold a share or you don't.
Track best cash while holding and while not holding. Equivalently, any rise splits into daily gains, so collecting every positive day-to-day difference is optimal.
Start holding at −price[0] and not-holding at 0. Each day, from old values: not-holding = better of staying or selling today; holding = better of staying or buying today. Return final not-holding.

zh: 最多两笔交易，而且不能同时持有两股。每天结束时你所处的阶段，可以按已完成几笔、手里有没有股票来划分。
用四个值：第一次买入后、第一次卖出后、第二次买入后、第二次卖出后的最大资金。第二次买入的本钱来自第一次卖出后的资金，而不是从 0 开始。
两个买入状态初始为负的首日价格，两个卖出状态为 0；每天按顺序更新第一次买、第一次卖、第二次买（用第一次卖出后的资金减今天价格）、第二次卖；返回第二次卖出的值。
en: At most two trades, never two shares at once. Each day you're in a stage defined by how many trades are done and whether you're holding.
Track four values: best cash after the first buy, first sell, second buy, and second sell. The second buy is funded from the first-sell balance, not from zero.
Init both buys to −price[0] and both sells to 0. Each day update in order: buy1, sell1, buy2 (from sell1 minus today's price), sell2. Return sell2.

zh: 最优路径一定在某个最高节点拐弯，左右各接一段向下的链。节点值可能是负数，所以有些分支宁可不要。
递归返回“从当前节点往下延伸的最大单链和”，这是父节点能接着用的部分；当前值加左右两条链，则是以这里为拐点的路径，用来更新全局最大值。
后序遍历：拿到左右子链和，小于零就当零；用当前值加两侧之和更新答案；返回当前值加较大的一侧。答案初始设为负无穷。
en: The best path bends at some highest node, joining a downward chain on each side. Values can be negative, so some branches are better dropped.
Return the best downward chain sum from this node, which a parent can extend; the value plus both chains is the path bending here and updates a global best.
Postorder: get both child chains and clamp negatives to zero; update the answer with value plus both; return value plus the larger one. Start the answer at negative infinity.

zh: 题目只关心字母和数字，其他符号可以当作不存在，大小写也视为相同。
不必先生成一个清洗后的新串：从两端同时向中间走，碰到无关字符就跳过，比较时统一转成小写，只用常数额外空间。
左右指针从两端出发，各自跳过非字母数字字符；比较两处字符的小写形式，不同就返回假，相同则同时向内移动；两指针相遇时返回真。
en: Only letters and digits matter; treat every other symbol as if it were absent, and ignore case.
No need to build a cleaned copy: walk inward from both ends, skip irrelevant characters and compare in lowercase, using constant extra space.
Start pointers at both ends. Advance each past non-alphanumerics, compare the lowercase characters, return false on a mismatch, otherwise move both inward. Return true when they meet.

zh: 把每个单词看成一个点，只差一个字母的两个单词之间连一条边。题目问的“最少要经过几个单词”，在这张图上对应什么？
这是无权图上的最短路，适合广度优先搜索。生成邻居时不必两两比较：把单词每一位依次换成 a 到 z，查是否在字典集合里；单词入队时就从集合中删掉，避免重复。
把字典放进哈希集合，endWord 不在其中就返回 0；从 beginWord 开始逐层 BFS，每层生成所有合法邻居，碰到 endWord 就返回当前层数（单词个数），队列空了返回 0。
en: Treat each word as a node, with an edge between words that differ by one letter. What does "the fewest words in the sequence" correspond to on this graph?
That's a shortest path on an unweighted graph, so use BFS. Don't compare all pairs: replace each position with a to z and check a dictionary set; remove a word from the set when it's enqueued.
Put words in a hash set; if endWord is missing, return 0. BFS by levels from beginWord, generating valid neighbors each level; return the level (word count) at endWord, else 0.

zh: 要求线性时间，所以不能排序。如果能 O(1) 判断某个数是否存在，你会选哪些数作为起点往后数？
只有当 x-1 不在集合中时，x 才是一段连续序列的起点。只从起点开始向右延伸，每个数最多被数一次，总工作量就是线性的。
把所有数放进哈希集合。遍历集合中的每个数，如果它的前一个数不存在，就不断检查下一个数是否存在并计数，用这段长度更新答案。遍历集合而不是原数组，可以避免重复值浪费时间。
en: Linear time rules out sorting. If you can test membership in O(1), which numbers should you start counting from?
x starts a run only if x-1 is absent. Extending only from run starts means each number is counted once, so the total work is linear.

Put every number in a hash set. For each number in the set whose predecessor is missing, keep checking the next value and counting, then update the best length. Iterate the set, not the array, so duplicates cost nothing.

zh: 每条根到叶的路径都对应一个十进制数，往下走一层就相当于在数字末尾添一位。
把“走到当前节点时已组成的数”作为参数往下传，每下一层就是旧值乘十再加上当前这一位。
递归时先算出新的前缀值；遇到叶子就返回它；否则返回左右子树结果之和，空节点贡献零。
en: Each root-to-leaf path spells a decimal number; going down one level appends one digit.
Pass the number formed so far down as a parameter; each level multiplies the old value by ten and adds the current digit.
Compute the new prefix; at a leaf return it; otherwise return the sum of both children's results, with null children contributing zero.

zh: 直接判断一片 O 有没有被围住很麻烦，不如反过来问：哪些 O 一定不会被翻转？
一片 O 只要有任意一格在边界上，就不可能被包围；所以凡是和边界上的 O 连通的格子都安全，剩下的 O 全部要翻。
从四条边上的每个 O 出发做 DFS/BFS，把能到达的 O 临时打上标记；再扫一遍整张表，没标记的 O 改成 X，带标记的恢复成 O。
en: Deciding whether a region is enclosed is awkward. Flip the question: which O cells can never be captured?
An O region escapes capture exactly when it touches the border. Every O connected to a border O is safe; all other O cells get flipped.
Start DFS/BFS from each O on the four edges and temporarily mark everything reachable. Then sweep the board: unmarked O becomes X, marked cells go back to O.

zh: 一个分割方案就是在字符串里选若干切口；从左往右决定“第一段在哪里结束”，剩下的部分就是同样的子问题。
状态是“当前段的起点”；只有起点到某个终点的子串是回文时，才能切出这一段继续递归。可以先用二维表算好任意区间是否回文，避免反复判断。
先预处理回文表：两端字符相等且内部也是回文即可；然后从起点 0 递归，到末尾就记录；否则枚举终点，区间是回文就加入路径、从终点下一位递归、撤销。
en: A partition is a set of cut points. Decide where the first piece ends, left to right, and the rest of the string is the same subproblem.
State: where the current piece starts. A piece can be cut only if it's a palindrome. Precompute a 2D palindrome table so each check is O(1).
Fill the table: ends match and the inside is a palindrome. Recurse from 0: at the end, record. Else for each end where the piece is a palindrome, append it, recurse from end+1, pop.

zh: 不管怎么切，最后一段一定是回文。把这一段拿掉之后，剩下的前缀要解决的是不是同一个问题？
要反复判断任意一段是否回文，先预处理 pal[i][j] 表示 s[i..j] 是否回文；再设 cut[i] 为以 i 结尾的前缀的最少切割数。注意切割次数等于段数减一。
用区间 DP 或中心扩展填好 pal；对每个结尾 i：整个前缀就是回文则 0 刀，否则枚举最后一段起点 j，s[j..i] 是回文就用 j 之前的切割数加一更新；返回最后一个值。
en: However you cut, the last piece is a palindrome. Once you remove it, is the remaining prefix facing the same problem?
You will test many slices, so precompute pal[i][j] for whether s[i..j] is a palindrome. Then let cut[i] be the min cuts for the prefix ending at i. Remember cuts = pieces − 1.

Fill pal by range DP or center expansion. For each end i: if the whole prefix is a palindrome, 0 cuts; else for each start j with s[j..i] palindromic, try cuts before j plus one. Return the last value.

zh: 先从全局看：如果所有站的油加起来少于总耗油，从哪出发都绕不完一圈。反过来，总量够的时候，是不是一定有一个起点能行？
若从 A 出发，在到达 B 之前油量第一次变成负数，那么 A 和 B 之间任何一站作起点也都会在 B 之前失败，因为它们少了从 A 起攒下的非负余油。
一遍扫描，同时累计总盈余和当前段盈余；当前段盈余变负时，把候选起点设为下一站并把当前段清零。最后总盈余为负就返回 -1，否则返回候选起点。
en: Look globally first: if total gas is less than total cost, no start can finish the loop. Conversely, when the total is enough, must some valid start exist?
If starting at A the tank first goes negative before reaching B, then no station between A and B can start either, since each loses the nonnegative surplus built up from A.

In one pass, accumulate the total surplus and the current segment's surplus. When the segment goes negative, set the candidate to the next station and reset it. Return -1 if the total is negative, else the candidate.

zh: 每个孩子同时受左、右两个邻居的约束。假如只要求满足“比左邻评分高就要比左邻多”这一条，你会怎么发？
正向扫描只保证“评分比左邻高就比左邻多”，反向扫描只保证右侧的同类条件。每个位置取两次结果中的较大值，就能同时满足两侧，而且仍然是最少的。
每人先发一颗；正向遍历，评分比左邻高就设为左邻加一；反向遍历，评分比右邻高就取当前值与右邻加一中的较大者。最后把所有人的糖果数加起来。
en: Each child is constrained by both neighbors. If only the rule about the left neighbor mattered, how would you hand out candy?
A forward pass enforces only "rated above the left neighbor means more than it"; a backward pass enforces the right side. Taking the larger value at each position satisfies both and stays minimal.
Give everyone one candy. Forward: if rated above the left neighbor, set to left plus one. Backward: if rated above the right neighbor, take the max of current and right plus one. Sum everything.

zh: 除了一个数以外，其余每个数都恰好出现两次。想想有没有哪种运算，能让两个相同的数互相抵消。
异或满足交换律和结合律，相同的数异或得 0，任何数与 0 异或还是它本身。所以不管顺序如何，把所有数异或起来，成对的都会消失。
用一个初值为 0 的变量依次与数组中每个数做异或，遍历结束后变量里剩下的就是只出现一次的数。时间 O(n)，额外空间 O(1)。
en: Every number appears exactly twice except one. Think of an operation under which two equal numbers cancel each other out.
XOR is commutative and associative, a number XOR itself is 0, and anything XOR 0 is unchanged. So XOR-ing everything removes every pair, regardless of order.
Start a variable at 0 and XOR it with each element in turn. What remains at the end is the single number. O(n) time, O(1) extra space.

zh: 其余数都出现三次。那么在任意一个二进制位上，所有数这一位上 1 的总个数会呈现什么规律？
对每一位统计所有数在这一位上 1 的个数并对 3 取模，余数就是只出现一次的数在这一位上的值，因为出现三次的数贡献的总是 3 的倍数。
对 32 个位逐一统计所有数在该位为 1 的次数，模 3 余 1 就在结果中置上这一位。在 Python 这种整数不定宽的语言里，若最高的第 31 位被置上，要把结果换算回对应的负数。
en: Every other number appears three times. On any single bit position, what pattern does the total count of 1s across all numbers follow?
Count the 1s at each bit and take the count mod 3. The remainder is the unique number's bit there, since numbers appearing three times always contribute a multiple of 3.
For each of the 32 bits, count how many numbers have it set; if the count mod 3 is 1, set that bit in the result. In Python, if bit 31 ends up set, convert the result back to its negative value.

zh: 麻烦在于 random 可能指向后面还没复制出来的节点。如果先不管指针，把所有节点都造出来，再回头连线，会不会容易些？
连线时要能从“原节点”找到“它的副本”。哈希表可以做到；想省空间，可以把每个副本暂时挂在原节点的 next 上，让链表本身记住这层对应关系。
第一遍为每个原节点建副本并记下对应关系；第二遍对每个原节点，让副本的 next 和 random 分别指向原 next、原 random 的副本（原来为空的仍为空）；最后返回头节点的副本。
en: The trouble is that random may point to a node you haven't copied yet. What if you created every node first and wired the pointers afterward?
To wire pointers you must get from an original node to its copy. A hash map does it; to save space, temporarily hang each copy on its original's next so the list itself stores the mapping.
Pass one: create a copy of each original and record the pair. Pass two: point each copy's next and random at the copies of the original's next and random (null stays null). Return the head's copy.

zh: 如果 s 的某个前缀能被完整切分，那么在它后面接上一个字典里的词，得到的更长前缀也能被切分。
设 can[i] 表示 s 前 i 个字符能否完整切分。can[i] 为真，当且仅当存在切点 j，使 can[j] 为真，且从 j 到 i 的这一段在字典里。同一个词可以反复用。
把字典放进哈希集合；can[0] 为真；对每个 i 枚举切点 j（只需往回看最长词长那么远），满足条件就标记 can[i] 并停止；返回 can[n]。
en: If some prefix of s can be fully segmented, appending a dictionary word to it gives a longer prefix that can be too.
Let can[i] mean the first i chars split cleanly. It's true exactly when some cut j has can[j] true and the slice from j to i is a dictionary word. Words may be reused.
Put the dictionary in a hash set. can[0] is true. For each i, try cuts j no further back than the longest word; set can[i] and stop on success. Return can[n].

zh: 没有环的话，一直往后走总会遇到空；有环则会永远绕圈。能不能不用额外空间记录走过的节点，就分辨出这两种情况？
让两个指针以不同速度前进；如果有环，等两者都进入环后，快指针每一步都会把距离缩小一格，最终必然追上慢指针。
快慢指针都从头出发；每轮快指针走两步、慢指针走一步；快指针或它的下一个为空就返回无环；两指针指向同一个节点就返回有环。
en: Without a cycle you eventually hit null; with one you loop forever. Can you tell the two apart without storing the nodes you've visited?
Move two pointers at different speeds. Once both are inside a cycle, the fast one closes the gap by one node per step, so it must eventually land on the slow one.
Start slow and fast at head. Each round move slow one step and fast two. If fast or its next is null, there's no cycle; if both point to the same node, there is.

zh: 判断有没有环不难，难在定位入口。把链表拆成“头到入口”和“环”两段来看，这几段长度之间能找出什么关系？
先用快慢指针找到相遇点。设头到入口距离为 a，快指针比慢指针多走的路程恰好是环长的整数倍；推下去会发现，从相遇点再走 a 步也正好落在入口上。
快慢指针从头出发直到相遇，快指针走到空就返回空；然后把一个指针放回头，另一个留在相遇点；两者每次各走一步，再次相遇的节点就是入环点。
en: Detecting a cycle is the easy part; locating its entrance is harder. Split the list into the stretch before the entrance and the loop itself. How are those lengths related?

Find a meeting point with fast and slow pointers. With a the distance from head to entrance, fast's extra distance is a whole number of laps, so a more steps from the meeting point also land on the entrance.
Run slow and fast until they meet (null means no cycle). Put one pointer back at head and leave the other at the meeting point. Step both one at a time; where they meet is the entrance.

zh: 目标顺序是“第一个、最后一个、第二个、倒数第二个……”，你需要能从后往前取节点。单链表怎么做到这一点？
拆成三步：在中点把链表断成前后两段，把后段原地反转，再把两段交替编织起来；关键是断开时让前段的尾部指向空，避免成环。
用快慢指针找到中点；从中点之后断开，前段以空结尾；反转后段；两个指针分别从两段的头开始，每次先存好各自的后继，再把后段节点插到前段节点之后，直到后段用完。
en: The target order is first, last, second, second-to-last, and so on, so you need to pull nodes from the back. How can a singly linked list do that?
Break it into three steps: cut the list at the middle, reverse the second half in place, then weave the halves together. End the first half with null so no cycle forms.

Find the middle, cut after it, and reverse the second half. With a pointer per half, save both successors, insert the second-half node after the first-half one, and advance; stop when the second half runs out.

zh: 前序是“根、左、右”。递归版很好写，改成迭代时，怎样保证左子树先于右子树被处理？
用显式栈模拟递归：访问完一个节点后，先压右孩子再压左孩子；栈是后进先出，于是左孩子会先被弹出来。
根非空就入栈；栈不空时弹出一个节点，把它的值加入结果；若有右孩子就先入栈，再把左孩子入栈；栈空时返回结果。
en: Preorder is root, left, right. Recursion is easy; in the iterative version, how do you make sure the left subtree is handled before the right?
Simulate the recursion with an explicit stack: after visiting a node, push its right child and then its left. Last in, first out means the left one comes off first.
Push the root if it exists. While the stack isn't empty, pop a node and record its value, then push its right child and then its left child, if present. Return the result.

zh: 后序是“左、右、根”：父节点必须等两棵子树都处理完。对照前序的“根、左、右”，把顺序倒过来看看有什么联系？
“根、右、左”的顺序整体倒过来正好是后序，所以用栈按“根、右、左”遍历、最后反转即可；若想直接按后序输出，就要记住上一个访问的节点，用来判断右子树是否已经完成。
根入栈；栈不空时弹出节点并记录值，然后先压左孩子再压右孩子；遍历结束后把结果整体反转再返回。
en: Postorder is left, right, root: a parent waits until both subtrees are done. Compare it with preorder's root, left, right; what happens if you reverse things?

Reversing a root, right, left order gives exactly postorder, so walk root-right-left with a stack and reverse at the end. To emit nodes directly, track the last visited node to know if the right subtree is done.
Push the root. While the stack isn't empty, pop a node and record it, then push its left child and then its right. Finally reverse the recorded list and return it.

zh: 要同时做到按键 O(1) 查找和按最近使用时间 O(1) 调整顺序，单一的数据结构很难兼顾，考虑把两种结构组合起来。
哈希表从键直接找到链表节点；双向链表按最近使用顺序排列，任何节点都能 O(1) 摘下并挪到一端。头尾各放一个哨兵节点，可以省掉空表的判断。
get 命中时把节点移到“最新”一端并返回值，没命中返回 -1。put 遇到已有键就更新值并移到最新端；遇到新键就建节点插到最新端，超出容量时摘掉最旧端的节点并从哈希表删除。
en: You need O(1) lookup by key and O(1) reordering by recency at once. No single structure does both, so think about pairing two.
A hash map jumps from a key straight to a list node; a doubly linked list keeps recency order and lets any node be unlinked and moved in O(1). Head and tail sentinels remove empty-list checks.

get on a hit moves the node to the newest end and returns its value, else -1. put updates and moves an existing key; a new key goes to the newest end, and if over capacity the oldest node is unlinked and unmapped.

zh: 插入排序要在已排序部分里找插入位置。链表没法往回走，所以只能从已排序部分的开头往后找。
