用哑节点作为已排序部分的起点；如果下一个节点不小于已排序部分的最后一个，它本来就在正确位置，直接保留即可，这能省掉大量从头扫描。
建哑节点接在头前，已排序尾设为头；看尾后面的节点：若它不小于尾的值，就让尾前进；否则把它摘下，从哑节点开始找到第一个“下一个值比它大”的位置插进去；直到尾后为空。
en: Insertion sort searches the sorted part for a spot. A linked list can't walk backward, so you have to search forward from the start of the sorted part.
Use a dummy as the start of the sorted part. If the next node is at least as large as the sorted tail, it's already in place; that shortcut saves a lot of rescanning from the front.

Put a dummy before head; the sorted tail starts at head. Check the node after the tail: if it isn't smaller, advance the tail; else unlink it, scan from the dummy to the first spot whose next is larger, insert it.

zh: 要求 O(n log n)，而链表不能随机访问，依赖下标的排序都不好用。哪种排序只需要顺序访问？
归并排序天然适合链表：拆分只要找中点断开，合并只是改指针，不需要额外数组；如果要求常数空间，可以自底向上按 1、2、4…的长度逐轮合并。
链表为空或只有一个节点就直接返回；用快慢指针找到中点并从中间断开；对两半分别递归排序；再用合并两条有序链的方法把结果合起来返回。
en: You need O(n log n), and a linked list has no random access, so index-based sorts are awkward. Which sort only needs sequential access?
Merge sort fits linked lists: splitting is a midpoint cut and merging just relinks nodes with no extra array. For O(1) space, merge bottom-up in runs of length 1, 2, 4, and so on.
If the list has zero or one node, return it. Find the middle with fast/slow pointers and cut there. Sort each half recursively. Merge the two sorted halves and return the result.

zh: 后缀表达式里，运算符总是作用在它前面最近产生的两个值上，这两个值可能是原始数字，也可能是之前算出的中间结果。
维护一个只装数值的容器，里面始终是还没被任何运算符用掉的结果。运算符取走两个值，把结果放回去供后面的运算符继续使用。
依次读每个记号：数字直接放入；运算符先取出右操作数、再取出左操作数，按“左 运算 右”算好放回。除法向零截断。最后容器里剩下的唯一值就是答案。
en: In postfix notation an operator always applies to the two most recently produced values, which may be raw numbers or earlier intermediate results.
Keep a container of values not yet consumed by any operator. An operator takes two of them and puts its result back for later operators to use.
For each token: push numbers; for an operator, pop the right operand first, then the left, compute left-op-right and push it. Division truncates toward zero. The single remaining value is the answer.

zh: 输入里可能有前导、尾随或连续多个空格，而输出的单词之间只能有一个空格。这个问题能拆成哪几个互不干扰的小步骤？
先把字符串切成干净的单词列表（丢掉所有空片段），再把列表倒序，最后用单个空格连接。如果要求原地完成，可以先整体反转，再逐个单词反转回来。
扫描字符串：跳过空格，遇到非空格就一直读到单词结束，把它放进列表。扫描完后倒序列表，用单个空格拼接。原地做法：先压缩多余空格，反转整个串，再把每个单词各自反转。
en: Input may have leading, trailing, or repeated spaces, while the output needs exactly one space between words. What independent sub-steps can you split this into?
Split into a clean list of words, dropping empty pieces, reverse the list, and join with single spaces. To do it in place, reverse the whole string and then each word.

Scan: skip spaces, read each run of non-spaces as a word, and collect it. Reverse the list and join with one space. In-place variant: squeeze extra spaces, reverse everything, then reverse each word back.

zh: 乘上一个负数，原本最大的乘积会瞬间变成最小，最小的也会变成最大。只记一个“当前最好”够不够？
对每个结尾位置同时维护以它结尾的最大乘积和最小乘积。遇到负数时两者角色互换；遇到 0 时两者都会被重置。
用第一个数初始化最大值、最小值和答案；之后每个数，用它本身、它乘旧最大值、它乘旧最小值三者算出新的最大和最小（先暂存旧值）；每一步更新答案。
en: Multiplying by a negative instantly turns the largest product into the smallest and the smallest into the largest. Is tracking a single running best enough?
For each end position keep both the max and the min product ending there. A negative swaps their roles; a zero resets both.
Seed max, min, and answer with the first number. For each next number, compute new max and min from: the number alone, it times old max, it times old min (save old values first). Update the answer.

zh: 旋转后的数组由两段递增序列拼成，最小值是后一段的开头。随便取一个位置，你能判断它属于前一段还是后一段吗？
拿它和最右端比：后一段的元素都不超过最右端，前一段的都比它大。据此二分：中点比右端大，最小值严格在中点右边；否则中点可能就是最小值，右边界只能收到中点。
左右边界从数组两端开始；左小于右时取中点，按上述规则把左边界移到中点右侧或把右边界收到中点；循环结束时左边界指向最小值。
en: A rotated array is two increasing runs glued together, and the minimum starts the second run. Given any position, can you tell which run it belongs to?

Compare it with the last element: the second run never exceeds it, the first run is always larger. Binary search on that: if mid is larger, the minimum is strictly to its right; otherwise hi moves to mid, not past it.
Start lo and hi at the two ends. While lo is less than hi, take mid and apply the rule to move lo past mid or hi to mid. When the loop ends, lo points to the minimum.

zh: 旋转后的数组是两段非递减序列拼成的，最小值在后一段的开头。有了重复元素之后，拿某个位置和端点比较，还总能判断它在哪一段吗？
二分时拿中点和右端比：更大说明最小值在中点右侧，更小说明在中点或其左侧。相等时无法判断，但这个值在中点处还有一份，去掉右端不会丢答案，所以只缩一格。
取中点：大于右端就把左边界移过中点；小于右端就把右边界收到中点；相等就右边界减一。直到左右相遇。全部相等时最坏是线性时间。
en: A rotated array is two non-decreasing runs glued together, with the minimum at the start of the second. With duplicates, can comparing a position against an endpoint always tell you which run it's in?

Binary search comparing mid with the right end: larger means the minimum is right of mid, smaller means at mid or left. On a tie you can't tell, but mid holds the same value, so drop just the right end.
Take mid: if greater than the right end, move lo past mid; if smaller, move hi to mid; if equal, decrement hi. Stop when they meet. All-equal input makes this linear in the worst case.

zh: 弹出元素后，最小值可能要回退到更早的某个值。这些“历史最小值”出现和消失的先后顺序，有什么规律？
最小值的更替是后进先出的，可以用第二个栈专门存它们：压入的数不大于当前最小值时才进辅助栈，弹出的数恰好等于辅助栈顶时才一起弹。
主栈正常压入弹出；辅助栈为空或新值不大于其栈顶时，新值也压入辅助栈；主栈弹出的值等于辅助栈顶时，辅助栈同步弹出；getMin 读辅助栈顶。用“不大于”能让重复的最小值不被提前弹掉。
en: After a pop, the minimum may have to roll back to an earlier value. In what order do these historical minimums appear and disappear?
Minimums come and go last-in-first-out, so keep them on a second stack: push there only when the new value is at most the current min, and pop there only when the popped value equals its top.

Push to the main stack as usual, and to the helper too if it's empty or the value is at most its top. Pop the helper when the popped value equals its top. getMin reads its top; at-most keeps duplicate minimums.

zh: 如果某个子串已经包含三种字符，那么包含它的任何更长子串也都不合法。这对左右端点的移动方式意味着什么？
这正是滑动窗口的前提：右端只管往前，不合法时只收左端。用哈希表记录窗口内每种字符的个数，表的大小就是种类数；某个计数减到 0 时要删掉这个键，否则种类数会算错。
右指针逐个加入字符并计数；种类数超过 2 时，不断移出左端字符、减少计数，归零就删掉该键，直到只剩 2 种；每步用窗口长度更新答案。
en: If a substring already has three distinct characters, every longer substring containing it is invalid too. What does that imply about how the two endpoints should move?

That is what makes a sliding window work: the right end only advances, and you shrink from the left when invalid. Count characters in a hash map whose size is the distinct count; delete a key at count 0.
Add characters as the right pointer moves. While more than 2 kinds are present, remove the left character, deleting its key at count 0. Update the best length each step.

zh: 两条链在交点之后共用同一段尾巴，麻烦只在于交点之前的长度不同。怎样让两个指针同时走到交点？
两个指针各自走完自己的链后，再去走对方的链，总路程都是“两段独有部分加公共部分”，于是会在交点相遇；不相交时会同时走到空。注意比较的是节点本身，不是节点的值。
两个指针分别从两个头出发，每步各走一步；某个指针走到空时，就让它跳到另一条链的头；当两个指针指向同一个节点时停下并返回它（可能是空）。
en: After the intersection both lists share one tail; the only problem is the different lengths before it. How can two pointers reach the junction at the same moment?
Let each pointer walk its own list, then the other's. Both cover the same total distance, so they meet at the junction, or reach null together. Compare node identity, not values.
Start one pointer at each head and step both. When one runs off the end, restart it at the other list's head. Stop when both are the same node and return it (possibly null).

zh: 数组两端外面都视为负无穷，所以只要一直往高处走，迟早会碰到峰值。
看中点和右邻居：右邻居更大，右侧一定有峰值；否则中点或其左侧一定有峰值。无论哪种情况，都能扔掉一半。
左右边界取数组首尾；左小于右时，若中点小于右邻居就把左边界移到中点右边，否则右边界收到中点；最终左边界就是一个峰值下标。
en: Both outer boundaries count as negative infinity, so if you keep walking uphill you must eventually reach a peak.
Look at the middle and its right neighbor: if the neighbor is larger, a peak exists on the right; otherwise one exists at mid or to its left. Either way, half is discarded.
Set lo and hi to the array ends. While lo is less than hi, move lo past mid if mid is smaller than its right neighbor, otherwise move hi to mid. lo ends on a peak index.

zh: 结果可以拆成三块：符号和整数部分、不循环的小数、循环节。前两块都很直接，真正的难点是：怎么知道循环从哪一位开始？
逐位求小数时，下一位以及之后的所有位，完全由当前余数决定。所以给每个余数记下它第一次出现时在结果中的位置；同一个余数再次出现，从那个位置到末尾就是循环节。
先定符号（恰好一个为负才加负号），用 64 位整数取绝对值，写出整数部分；余数为 0 就直接返回。否则加小数点循环：记下余数位置，余数乘 10 得到下一位；余数为 0 时结束，重复时在记录处插左括号、末尾补右括号。
en: The output splits into three parts: sign and integer part, non-repeating decimals, and the repeating block. The first two are easy; the real question is how to tell where the cycle starts.

Digit by digit, everything from the next digit on is fixed by the current remainder. So map each remainder to where it first appeared in the output; when it recurs, that position to the end is the cycle.

Negative only if exactly one operand is. With 64-bit absolute values, write the integer part; done if no remainder. Else add a point and loop: log the position, times 10, emit a digit; on a repeat, insert parentheses.

zh: 数组是有序的。如果某一对数的和比目标大，你能立刻断定还有哪些配对也一定偏大吗？
从最左和最右这一对开始。和太大时，最右的数配上剩下任何一个数都不会更小，可以整个排除；和太小时同理排除最左的数。每一步都排掉一整排配对，这就是双指针。
左指针放开头、右指针放末尾；两数之和等于目标就返回下标（注意从 1 开始计数），偏大右指针左移，偏小左指针右移。
en: The array is sorted. If some pair sums to more than the target, which other pairs can you immediately rule out as too large?

Start with the leftmost and rightmost pair. If the sum is too large, the rightmost value is too big with anything left, so drop it; if too small, drop the leftmost. Each step removes a whole row of pairs.
Put one pointer at each end. If the sum equals the target, return the 1-based indices; if it is larger, move the right pointer left; otherwise move the left pointer right.

zh: 多数元素的出现次数超过一半。如果每次拿掉两个不同的元素，多数元素还能保住“多数”的地位吗？
维护一个候选和一个计数：遇到相同的加一，不同的减一，计数归零就换候选。不同元素两两抵消之后，剩下的只可能是多数元素。
从左到右扫描：计数为零时把当前元素设为候选；当前元素等于候选则计数加一，否则减一。题目保证多数元素存在，所以扫描结束时的候选就是答案。
en: The majority value fills more than half the array. If you repeatedly discard two different elements, does the majority keep its majority?
Keep a candidate and a counter: a match adds one, a mismatch subtracts one, and you switch candidates at zero. Pairwise cancellation can never wipe out the true majority.
Scan left to right: when the counter is zero, take the current value as candidate; then add one if it matches, else subtract one. Since a majority is guaranteed, the final candidate is the answer.

zh: 末尾的每个零都来自一对 2 和 5 相乘。在 1 到 n 的连乘里，因子 2 远比因子 5 多。
所以只需数 n! 里一共有多少个因子 5：每个 5 的倍数贡献一个，25 的倍数再多贡献一个，125 的倍数又多一个，依此类推。
计数设为 0。只要 n 大于 0，就把 n 整除 5，把结果加到计数上，再用新的 n 继续。循环结束返回计数，时间 O(log n)，完全不需要算出阶乘本身。
en: Every trailing zero comes from a 2 times a 5, and in the product 1 through n there are far more factors of 2 than of 5.
So just count the factors of 5 in n!: each multiple of 5 gives one, each multiple of 25 one more, each multiple of 125 another, and so on.
Set a count to 0. While n is positive, integer-divide n by 5, add the quotient to the count, and continue with the new n. Return the count: O(log n), no factorial needed.

zh: 没必要一开始就把整棵树中序遍历存下来，迭代器只需要在被调用时往前推进一步。
用栈保存一条“左链”：栈里是还没被访问的祖先节点。栈顶永远是下一个最小值，栈的大小只和树高有关。
初始化时把从根出发一路向左的节点全部压栈。next 弹出栈顶作为结果，若它有右子树，就把右子树的整条左链压栈；hasNext 判断栈是否为空。每个节点只进出栈一次，均摊 O(1)。
en: You don't need to store the whole inorder sequence up front; the iterator only has to advance one step each time it is asked.
Keep a stack holding a left spine: ancestors not yet visited. The top is always the next smallest value, and the stack never exceeds the tree height.

Initially push the root and every left child down the chain. next pops the top and, if it has a right child, pushes that child's left spine; hasNext checks the stack. Each node is pushed and popped once.

zh: 从起点正向推时，你既想剩余血量多，又想途中最低血量高，两个目标会互相冲突；试着从终点倒着想。
定义“进入 (i, j) 之前至少需要的血量”。从终点往回推：先取右边和下边两者需求中较小的，再减去当前格的值，结果小于 1 就记为 1，因为任何时刻血量都不能低于 1。
建一个多一行一列的表，表外都设为无穷大，只把终点右侧和下侧的两个哨兵设为 1；从右下往左上逐格按上述规则计算，最后左上角的值就是最低初始血量。
en: Going forward, you want both high remaining health and a high minimum along the way, and those goals conflict. Try reasoning backward from the end.
Let the state be the minimum health needed before entering (i, j). Going backward, take the smaller need of right and down, subtract this cell's value, and clamp to at least 1.
Add an extra row and column filled with infinity, except the two sentinels beside the goal set to 1. Fill from bottom-right to top-left by the rule; the top-left value is the answer.

zh: 按数值大小或普通字典序排都不对：3 和 30 谁该放前面？3 和 34 呢？先想清楚只有两个数时该怎么决定先后。
比较两个数字串 a 和 b 时，就比“a 接 b”与“b 接 a”哪个更大。这种比较满足传递性，所以可以直接当作排序规则。
把所有数转成字符串，按上面的拼接规则把应该排前面的放前面，再依次拼接。如果排完后第一个就是“0”，说明全是零，直接返回“0”。
en: Sorting by value or by plain lexicographic order both fail: should 3 go before 30? What about 3 and 34? First work out how to order just two numbers.
To compare strings a and b, compare a followed by b against b followed by a. This rule is transitive, so it works directly as a sort comparator.
Convert the numbers to strings, sort with that concatenation rule so whichever should lead comes first, and join. If the first string is "0", everything is zero, so return "0".

zh: 子串长度固定为 10，这样的子串最多 n 个。能不能一边扫描一边记录见过哪些子串？
用一个集合记录见过的子串，再用另一个集合存已经确认重复的，避免同一子串被多次加入答案。想更快，可以把四种碱基各编成 2 位，滚动维护一个 20 位整数作为键。
枚举每个起点的长度 10 子串：已经见过就放进结果集合，否则标记为见过。用滚动编码时，每右移一位就把旧值左移两位、加上新碱基，再截掉超出 20 位的高位。
en: The length is fixed at 10, so there are at most n such substrings. Can you record which ones you've seen while scanning?
Use one set for substrings seen and another for those already reported, so a repeat isn't added twice. For speed, encode each base in 2 bits and roll a 20-bit integer as the key.

For each start, take the length-10 substring: if already seen, add it to the result set; otherwise mark it seen. With rolling codes, shift left by two, add the new base, and mask off the old high bits.

zh: 最多 k 笔交易时，第 j 次买入只能发生在第 j−1 次卖出之后。另外想想：k 大到什么程度时，这个次数限制就不再起作用？
维护 buy[j] 和 sell[j]，表示完成第 j 次买入、卖出后的最大资金。一笔有用的交易至少占两天，所以 k 不小于天数的一半时就等同于不限次数。
若 2k 不小于天数，直接累加所有正的日差价；否则 buy 设为负的首日价格、sell 全为 0，每天让 j 从 1 到 k 依次用 sell[j−1] 更新 buy[j]、再用 buy[j] 更新 sell[j]；返回 sell[k]。
en: With at most k trades, the j-th buy can only happen after the (j−1)-th sell. Also ask: how large must k be before the limit stops mattering at all?
Keep buy[j] and sell[j], the best cash after the j-th buy and j-th sell. A useful trade spans at least two days, so once k ≥ n/2 it's the same as unlimited trading.
If 2k ≥ n, sum all positive daily gains. Else set every buy to −price[0] and every sell to 0; each day, for j = 1..k, update buy[j] from sell[j−1], then sell[j] from buy[j]. Return sell[k].

zh: 结果的每一位都来自输入的某一位：输入的第 i 位会去到结果的第 31-i 位，这和数值大小无关，必须完整处理 32 位。
用一个结果变量，每一轮先左移一位腾出空位，再把输入的最低位放进去，然后输入右移一位。这样输入的低位最后就落到了结果的高位。
结果初始化为 0，固定循环 32 次：结果左移一位，加上输入的最低位，再把输入右移一位。不要在输入变成 0 时提前停，否则高位会少移；有符号语言里要用无符号右移。
en: Each result bit comes from one input bit: bit i goes to bit 31 minus i. That holds regardless of the value, so all 32 bits must be processed.
Keep a result; each round shift it left to make room, drop in the input's lowest bit, then shift the input right. The input's low bits end up as the result's high bits.

Start the result at 0 and loop exactly 32 times: shift result left, add the input's lowest bit, shift the input right. Don't stop early when the input hits 0. Use an unsigned shift in signed languages.

zh: 逐位检查 32 位当然可行，但有办法让循环次数只等于 1 的个数。
把 n 和 n-1 做按位与，恰好会把 n 最低位的那个 1 清掉，其他位保持不变。每清一次，就说明有一个 1。
计数器设为 0。只要 n 不为 0，就把 n 换成它与 n-1 按位与的结果，计数加一。循环结束返回计数。如果语言里输入是有符号数，要按 32 位无符号来处理。
en: Checking all 32 bits works, but you can make the loop run only as many times as there are 1 bits.
ANDing n with n-1 clears exactly the lowest set bit of n and leaves the rest untouched. Each clearing accounts for one 1 bit.
Set a counter to 0. While n is nonzero, replace n with n AND (n-1) and increment the counter. Return it. If your language gives a signed input, treat it as a 32-bit unsigned value.

zh: 每间房只有偷和不偷两种选择，偷了这间就不能偷前一间；从左往右看，当前决策只受前面一两间的影响。
定义“只考虑前 i 间房时能偷到的最大金额”。第 i 间不偷就继承前 i-1 间的结果；偷的话只能接在前 i-2 间的结果之后，两者取大。
用两个变量分别表示前 i-2 间和前 i-1 间的最优值，初始都为 0；依次扫描每间房，算出新的最优值后整体向后滑动；扫描结束时较新的变量就是答案。
en: Each house is rob or skip, and robbing one forbids its neighbor. Scanning left to right, each decision depends only on the last one or two houses.
Let the state be the best total using the first i houses. Skipping house i inherits the best for i-1; robbing it builds on the best for i-2. Take the larger.
Keep two variables for the best up to i-2 and i-1, both starting at 0. For each house compute the new best, then slide both forward. The newer one at the end is the answer.

zh: 站在右边看，每一层只能看到一个节点。想想怎样按“层”来组织遍历。
每层最右侧的节点就是该层的答案；如果先右后左做深度优先，第一次到达某个新深度时遇到的节点正好就是它。
用队列逐层处理，记下每层最后出队的节点值；或者 DFS 时带上深度，结果列表长度等于当前深度时就把该节点加入。
en: From the right side you see exactly one node per level. Think about organizing the traversal level by level.
Each level's answer is its rightmost node; with a right-before-left DFS, the first node you reach at a new depth is exactly that node.
BFS with a queue, recording the last node popped in each level; or DFS carrying depth, appending a node whenever the result length equals the current depth.

zh: 每个岛屿就是网格里由相邻陆地连成的一块，问题等价于数连通块的个数。
每当扫描到一块还没访问过的陆地，就说明发现了一个新岛；把它所在的整块陆地都标记掉，后面就不会重复计数。
逐格扫描，遇到未访问的陆地就计数加一，再用 DFS 或 BFS 把上下左右相连的陆地全部标记为已访问（也可以直接改成水）。扫描结束即得答案。
en: Each island is a group of adjacent land cells, so the problem is counting connected components.
Whenever the scan hits unvisited land, you've found a new island; marking its whole component ensures it is never counted again.
Scan every cell; on unvisited land increment the count, then DFS or BFS through four-directional neighbors marking land visited (or turning it into water). The count is the answer.

zh: 区间里的数是连续的。只要某一位在区间内发生过从 0 到 1 的变化，那么这一位以及更低的位，一定在某个数里是 0。
答案就是 left 和 right 二进制的公共前缀，后面补零。公共前缀之后第一个不同的位，在区间内必然经历一次进位，它和后面所有位都会出现 0。
把 left 和 right 同时右移，直到两者相等，记下右移了几次；再把相等的值左移回同样的位数，就是答案。也可以反复清掉 right 的最低位 1，直到它不大于 left。
en: The range is consecutive. If some bit flips from 0 to 1 within it, that bit and every lower bit must be 0 in at least one number.
The answer is the common binary prefix of left and right, padded with zeros. At the first differing bit a carry happens inside the range, so it and all lower bits see a 0 somewhere.

Shift left and right rightward together until they're equal, counting the shifts, then shift the common value back left by that count. Or keep clearing right's lowest set bit until it's no greater than left.

zh: 删除一个节点要改的是它前一个节点的 next。头节点没有前驱，怎样避免为它单独写一套逻辑？
在头前面放一个哑节点，让指针始终停在“待检查节点的前驱”上；删掉一个后先别移动指针，因为新接上来的节点也可能要删。
新建哑节点指向头，当前指针设为哑节点；只要它后面还有节点：若后面那个的值等于目标，就把它跳过；否则指针后移；最后返回哑节点的下一个。
en: Deleting a node means changing its predecessor's next. The head has no predecessor, so how can you avoid special-casing it?
Put a dummy node before the head and keep a pointer on the predecessor of the node being checked. After a deletion, don't advance, since the newly linked node may also need removing.
Create a dummy pointing to head and start there. While a node follows: if its value matches, unlink it; otherwise move forward. Return the node after the dummy.

zh: 逐个判断每个数是不是质数，前面得到的信息完全没用上。已经确认 2 是质数之后，你马上就能断定哪些数一定不是质数？
这就是埃氏筛：用布尔数组，每确认一个质数就划掉它的倍数。划的起点可以推迟到 p 的平方，因为更小的倍数都带有比 p 小的质因子，早被划过；p 的平方不小于 n 时就可以停。
n 小于 3 时返回 0。数组先全部标为质数，再去掉 0 和 1。p 从 2 开始，只要 p 的平方小于 n：若 p 没被划掉，就从 p 的平方起每隔 p 划一个。最后统计没被划掉的个数。
en: Testing each number on its own throws away everything learned so far. Once you know 2 is prime, which numbers do you immediately know are not?

That's the Sieve of Eratosthenes: keep a boolean array and cross out multiples of each prime found. Multiples of p below p squared have a smaller prime factor and are already gone, so start at p squared.

If n is below 3, return 0. Mark 0..n-1 as prime except 0 and 1. For p from 2 while p squared is below n: if p is unmarked, cross out p squared, p squared plus p, and so on. Count what remains unmarked.

zh: 反转就是让每个节点的 next 改为指向它原来的前一个节点。可是一旦改掉这个指针，你还找得到原来的下一个节点吗？
把链表看成两部分：已经反转好的一段（记住它的头），和还没处理的剩余部分；每一步把剩余部分的第一个节点摘下来，放到已反转段的最前面。
“已反转头”设为空，当前节点设为原头；循环：先记下当前节点的后继，再让当前节点指向已反转头，已反转头更新为当前节点，当前节点移到刚才记下的后继；最后返回已反转头。
en: Reversing means each node's next should point to its old predecessor. Once you overwrite that pointer, can you still reach the original next node?
Think of two parts: an already-reversed list (track its head) and the untouched remainder. Each step detaches the remainder's first node and puts it at the front of the reversed list.

Start with an empty reversed head and current at the original head. Loop: save current's successor, point current at the reversed head, make current the new reversed head, move to the saved successor.

zh: 把自己当成真的在排课：一开始能上的是哪些课？上完它们之后，哪些课会被解锁？什么情况下会卡住，再也没有课能上？
“能上”就是入度为 0，所有先修课都已完成；每上完一门，它指向的课入度各减一。如果中途卡住，剩下的课必然互相等待、构成环，这时就不可能修完。
建邻接表并统计入度；把入度为 0 的课入队，出队时计数，并把后继课的入度减一，减到 0 就入队。最后处理过的课数等于总数就返回 true。
en: Picture actually scheduling: which courses can you take right away? Which ones unlock after those? When would you get stuck with nothing left to take?

Takeable means in-degree 0: every prerequisite is done. Taking a course lowers its successors' in-degrees. If you get stuck, the remaining courses wait on each other in a cycle, so finishing is impossible.
Build adjacency and in-degree arrays. Queue all in-degree-0 courses; on each pop, count it and decrement its successors, enqueuing any that reach 0. True if the count equals numCourses.

zh: 所有数都是正数：子数组往右延长，和只会变大；从左边去掉元素，和只会变小。利用这一点，左右两个端点有没有必要往回走？
所以可以用滑动窗口：对每个右端点，只要窗口和仍不小于目标，就继续收缩左端；收缩过程中每个满足条件的窗口都可能是更短的答案。
右指针逐个加入元素累加和；当和不小于目标时，用当前长度更新最小值并移出左端元素，重复到和小于目标为止；若始终没满足过，返回 0。
en: Every number is positive: extending a subarray to the right only raises its sum, and dropping from the left only lowers it. Given that, does either endpoint ever need to move backward?
So a sliding window works: for each right end, keep shrinking from the left while the sum still reaches the target; every valid window seen while shrinking may be a shorter answer.
Add elements as the right pointer advances. While the sum is at least the target, record the length and remove the left element. If no window ever qualified, return 0.

zh: 要给出一个上课顺序，让每门课都排在它的所有先修课之后。先想想：排在第一位的课需要满足什么条件？
排第一的课一定没有先修课。把它排上并从图中去掉，剩下的就是同样的问题。所以每次挑一门当前入度为 0 的课，按挑出的先后记录；挑不下去就说明有环。
统计入度，把入度为 0 的课入队；每出队一门就追加到结果里，并把后继的入度减一，降到 0 的入队。结果长度不足课程总数说明有环，返回空数组。
en: You need an order where every course comes after all its prerequisites. What must be true of the course you place first?

The first course has no prerequisites. Place it, remove it from the graph, and the rest is the same problem. So keep picking a course with in-degree 0 and record the order; if you can't, there's a cycle.
Compute in-degrees and queue zero-in-degree courses. Append each popped course to the result and decrement its successors, queuing those that hit 0. If the result is short, return an empty array.

zh: 一个单词一个单词地去网格里搜，同一条路径会被反复走很多遍。能不能只在网格上 DFS 一次，边走边检查路径是不是某个单词？
关键是走到一半就能知道“这条路还有没有希望”。把所有单词放进前缀树，DFS 时同步在树上往下走：树上没有对应分支就立刻回头，走到某个单词的结尾就收集它。
建前缀树；从每个格子出发 DFS，携带当前树节点：字母不在子节点中就返回；进入子节点，若存有单词就收集并清空以免重复；标记格子，向四邻递归，再恢复；子节点变空时从父节点删掉以剪枝。
en: Searching the grid word by word re-walks the same paths many times. Could a single DFS over the grid check every word at once as it walks?
The key is knowing mid-walk whether a path can still lead anywhere. Put all words in a trie and descend it with the DFS: no matching child means turn back; reaching a word end means collect it.
Build the trie. DFS from each cell with a trie node: return if the letter isn't a child; step in, collect and clear any word; mark, recurse on neighbors, restore; drop the child once it's empty.

zh: 房子围成一圈后，每间都有两个邻居，也没有天然的起点，没法直接从左往右推。先想想：只要定下某一间偷还是不偷，这个环会变成什么样？
按第一间分两种情况：不偷它，第 2 到第 n 间就是一排普通的房子；偷它，第 2 间和第 n 间都不能碰，只剩第 3 到第 n−1 间这一排。每一排都能用“偷或不偷”的线性 DP 解决。
对一排房子用两个变量滚动求最大金额：每间取“跳过它”与“偷它加上隔一间的最优值”中的较大者。答案是“第一间金额加第 3 到 n−1 间的结果”与“第 2 到 n 间的结果”中的较大值；只有一间时直接返回它。
en: On a circle every house has two neighbors and there's no natural starting point, so a left-to-right scan doesn't apply directly. Once you fix whether one house is robbed, what does the circle become?
Split on the first house. Skip it, and houses 2..n form an ordinary row. Rob it, and houses 2 and n are off-limits, leaving the row 3..n−1. Each row is a plain rob-or-skip linear DP.

For a row, roll two variables: each house takes the larger of skipping it or robbing it plus the best from two back. The answer is the larger of first house plus row 3..n−1, and row 2..n. One house: return it.

zh: 加在前面的字符只能是原串某段后缀的镜像。想一想：原串开头最长有多长的一段可以完全不动？它需要满足什么条件？
于是问题变成求 s 的最长回文前缀。前缀是回文，等价于它和反转串的某个后缀相同，这正是 KMP 前缀函数能线性求出的匹配关系。
把 s、一个不在 s 中出现的分隔符、s 的反转串依次拼起来，求前缀函数，末尾的值就是最长回文前缀的长度；把剩余后缀翻转后放到 s 前面。
en: Whatever you add in front must mirror some suffix of the string. How long a stretch at the start can stay untouched, and what property must that stretch have?
So find the longest palindromic prefix. A prefix is a palindrome when it equals a suffix of the reversed string, which a KMP prefix function finds in linear time.
Join s, a separator not in s, and reversed s; compute the prefix function. Its last value is the longest palindromic prefix length. Reverse the remaining suffix and prepend it.

zh: 完全排序要 O(n log n)，但你只关心第 k 大这一个位置，其余元素之间的顺序根本不需要知道。
两个角度：只保留目前见过的最大 k 个数，它们中最小的就是候选答案；或者像快速排序那样分区，但每次只进入包含目标位置的那一侧。
堆做法：维护大小为 k 的小顶堆，逐个加入，超过 k 就弹出堆顶，最后的堆顶即答案。快速选择：随机选枢轴分区，比较枢轴位置和目标下标，只在一侧继续；重复值多时用三路划分防止退化。
en: Full sorting costs O(n log n), but you only care about one position, the k-th largest, not the order among everything else.
Two angles: keep only the k largest values seen so far, whose smallest is the candidate; or partition like quicksort but continue only into the side containing the target position.

Heap: keep a min-heap of size k, popping when it exceeds k; the final top is the answer. Quickselect: partition around a random pivot and continue on one side; use three-way partitioning for duplicates.

zh: 只能用 1 到 9，每个数最多一次，还要恰好 k 个，搜索空间很小，按递增顺序挑数就能避免重复。
状态是“下一个可选数字、还需选几个、还差多少”；剩余和变负、个数够了但和不对、或剩下的数字不够凑个数时，都可以立刻剪枝。
从数字 1 开始递归：个数和总和同时达标就记录；否则从当前数字枚举到 9，数字超过剩余和就停止；选中后从下一个数字递归，回来撤销。
en: Only digits 1-9, each at most once, exactly k of them. The space is tiny, and picking in increasing order prevents duplicates.
State: next allowed digit, how many are still needed, and the remaining sum. Prune when the sum goes negative, the count is met with the wrong sum, or too few digits remain.
Recurse from 1: when count and sum both match, record. Else try each digit up to 9, stopping once it exceeds the remaining sum; pick it, recurse from the next digit, undo.

zh: 只关心相同值的两个下标之差是否不超过 k。对当前位置来说，之前同值的哪一次出现最有希望满足条件？
离当前位置最近的那次出现最可能满足距离限制，所以每个值只需记住它最后一次出现的下标。
遍历数组，用哈希表记录每个值最近一次出现的下标。遇到某个值时，如果表里已有且下标差不超过 k，就返回真；否则把它的下标更新为当前位置。也可以维护一个大小为 k 的滑动窗口集合。
en: You only care whether two equal values are at most k apart. For the current index, which earlier occurrence of the same value is most promising?
The closest earlier occurrence is the best bet, so each value only needs its most recent index.
Scan with a hash map from value to latest index. If the value is already there and the gap is at most k, return true; otherwise record the current index. A sliding set of size k works too.

zh: 条件同时限制了下标差和数值差。如果只保留最近 k 个元素作为窗口，问题就变成：窗口里有没有和当前值足够接近的数？
按宽度 valueDiff+1 给数值分桶：同一个桶里的两个数一定满足数值差，相邻桶需要单独检查。窗口里每个桶最多只会有一个数。
遍历时算出当前值的桶号：同桶已有元素就返回真；再检查左右相邻桶，差值够小也返回真。然后放入当前值，并删掉刚离开窗口的那个元素。负数分桶时注意向下取整。
en: The condition bounds both the index gap and the value gap. If you keep only the last k elements as a window, the question becomes: is anything in it close enough in value?
Bucket values by width valueDiff+1: two values in one bucket always qualify, and neighboring buckets need a direct check. Each bucket holds at most one value inside the window.
For each value, find its bucket: occupied means true; also check both neighbor buckets. Then insert it and evict the element that just left the window. Floor carefully for negative values.

zh: 换个问法：如果固定正方形的右下角，它最大能做到多大？这个答案能不能从相邻格子的同一个问题推出来？
定义“以 (i, j) 为右下角的最大正方形边长”。若当前格是 1，它最多只能比三个相邻状态中最小的那个大 1，因为任何一个方向短了，正方形都会缺一块。
遍历每个格子：是 0 就记 0；是 1 时，若在第一行或第一列记 1，否则取左、上、左上三者最小值再加 1；同时记录出现过的最大边长，最后返回它的平方。
en: Rephrase it: if you fix the square's bottom-right corner, how large can it be? Can that answer be derived from the same question asked at neighboring cells?
Let the state be the side of the largest square ending at (i, j). If the cell is 1, it can be at most one more than the smallest of its three neighboring states; any shorter side leaves a gap.
Scan cells: a 0 gets 0; a 1 in the first row or column gets 1, otherwise 1 plus the min of left, up, and up-left. Track the largest side and return its square.

zh: 直接遍历是 O(n)，但完全二叉树形状很规整，其中一些子树必然是满的，而满二叉树的节点数可以直接算出来。
从一个节点出发，一路向左的深度和一路向右的深度如果相等，这棵子树就是满的，节点数等于 2 的高度次方减一。
对当前节点测左右边界高度：相等就直接按满树计算返回；不等就递归统计左右子树再加一。每层只有一侧会继续深入，总复杂度约为 O(log²n)。
en: A plain traversal is O(n), but a complete tree is regular: some subtrees must be perfect, and a perfect tree's size can be computed directly.
If the always-left depth equals the always-right depth from a node, that subtree is perfect and has 2^h - 1 nodes.
At each node compare the two boundary heights; if equal, return the perfect-tree count, otherwise recurse on both children and add one. Only one side goes deep per level, about O(log² n).

zh: 只有加减和括号时，整个表达式最终就是一串带符号数字的和。关键是弄清每个数字最后的正负由什么决定。
一个数字的实际符号，等于它自己前面的符号乘上所有包住它的括号前面的符号。括号外的减号会翻转里面所有项，所以要记住每层括号外的有效符号。
扫描时维护累加结果和当前有效符号；读完一个数就按符号累加；遇左括号把外层状态存起来，遇右括号恢复；遇减号翻转符号。开头或括号后的负号也照此处理。
en: With only plus, minus and parentheses, the expression is just a sum of signed numbers. The real question is what decides each number's final sign.
A number's effective sign is its own sign times the sign in front of every parenthesis enclosing it. A minus outside flips everything inside, so remember the effective sign at each level.
Keep a running total and current sign. Add each finished number with its sign; on "(" save the outer state, on ")" restore it; a minus flips the sign, which also covers unary minus.

zh: 队列只能从一端取出，而栈要求最后放进去的最先出来。要让队头始终是最近压入的元素，就必须在某个操作里调整一下顺序。
其实一个队列就够了：每次压入新元素后，把排在它前面的旧元素逐个出队再入队，新元素就转到了队头。这样重排的代价全部由 push 承担，pop 和 top 都是 O(1)。
push 时先入队，再把队里原有的其余元素一个个移到队尾。pop 直接取出队头，top 读取队头，empty 判断队列是否为空。也可以反过来让 pop 承担搬运，对比两种做法的代价。
en: A queue only removes from the front, while a stack must return the newest element first. To keep the newest item at the front, something has to reorder elements at some point.
One queue suffices: after enqueuing a new item, rotate every older item from the front to the back so the new one ends up in front. Push pays the reordering cost; pop and top become O(1).
On push, enqueue, then move each previously stored element from front to back. Pop dequeues the front, top peeks it, empty checks size. You could instead make pop do the shuffling and compare costs.

zh: 画一棵三层的小树，对照它的镜像看看：每个节点本身发生了什么变化？这个变化是不是对所有节点都一样？
交换某个节点的左右指针，再分别翻转它的两棵子树即可；先交换还是先递归都可以，只要每个节点恰好被交换一次。
递归：节点为空直接返回；交换它的左右孩子；对两个孩子分别递归；返回该节点。也可以用队列按层访问，逐个交换。
en: Sketch a three-level tree next to its mirror image. What changed at each individual node, and is that change the same for every node?
Swap a node's two child pointers, then invert both subtrees. Swapping before or after the recursion both work, as long as every node is swapped exactly once.
Recurse: return for null; swap the node's two children; recurse on both; return the node. Or visit nodes level by level with a queue and swap each one.

zh: 乘除比加减先算，但它们只会粘住相邻的数字。可以把表达式看成被加减号隔开的若干项，每一项内部只有乘除。
加减号开启新的一项，乘除只会修改正在处理的最后一项。因此只需保留已完成项的和与当前项的值，最后一项是唯一可能被改动的。
读完一个数后看它前面的运算符：加号让它成为新项，减号让它成为负的新项，乘除则把它并入上一项（除法向零截断）。把所有项加起来就是答案，空格直接跳过。
en: Multiplication and division bind before addition and subtraction, but only to neighboring numbers. View the expression as terms separated by + and -, with only * and / inside each term.
A + or - starts a new term, while * or / only modifies the latest term. So you only need the sum of finished terms plus the value of the current term.
After each number, check the operator before it: + makes a new term, - a negative new term, * or / folds it into the previous term (truncate toward zero). Sum all terms; skip spaces.

zh: 不用哈希表计数，试试“抵消”的思路：每次删掉三个互不相同的数，出现次数超过 n/3 的元素会被删光吗？
这就是摩尔投票的推广。满足条件的值最多两个，所以同时维护两个候选和计数；遇到与两者都不同的数，就三方各抵消一次。真正的答案一定留在候选里，但候选不一定是答案。
第一趟：等于某个候选就给它加一；有空位就占位；否则两个计数都减一。第二趟：重新统计两个候选的真实次数，只保留超过三分之一的。注意两个候选不能是同一个值。
en: Without a hash map, think about cancellation: if you repeatedly delete three pairwise-distinct values, can an element appearing more than n/3 times ever be wiped out?

This generalizes Boyer-Moore voting. At most two values qualify, so track two candidates with counters; a value matching neither cancels one from each. True answers survive, but candidates still need checking.
Pass one: increment a matching candidate, fill an empty slot, or decrement both counters. Pass two: recount both candidates and keep only those above n/3. Make sure the two candidates are distinct.

zh: 第 k 小的数前面恰好有 k-1 个更小的数。在 BST 里这些更小的数分布在哪里？有没有一种访问顺序，能依次碰到最小、第二小……？
中序遍历（左、根、右）在 BST 上得到的正好是升序序列。边遍历边计数，访问到第 k 个就可以停，剩下的节点不必再看。
用栈迭代：一路向左压栈到底，弹出一个节点就计数加一，计到 k 立即返回；否则转向它的右孩子，重复上面的过程。这样只会访问大约树高加 k 个节点。
en: The k-th smallest value has exactly k-1 smaller values before it. Where do those live in a BST, and is there a visiting order that meets the smallest, then the second smallest, and so on?
Inorder traversal (left, node, right) of a BST yields values in ascending order. Count as you go and stop at the k-th visit; the rest of the tree never needs to be touched.
Iterate with a stack: push left children all the way down, pop a node and bump the count, and return when it hits k; otherwise move to its right child and repeat. This touches about height + k nodes.

zh: 2 的幂在二进制下有一个非常醒目的特征，从这里入手就够了。
正数是 2 的幂，当且仅当它的二进制里只有一个 1。而清掉最低位 1 的技巧，可以一步检查“去掉这个 1 之后是不是变成了 0”。
先判断 n 是否大于 0，不是就直接返回 false。否则计算 n 与 n-1 的按位与，结果为 0 就是 2 的幂，不为 0 就不是。
en: Powers of two have a very distinctive look in binary; start from that.
A positive number is a power of two exactly when its binary form has a single 1. The clear-lowest-set-bit trick checks in one step whether removing that bit leaves zero.
If n is not greater than 0, return false. Otherwise compute n AND (n-1); the number is a power of two exactly when that result is 0.

zh: 一个栈会把顺序倒过来，倒两次就恢复成原来的顺序，而队列要的正是原来的先进先出顺序。
一个栈只负责接收新元素，另一个栈只负责出队。只有当出队栈空了，才把输入栈整个倒进去。每个元素最多被搬一次，所以均摊下来每次操作是 O(1)。
push 压入输入栈。pop 或 peek 时，如果输出栈为空，就把输入栈的元素全部弹出并压入输出栈，然后操作输出栈栈顶；peek 只读不弹。两个栈都空时队列为空。
en: A stack reverses order, and reversing twice restores it, which is exactly the first-in-first-out order a queue needs.
Use one stack only for incoming items and another only for outgoing ones. Refill the outgoing stack only when it is empty. Each element moves at most once, giving amortized O(1) per operation.
Push onto the input stack. For pop or peek, if the output stack is empty, pour the whole input stack into it, then use its top; peek reads without removing. The queue is empty when both stacks are.

zh: 判断回文要从两端往中间比，可单链表只能往后走。能不能想办法让后半段“掉个头”？
先用快慢指针找到中点，再把后半段原地反转；这样就能一边从头往后、一边从尾往前逐个比较，额外空间只要常数。
用快慢指针找到中点；反转中点之后的后半段；两个指针分别从头和反转后的新头同时前进并比较值，后半段走完就停；如需保持输入不变，比完再把后半段反转回去接好。
en: A palindrome check compares from both ends inward, but a singly linked list only moves forward. Could you turn the second half around?
Find the middle with fast and slow pointers, then reverse the second half in place. Now you can compare front-to-back against back-to-front using O(1) extra space.
Locate the middle and reverse the half after it. Walk from head and from the reversed head together, comparing values until the second half ends. Optionally reverse it back to restore the input.

zh: 在 BST 中，拿 p、q 和当前节点比大小，就能知道两个目标分别在哪一侧。
两个值都比当前节点小，祖先在左边；都比它大，在右边；一旦分居两侧或其中一个等于当前节点，当前节点就是最低公共祖先。
从根开始循环：两值都更小就往左，都更大就往右，否则返回当前节点。不需要回溯，也不需要额外空间。
en: In a BST, comparing p and q against the current node tells you which side each target is on.
If both are smaller the ancestor lies left; if both larger, right; once they split across sides or one equals the current node, that node is the LCA.
Loop from the root: go left when both are smaller, right when both are larger, otherwise return the current node. No backtracking or extra space.

zh: 从下往上看：如果 p 和 q 分别出现在某个节点的左右两侧，这个节点就是它们的汇合点。
让递归返回“在这棵子树里找到的 p、q 或它们的公共祖先”。左右都非空时，当前节点就是答案；只有一侧非空，就把那一侧往上传。
遇到空节点、p 或 q 时直接返回它；否则递归左右子树；两边都有结果返回当前节点，否则返回非空的那一侧。
en: Look bottom-up: if p and q appear on different sides of some node, that node is where their paths meet.
Let recursion return p, q, or their LCA found in this subtree. If both sides are non-null, the current node is the answer; if only one is, pass it up.
Return the node immediately if it is null, p, or q; otherwise recurse on both sides; return the current node if both are non-null, else whichever side is non-null.

zh: 能用除法的话，总乘积除以自己就行，可一碰到 0 就失效。换个角度：把位置 i 挖掉以后，剩下的元素在数组里构成了哪两段？
答案就是“i 左边那段的乘积”乘以“i 右边那段的乘积”。两者都能从数组一端顺序累乘得到：从左往右推一遍，再从右往左推一遍。
第一遍从左到右，把每个位置左侧的累乘写进答案数组；第二遍从右到左，用一个变量记右侧累乘，先乘进答案，再把当前数乘进变量。答案数组之外只用常数空间。
en: With division you would divide the total by nums[i], but a zero breaks that. Instead: once position i is cut out, what two pieces of the array are left?
The answer is the product of the piece left of i times the product of the piece right of i. Each can be accumulated by walking from one end: once left to right, once right to left.

Pass one, left to right: store each position's running product of earlier elements in the answer. Pass two, right to left: keep the product of later elements in one variable, multiply it in, then update it.

zh: 窗口每滑一步只进一个、出一个元素，每次重新扫一遍窗口太慢。想想：哪些元素已经永远不可能再成为窗口最大值？
一个元素后面只要出现了不比它小的值，它在离开窗口前都不会是最大值，可以立刻丢掉。剩下的候选下标递增、值递减，最前面那个就是当前最大值。
用双端队列存下标：新元素进来时，先从尾部弹出所有不大于它的值再加入；队首下标已滑出窗口就从头部移除；窗口凑满 k 个后，每一步记录队首对应的值。
en: Each slide adds one element and removes one, so rescanning the window is too slow. Ask which elements can never be the window maximum again.

An element followed by a value at least as large will never be the maximum before it leaves, so drop it at once. Remaining candidates have increasing indices and decreasing values; the front is the max.

Keep indices in a deque. For a new element, pop smaller-or-equal values from the back, then append. Drop the front once it leaves the window. Once the window holds k elements, record the front's value each step.

zh: 行从左到右递增、列从上到下递增，但行与行之间并不连成一个有序序列。站在哪个角上，一次比较就能排除一整行或一整列？
从右上角出发：当前值比 target 大，这一列下面只会更大，整列可以排除；比 target 小，这一行左边只会更小，整行可以排除。
从右上角开始循环：相等返回 true，偏大就左移一列，偏小就下移一行，越界返回 false。步数是行数加列数；逐行二分也可行，但通常更慢。
en: Rows increase left to right and columns top to bottom, but rows don't chain into one sorted list. Which corner lets one comparison rule out a whole row or column?
Start at the top-right. If the value exceeds target, everything below it in that column is larger, so drop the column. If smaller, everything to its left is smaller, so drop the row.
Loop from the top-right: return true on equality, move left when too big, move down when too small, return false once out of bounds. That's rows plus columns steps; per-row binary search also works.

zh: 移位之后，字符串长度不变，相邻字母之间的“距离”也不变。能找到一个同组字符串都相同的特征吗？
把每对相邻字母的差值对 26 取模，得到的序列就是分组键。取模保证了从 z 绕回 a 的情况也能正确处理。
对每个字符串，依次计算相邻字母的差值并调整到 0 到 25 之间，用分隔符拼成键，放进哈希表对应的组。单个字母的字符串键为空，自然会分到同一组。
en: Shifting keeps the length and the distance between adjacent letters unchanged. Is there a feature shared by every string in a group?
Take each adjacent letter difference modulo 26; that sequence is the group key. The modulo handles the wraparound from z back to a.
For each string, compute adjacent differences, normalize them to 0..25, join them with a separator as the key, and add the string to that group. Single letters get an empty key and land together.

zh: 需要的会议室数，等于某一时刻同时进行的会议数的最大值。
把每场会议拆成“开始时 +1、结束时 -1”两个事件，按时间扫描，计数器的最大值就是答案。同一时刻要先处理结束再处理开始，因为 [1,5] 和 [5,8] 可以共用一间。
开始、结束时间分别排序；依次看每个开始时间，若早于结束指针所指的时间就新开一间房，否则结束指针前移一位，相当于复用刚空出的房间。最后的房间数即答案，小根堆存结束时间也可以。
en: The number of rooms needed equals the maximum number of meetings running at the same moment.
Turn each meeting into two events, +1 at its start and -1 at its end, and sweep through time; the peak count is the answer. At equal times handle ends first, since [1,5] and [5,8] can share a room.

Sort starts and ends separately. For each start, if it is earlier than the end at the end pointer, open a room; otherwise advance the pointer and reuse one. The room count is the answer; a min-heap of ends works too.

zh: 12 = 2×6 = 2×2×3 = 3×4：拿出一个因子后，商还能继续分解，这是天然的递归结构；但 2×6 和 6×2 不能都出现。
规定因子从小到大排列：递归时记住“下一个因子至少多大”，并且只枚举到当前剩余值的平方根，更大的那一侧由商本身承担。
下界从 2 开始；从下界枚举到剩余值的平方根，能整除时先记录“路径 + 该因子 + 商”这一完整方案，再把该因子加入路径，以商为新值、该因子为新下界继续递归，最后撤销。
en: 12 = 2×6 = 2×2×3 = 3×4: after pulling out one factor, the quotient can split further, a natural recursion. But 2×6 and 6×2 must not both appear.
Keep factors nondecreasing: pass a lower bound for the next factor, and only try factors up to the square root of what remains, letting the quotient cover the larger side.
Start with bound 2. For each factor from the bound to sqrt(remaining) that divides it, record path + factor + quotient, then push it and recurse on the quotient with that factor as bound; pop.

zh: 每条路径都从根出发、一路向下停在某个叶子。走到叶子的那一刻，手上需要握着什么信息，才能直接写出这条路径？
用深度优先搜索，一路维护“从根到当前节点”的路径；到达叶子就把它拼成字符串存起来。如果所有递归共用同一个路径容器，返回前要把当前节点撤掉。
进入节点时把值加入路径；如果是叶子，就用箭头连成字符串放进结果；否则递归左右孩子；离开前弹出当前值（每层都传副本则不必撤销）。
en: Every path starts at the root and goes straight down to some leaf. At the moment you reach a leaf, what do you need to be holding to write that path out immediately?

Use depth-first search and keep the path from the root to the current node; at a leaf, join it into a string and save it. If all calls share one path container, remove the current node before returning.
On entry push the value; at a leaf join with arrows and record it; otherwise recurse on the children; pop before leaving (not needed if each call gets its own copy).

zh: 假如能把数组分成两组，让两个目标分别落进不同组、而相同的数总在同一组，问题就简化成每组找一个落单的数。按什么标准分组能做到这一点？
把所有数异或起来，成对的会抵消，剩下两个目标的异或值。它不为 0，其中任意一个为 1 的位都说明两个目标在这一位上不同；按这一位分组即可，相同的数必然同组。
先把全部数异或得到总值。取总值最低位的 1 作为掩码。遍历数组，按每个数与掩码相与的结果分到两组，各组分别异或累积，得到的两个值就是答案。
en: Suppose you could split the array so the two targets land in different groups while equal numbers always stay together. Then each group has a single loner. What rule could split them that way?
XOR everything: pairs cancel, leaving the XOR of the two targets. It is nonzero, and any set bit marks a position where the targets differ. Group by that bit; equal numbers always share a group.

XOR everything to get a total. Use its lowest set bit as a mask. Walk the array, putting each number into one of two groups by its AND with the mask, and XOR within each group. The two results are the answer.

zh: 先数边：n 个点的树一定有多少条边？边数不对可以直接下结论；边数对了，图还可能在哪方面出问题？
边数恰为 n-1 时，“连通”和“无环”互相蕴含，只需检查其中一个。可以用并查集看有没有边连接了已经相通的两点，也可以从任一点出发遍历，看能否到达全部 n 个点。
先看边数是不是 n-1，不是就返回 false；然后用并查集逐条合并，若某条边两端已经在同一集合，说明有环，返回 false；都通过就是一棵树。
en: Count edges first: how many must a tree on n nodes have? A wrong count settles it at once. With the right count, what could still go wrong?

With exactly n-1 edges, being connected and being acyclic imply each other, so check just one. Union-find can spot an edge joining already-connected nodes; or traverse from any node and see if all n are reached.
If the edge count isn't n-1, return false. Then union edges one by one; if an edge's endpoints already share a set, there's a cycle, so return false. Otherwise it's a tree.

zh: 回文串从两端往中间看，是一对一对相同的字符。重新排列时，每个字符都要找到怎样的“搭档”？有没有可以不配对的位置？
除了正中间那一格，每个位置都要和对称位置放相同字符，所以字符必须两两配对，最多只能有一个字符落单。
用一个集合来回切换：字符第一次出现就加入，再出现就移除，相当于把配好的对子消掉。扫完后集合里最多剩一个字符就返回真；统计出现奇数次的字符有几种也一样。
en: Read a palindrome from both ends inward and you see pairs of equal characters. When rearranging, what partner does each character need? Is there any position that needs no partner?
Every position except the exact center must match its mirror, so characters must pair up, and at most one character can be left without a partner.
Toggle characters in a set: add on first sight, remove on the next, which cancels matched pairs. Return true if at most one remains. Counting how many characters have odd frequency works too.

zh: 先确认能不能组成回文：出现奇数次的字符最多允许几个？如果有这样的字符，它在每个结果里只能放在哪？
回文完全由左半边和中间字符决定。把每种字符取一半数量，问题就变成：这批字符能排出哪些不同的串？只要左半边不重复，得到的回文也不会重复。
统计频次，奇数次字符超过一个就返回空。按字符种类回溯构造左半边：每一步从剩余次数大于 0 的字符里挑一种，次数减一后递归，回来再加回；长度够了就拼上中间字符和左半边的反转。
en: First check feasibility: how many characters may occur an odd number of times? If there is one, where must it sit in every answer?

A palindrome is fixed by its left half plus the middle character. Take half of each count; the task becomes listing the distinct strings these characters form. Distinct halves give distinct palindromes.
Count chars; if more than one is odd, return empty. Backtrack over distinct characters: pick one with count left, decrement, recurse, restore. At full length, output half + middle + reversed half.

zh: 字典是排好序的，相邻两个单词的比较会透露字母之间的先后；把这些关系放在一起，就是一张依赖图。
相邻两个单词只看第一个不同的字母，它给出一条有向边，后面的字母不提供任何信息。如果前一个词更长、而后一个词恰好是它的前缀，输入就是非法的。
先把所有出现过的字母都加入图；逐对比较相邻单词建边、统计入度，遇到非法前缀返回空串；然后做拓扑排序，输出的字母数少于总数说明有环，也返回空串。
en: The list is sorted, so comparing adjacent words reveals which letters come first. Together these relations form a dependency graph.
For each adjacent pair, only the first differing letter yields an edge; later letters say nothing. If a longer word comes before its own prefix, the input is invalid.
Add every letter seen as a node. Compare adjacent pairs to add edges and in-degrees, returning empty on a bad prefix. Topologically sort; if fewer letters come out than exist, there's a cycle.

zh: 先看英语怎么念 100 以内的数：1 到 19 各有专门的词，20 以上才是“整十 + 个位”。小数字的读法理顺了，大数字只是它们的组合。
百位读作“几 Hundred”再接后两位；更大的数可以写成“高位部分 × 单位 + 余数”，单位依次是 Billion、Million、Thousand，高位部分和余数都按同一套规则递归去读。
准备 1 到 19、整十两张表。递归时：小于 20 查表，小于 100 拆成整十加个位，小于 1000 拆出百位，否则用最大的单位拆成商和余数分别递归再拼接，余数为 0 时不输出。n 为 0 单独返回 Zero。
en: Start with how English says numbers under 100: 1 to 19 each have their own word, and from 20 up it is a tens word plus a ones word. Once small numbers are right, big ones are just combinations.
Hundreds read as "X Hundred" plus the last two digits. Anything larger is "high part × scale + remainder" with scales Billion, Million, Thousand, and both parts follow the same rules recursively.

Keep tables for 1-19 and the tens. Recursively: under 20 look up, under 100 split tens and ones, under 1000 peel off hundreds, else split by the largest scale and recurse, skipping a zero remainder. 0 is Zero.

zh: 引用数已经升序排列。任取一篇论文，从它开始往后的每一篇引用数都不少于它。
在下标 i 处，从这里往后共有 n-i 篇论文。“这篇的引用数不少于剩余篇数”随 i 增大从不成立变为成立，是单调的；第一个成立的位置决定了 h。
在 0 到 n 之间二分第一个满足条件的下标，满足就收右边界，否则移左边界；返回 n 减去该下标，全都不满足时为 0。
en: Citations are sorted ascending. Pick any paper: every paper from it onward has at least that many citations.
At index i, n minus i papers remain from there on. "Citations at i are at least the papers remaining" flips from false to true as i grows, so it's monotonic; the first true index gives h.
Binary-search between 0 and n for the first index meeting the condition, shrinking hi when it holds and moving lo otherwise. Return n minus that index, which is 0 if none qualifies.

zh: 能用的“零件”只有 1、4、9、16 这些平方数，每个都能重复用。凑出 n 时，最后放进去的那个平方数可能是哪些？去掉它之后剩下的是什么问题？
定义“和为 i 时所需平方数的最少个数”，0 对应 0 个。和为 i 的最优解去掉最后一个平方数 s 后，剩下的 i-s 也必须是最优的。
先列出所有不超过 n 的平方数；i 从 1 推到 n，初始为一个较大值，枚举每个不超过 i 的平方数，用“减去它之后的最优值加 1”更新；返回 n 对应的值。
en: Your only building blocks are 1, 4, 9, 16 and so on, each reusable. When forming n, which square could be the last one added, and what problem is left once you remove it?
Let the state be the fewest squares summing to i, with 0 for i = 0. Removing the last square s from an optimal sum for i must leave an optimal sum for i - s.
List squares up to n. For i from 1 to n, start with a large value and, for each square not above i, update with the best for i minus that square, plus one. Return the value at n.

zh: 只含 +、-、* 的表达式，都可以看成若干个“乘积项”带着正负号相加。放一个加减号对这个结构意味着什么？放一个乘号又意味着什么？
加减号把当前项“封存”进总和，并开启一个新项（减号让新项带负号）；乘号只是把下一个数乘进当前项。所以递归时只需带两个数：已封存项的和，以及正在构造的当前项。
递归带上下标、表达式、已封存的和、当前项。从下标起截取下一个数（多位数不能以 0 开头）：第一个数直接作当前项；放加减号就封存当前项、新项为正负该数；放乘号就让当前项乘上它。到末尾时和加当前项等于目标就记录，用 64 位整数。
en: Any expression using only +, -, * is a signed sum of product terms. What does placing a + or - do to that structure, and what does placing a * do?

A + or - seals the current term into the total and starts a new one (negative for -); a * multiplies the next number into the current term. Recursion only needs two numbers: the sealed total and the term in progress.

Recurse on index, expression, sealed sum, current term. Take the next number (no leading zero if multi-digit): the first is the term; +/- seals it, starts anew; * multiplies it. At the end check sum + term; use 64-bit.

zh: 与其想着把零往后挪，不如反过来想：所有非零元素按原顺序排到前面之后，第 i 个非零元素应该落在哪个位置？
维护一个边界：边界左侧全是非零元素，并且保持原顺序。每扫到一个非零元素，就把它放到边界处。
用写指针扫描整个数组，把非零元素依次挪到前面；扫描结束后把写指针之后的位置全部填零。如果改成交换而不是复制，一趟就能完成。
en: Instead of pushing zeros back, flip it around: once all nonzero elements sit at the front in their original order, where should the i-th nonzero element end up?
Maintain a boundary: everything left of it is nonzero and in original order. Each nonzero element you scan goes right at that boundary.
Scan with a write index, moving each nonzero value forward. Afterwards fill every slot from the write index onward with zero. Swapping instead of copying does it in a single pass.

zh: 中序后继就是比 p 大的最小值。它要么在 p 的右子树里，要么在 p 上方的某个祖先处。
p 有右子树时，后继是右子树的最左节点；否则，它是从根走到 p 的路径上最后一次向左拐时所在的那个节点。
从根开始按大小往下找：当前值大于 p 时记为候选并往左走，否则往右走；走到空时，候选就是答案。这一套同时覆盖了有右子树的情况。
en: The inorder successor is the smallest value greater than p. It is either in p's right subtree or at some ancestor above p.
If p has a right subtree, the successor is its leftmost node; otherwise it is the node where the root-to-p path last turned left.
Descend from the root: when the current value exceeds p, record it as candidate and go left, otherwise go right; at null the candidate is the answer. This covers both cases.

zh: 每个房间要填的是到最近那扇门的距离，从每个房间分别去找门代价太高；换成从门这一侧出发试试。
把所有门同时当作起点做一次 BFS，某个房间第一次被访问到时的层数，就是它到最近门的距离，之后不会再变。
把所有门入队；出队时看四个邻居，若是还没填过的空房间，就写入当前距离加一并入队，墙和已填的格子直接跳过。
en: Each room needs its distance to the nearest gate. Searching from every room is wasteful, so try starting from the gates instead.
Run one BFS with all gates as sources. The level at which BFS first reaches a room is its final shortest distance.
Enqueue all gates. For each dequeued cell, check its four neighbors; if one is a still-empty room, set it to current distance plus one and enqueue it. Skip walls and filled cells.

zh: 不能改数组，也不能用额外空间。把每个下标看成节点，把 nums[i] 看成指向下一个节点的边，会得到什么结构？
从下标 0 出发沿边一直走，由于有两个下标指向同一个值，路径一定会进入一个环，而环的入口恰好就是重复的数。
快慢指针都从起点出发，慢的每次走一步，快的每次走两步，直到相遇。然后把其中一个放回起点，两者都改为每次走一步，再次相遇的位置就是重复数。
en: You can't modify the array or use extra space. Treat each index as a node and nums[i] as an edge to the next node. What structure do you get?
Walking from index 0, two indices point to the same value, so the path must enter a cycle, and the cycle's entry point is exactly the duplicate.
Move a slow pointer one step and a fast pointer two steps until they meet. Reset one to the start, move both one step at a time, and where they meet again is the duplicate.

zh: 模式里每个字母要对应一个非空子串，但长度事先不知道。当前字母该吃掉几个字符？如果猜错了，后面怎么办？
用回溯逐个尝试长度，同时维护双向约束：字母映射到哪个子串，哪些子串已被别的字母占用。字母已有映射就只检查字符串此处是否以它开头；没有映射才枚举还没被占用的前缀。
状态为模式下标和字符串下标，两者同时到末尾即成功；已映射的字母校验前缀后前进；未映射的枚举每个结束位置，子串未被占用就建立双向映射递归，失败则撤销。可用剩余长度剪枝。
en: Each pattern letter must match a nonempty substring whose length you don't know in advance. How many characters should the current letter take, and what if that guess turns out wrong?

Backtrack over lengths, enforcing both directions: letter to substring, and which substrings are taken. A mapped letter just checks the string continues with it; an unmapped one tries every free prefix.
State: pattern and string indices; succeed when both end. Mapped letter: verify prefix, advance. Unmapped: try each end; if the substring is free, map both ways, recurse, undo on failure.

zh: 中位数只和中间那一两个数有关。如果把数据分成较小的一半和较大的一半，只需要能快速拿到两半交界处的值。
较小一半放进大顶堆，较大一半放进小顶堆，并保持两个不变量：小半的每个数都不超过大半的每个数；两堆大小相等，或者小半多一个。
新数先放进大顶堆，再把大顶堆的堆顶移到小顶堆，保证顺序不变量；若小顶堆变得比大顶堆多，就移一个回去。总数为奇数时中位数是大顶堆堆顶，偶数时取两个堆顶的平均。
en: The median only cares about the middle one or two values. Split the data into a lower half and an upper half and you just need fast access to the values at the boundary.
Put the lower half in a max-heap and the upper half in a min-heap. Keep two invariants: every lower value is no larger than every upper value, and sizes are equal or the lower half has one extra.
Push each number into the max-heap, then move its top to the min-heap to keep order. If the min-heap grows larger, move one back. Odd count: median is the max-heap top; even: average the two tops.

zh: 只记录节点值的遍历序列不足以还原树，因为同一串值可能对应好几种形状；空孩子的位置必须也被编码进去。
用前序遍历输出每个节点，遇到空节点就写一个特殊标记。这样序列里每个位置要么是节点要么是空，反序列化时按同样的前序顺序依次消费，就能唯一还原。
序列化：递归前序遍历，节点写值、空写标记，用分隔符连起来。反序列化：先把字符串切成列表，用一个共享的读取位置递归：读到标记返回空，否则建节点，再依次构建左子树和右子树。
en: A traversal of values alone cannot rebuild the tree, since the same values fit several shapes. The positions of missing children must be encoded too.
Write a preorder traversal and emit a special marker for each null child. Every slot is then a node or a null, and reading back in the same preorder order rebuilds the tree uniquely.

Serialize: recursive preorder, writing values and null markers with a delimiter. Deserialize: split into tokens and recurse with a shared cursor; a marker returns null, else build the node, then its left and right.

zh: 假设有两条长度相同的递增子序列，一条以 5 结尾，一条以 3 结尾。之后再来新数字，哪一条更容易被接长？这说明对每种长度应该记住什么？
对每个长度 L，只记录“长度为 L 的递增子序列能拥有的最小末尾”。这些最小末尾随 L 严格递增，所以来一个新数时，可以用二分查找决定它该更新哪个长度。
依次读入每个数：在这组最小末尾里二分找第一个不小于它的位置，找到就替换，找不到就追加到最后；遍历结束后，记录的个数就是答案，但这组数本身不一定是一条真实的子序列。
en: Say two increasing subsequences have the same length, one ending in 5 and one in 3. When new numbers arrive, which is easier to extend? What does that suggest you remember for each length?
For each length L, keep only the smallest possible tail of an increasing subsequence of length L. These tails strictly increase with L, so binary search tells you which length a new number updates.

For each number, binary search the tails for the first entry ≥ it; replace that entry, or append if none exists. The final count is the answer, though the tails themselves need not form a real subsequence.

zh: 先别急着搜索，扫一遍就能算出至少要删几个左括号、几个右括号；有了这个最少删除数，搜索范围会小得多。
扫描时维护平衡计数：遇到右括号却没有可配对的左括号，就必须删一个右括号；扫描结束时剩下未配对的左括号数，就是必须删的左括号数。之后只允许删这么多。
先算出两种删除配额；从下标 0 递归尝试删除，只在配额内删，并且一串相同括号只从本层第一个开始删，避免重复；配额用完后检查剩余串是否合法，合法就放入结果集合。
en: Before searching, one scan tells you the minimum number of opens and closes to remove. That budget shrinks the search enormously.
Scan with a balance: a close with nothing to match forces one close removal; opens still unmatched at the end must be removed. The search may delete exactly those amounts.
Compute both budgets. Recurse over positions, deleting only within budget, and in a run of identical brackets delete only the first per level. When budgets hit zero, keep the string if valid.

zh: 卖出后的第二天不能买。那么只用“今天持股 / 不持股”描述状态还够吗？今天能不能买，还取决于什么？
设三个状态：持股、今天刚卖出、空仓且可以买。今天买入只能从昨天就已可买的状态转入，不能从昨天刚卖出直接转入。
持股初始为负的首日价格，其余为 0；每天用昨天的三个值同时算出今天的：持股来自继续持有或从可买状态买入，刚卖出来自昨天持股卖掉，可买来自昨天可买或昨天刚卖出；返回两个不持股状态的较大值。
en: After a sale you can't buy the next day. Is "holding or not" still enough of a state, or does whether you may buy today depend on something more?
Use three states: holding, just sold today, and idle (free to buy). Buying today must come from yesterday's idle state, never straight from yesterday's just-sold state.

Start hold at −price[0], the rest at 0. Each day, from yesterday's values: hold = keep or buy from idle; sold = sell from hold; idle = stay idle or come off cooldown. Return the larger non-holding state.

zh: 以某个点为根时，树高就是它到最远叶子的距离。直觉上，好的根不该在边缘，而应该在靠中间的位置。
最小高度树的根就是树上最长路径的中点，所以答案最多只有 2 个。可以像剥洋葱一样一圈圈去掉叶子，最后剩下的就是中心。
统计每个点的度数，把度为 1 的叶子入队；每轮删掉当前所有叶子，把邻居度数减一，变成 1 的作为下一轮叶子。剩余节点不超过 2 个时停止并返回它们，n 为 1 时直接返回 [0]。
en: Rooted at a node, the tree's height is its distance to the farthest leaf. Intuitively, good roots shouldn't sit on the edge but somewhere in the middle.
The best roots are the middle of the tree's longest path, so there are at most 2. Peel leaves off layer by layer like an onion; what remains is the center.

Compute degrees and queue all degree-1 leaves. Each round, remove every current leaf and decrement its neighbors' degrees, queuing new leaves. Stop when at most 2 nodes remain and return them; for n=1 return [0].

zh: 先戳哪个气球会改变邻居关系，子问题就缠在一起了。反过来想：如果某个气球是区间里最后一个被戳的，戳它时左右邻居是谁？
两端各补一个值为 1 的虚拟气球。设 B[i][j] 为只戳开区间 (i, j) 内所有气球的最大收益。若 k 最后戳，此时它的邻居正好是 i 和 j，左右两段互不影响。
补好两端；按区间长度从小到大枚举 (i, j)，再枚举其中每个 k 作为最后戳破的气球，收益为两侧子区间的值加上 i、k、j 三者乘积，取最大；返回最外层区间的值。
en: Choosing which balloon to pop first scrambles neighbors and tangles subproblems. Flip it: if a balloon is the last one popped in a range, who are its neighbors then?
Pad both ends with a 1. Let B[i][j] be the best coins from popping everything strictly between i and j. If k goes last, its neighbors are exactly i and j, and the two sides are independent.
Pad the array. For ranges by increasing length, try each inner k as the last pop: left value + right value + the product of i, k, j; keep the max. Return the outermost range.

zh: 同一列的节点要从上到下、同一行再从左到右排列。想想普通的递归遍历为什么会弄错：它可能先走到较深的节点，再回头访问同一列里更浅的节点。
给节点标横向坐标：向左一步减一，向右一步加一。按层访问时，节点天然按“先上后下、同层先左后右”出现，所以按访问顺序把值追加到所在列即可，无需再排序。
队列里同时放节点和它的列号，出队时把值追加到哈希表中该列的列表，再把孩子连同列号减一、加一入队；记录出现过的最小和最大列号，最后从小到大逐列输出。
en: Within a column, nodes go top to bottom, then left to right in the same row. Why can a plain recursive traversal get this wrong? It may reach a deep node before a shallower one in the same column.

Label horizontal positions: -1 for a left step, +1 for a right step. Level-order traversal already yields nodes top to bottom and left to right, so appending each value to its column in visit order needs no sorting.

Queue nodes with their column. On dequeue, append the value to that column's list in a hash map and enqueue children with column -1 and +1. Track the min and max column, then output columns from min to max.

zh: 每个字母必须恰好保留一次，但保留哪一次出现会影响字典序。想想什么时候可以放心地放弃一个已经选下的字母。
已选序列末尾的字母如果比当前字母大，而且后面还会再出现，就可以先撤掉它、留到以后再选；如果后面不再出现，就必须留着。已经在序列里的字母再遇到时直接跳过。
先记下每个字母最后出现的位置；从左到右扫描，已在结果里的跳过；否则只要结果末尾比当前字母大且后面还有它，就移除末尾并取消标记；然后加入当前字母并打上标记。
en: Each letter must appear exactly once, but which occurrence you keep changes the lexicographic order. Think about when it is safe to give up a letter you already picked.
If the last picked letter is larger than the current one and appears again later, you can drop it and pick it later; if it never appears again, it must stay. Skip letters already picked.

Record each letter's last index. Scan left to right, skipping letters already used. Otherwise, while the last letter is larger and reappears later, remove and unmark it. Then append and mark the current letter.

zh: 每个字符要么保留，要么被缩写成数字；麻烦在于相邻被省略的字符必须合并成一个数，而不能写成 11 这样拆开的形式。
递归时额外带一个“当前连续省略了几个字符”的计数：选择省略就让计数加一；选择保留时，先把非零的计数写出来，再写这个字符，并把计数清零。
从下标 0、计数 0、空前缀开始：到末尾时补上非零计数再记录；否则分两支：省略当前字符、计数加一递归；或先写出计数再写当前字符、计数归零递归。
en: Each character is either kept or abbreviated. The catch: adjacent abbreviated characters must merge into one number, not be written as separate digits.
Carry a count of consecutive skipped characters. Skipping increments it; keeping a character first writes any nonzero count, then the character, and resets the count.
Recurse from index 0 with count 0 and an empty prefix. At the end, append a nonzero count and record. Else branch: skip (count + 1), or write the count, then the char, reset to 0.

zh: 凑出金额 x 时，最后一枚硬币可以是任意面值 c，剩下要解决的就是凑出 x-c，这是同类型的更小问题。
定义“凑出金额 i 的最少硬币数”：金额 0 需要 0 枚，其余先设为不可达（比如一个比任何真实答案都大的数）。每种硬币可以无限使用，所以按金额从小到大计算即可。
建一个长度为 amount+1 的数组，下标 0 为 0，其余为不可达；金额从 1 推到 amount，对每个不超过当前金额的面值，用“剩余金额的最优值加 1”更新最小值；最后仍不可达就返回 -1。
en: The last coin used to make amount x can be any denomination c, leaving x - c to make: the same problem, only smaller.
Let the state be the fewest coins for amount i: 0 for amount 0, unreachable (a value above any real answer) elsewhere. Coins are unlimited, so compute amounts in increasing order.
Make an array of size amount+1, 0 at index 0, unreachable elsewhere. For each amount and each coin not above it, minimize with the remainder's best plus one. Return -1 if still unreachable.

zh: 先看极端情况：一条边都没有时，答案就是 n。之后每加入一条边，连通块的数量会怎样变化？什么情况下它不变？
一开始把 n 个节点看成 n 个独立集合，每当一条边连起两个原本不同的集合，连通块数就少一个。
初始化并查集，计数设为 n；遍历每条边，找到两端的根，不同就合并并把计数减一。处理完所有边后返回计数。也可以建邻接表逐个 DFS 来数。
en: Start from the extreme: with no edges the answer is n. As each edge is added, how does the number of components change, and when does it stay the same?
Start with n separate sets. Every time an edge joins two different sets, the component count drops by one.
Initialize union-find with count n. For each edge, find both roots; if they differ, union them and decrement the count. Return the count. DFS over an adjacency list also works.

zh: 要求严格的“小、大、小、大”交错。如果能把数组分成“较小的一半”和“较大的一半”，你会怎么摆放它们？
真正的陷阱是等于中位数的元素不能相邻。把两半都按从大到小的顺序交错放置，可以把中位数的副本尽量推到两端，避免碰头。
简单做法：排序后取前一半和后一半，各自从大到小，前一半依次填偶数位，后一半依次填奇数位。进阶做法：用快速选择找中位数，再配合虚拟下标映射做三路划分，达到线性时间。
en: You need a strict small, big, small, big pattern. If you could split the array into a smaller half and a larger half, how would you place them?
The trap is that copies of the median must not end up adjacent. Interleaving both halves in descending order pushes those copies apart.

Simple: sort, then fill even slots from the lower half and odd slots from the upper half, each taken from largest to smallest. Advanced: quickselect the median, then three-way partition with virtual indices.

zh: 这里的奇偶指的是节点位置，不是节点的值。题目要求 O(1) 额外空间，能不能不新建节点，只靠改动 next 指针完成重排？
同时维护奇数链的尾和偶数链的尾，并记住偶数链的头；两条链交替向前生长，最后把奇数链的尾接到偶数链的头，偶数链的尾必须指向空。
奇尾设为头，偶尾和偶头都设为第二个节点；当偶尾和它的下一个都存在时：奇尾连到偶尾的下一个并前移，偶尾再连到奇尾的下一个并前移；最后让奇尾接上偶头。
en: Odd and even refer to positions, not values. With O(1) extra space, can you rearrange the list purely by rewiring next pointers, without creating nodes?
Track the tail of the odd chain and the tail of the even chain, and remember the even head. Grow both alternately, then attach the even head after the odd tail; the even tail must end in null.

Set the odd tail to head and the even tail and even head to the second node. While the even tail and its next exist, link each tail past the other and advance it. Finally join the odd tail to the even head.

zh: 路径要求严格递增，所以不可能绕回走过的格子，图里也不存在环；这意味着从某个格子出发的最长路径是一个确定的值。
设某格的结果为从它出发的最长递增路径长度，它只取决于比它大的邻居的结果；每格算一次就缓存，之后直接复用。
对每个格子做带缓存的 DFS：已经算过就直接返回；否则在四个邻居里挑比它大的递归，取最长的再加一并存下。所有格子的结果取最大。
en: Strict increase means a path can never return to a cell, so there are no cycles. The longest path starting from a given cell is a fixed value.
Let each cell's value be the longest increasing path starting there. It depends only on strictly larger neighbors, so compute it once and cache it.
Memoized DFS from every cell: if cached, return it; otherwise recurse into larger neighbors, take the best, add one, and store it. The answer is the max over all cells.

zh: 不需要找出具体的三元组，只需判断是否存在。扫描时记住什么信息，能让后面出现第三个数的机会最大？
维护两个值：目前见过的最小数，以及所有“长度为 2 的递增对”里最小的那个结尾。这两个值越小，后面越容易接上。
逐个扫描：不大于最小值就更新最小值；否则不大于第二个值就更新第二个值；否则它比两者都大，直接返回真。更新最小值并不会破坏之前已经形成的递增对。
en: You only need to know whether a triplet exists. What should you remember while scanning to give a future third element the best chance?
Track two values: the smallest number so far, and the smallest ending value of any increasing pair seen so far. The smaller they are, the easier they are to extend.

For each number: if it's at most the first value, update it; else if it's at most the second, update that; otherwise it beats both, so return true. Updating the first value never breaks a pair already found.

zh: 两个单词拼起来是回文，意味着一个单词的一部分恰好是另一个单词的反转，而多出来的那部分自己必须是回文。
把单词切成左右两段：左段是回文且右段反转后在词表里，那么那个词放在前面就能拼成回文；右段是回文时对称处理。哈希表存单词，查询是常数时间。
建立“单词→下标”的哈希表；对每个单词枚举所有切分点（含空的左段或右段），按两种情况查表并排除自己与自己配对；整词切分会被两种情况各算一次，注意去重。
en: If two words concatenate into a palindrome, part of one word mirrors the other word exactly, and the leftover part must be a palindrome on its own.

Split a word into left and right. If left is a palindrome and reversed right is in the list, that word goes before this one; handle a palindromic right side symmetrically. A hash map gives O(1) lookups.
Map each word to its index. For every word, try every split, including empty parts, and check both cases. Skip pairing a word with itself and don't count the full-word split twice.

zh: 树上的选择会互相牵制：父节点被偷，它的孩子就都不能偷。如果每个子树只返回一个最大值，父节点没法据此做决定。
让每个节点返回两个数：偷这个节点时子树的最大收益，以及不偷它时的最大收益。偷它，孩子只能用“不偷”的结果；不偷它，每个孩子可以自由取两者中较大的。
后序遍历，空节点返回两个 0。拿到左右孩子的两组结果后，算出本节点“偷”和“不偷”两个值并向上返回。根节点两值取较大者即为答案。
en: Choices on the tree constrain each other: robbing a parent forbids robbing its children. A single best value per subtree does not tell the parent enough to decide.
Have each node return two numbers: the best loot if it is robbed and if it is not. Robbing it forces both children into their not-robbed values; skipping it lets each child take its better value.

Do a postorder traversal where a null node returns two zeros. Combine the children's pairs into this node's robbed and skipped values and pass them up. The answer is the larger of the root's two values.

zh: 一个数的二进制和比它小的某个数联系很紧密，比如去掉一位以后，就变成了一个已经算过的数。
把 i 右移一位得到 i/2，它的 1 的个数已经算过；i 的个数就是它再加上 i 的最低位。也可以用“清掉最低位 1 之后的那个数的结果再加一”。
建一个长度为 n+1 的数组，第 0 项为 0。从 1 到 n 依次用某个更小下标的已知结果，加上当前数的最低位（或加一）填进去，最后返回整个数组。总时间 O(n)。
en: A number's binary form is closely tied to some smaller number: drop one bit and you get a value already computed.
Shifting i right by one gives i/2, whose count is known; add i's lowest bit to get i's count. Alternatively, take the count of i with its lowest set bit cleared and add one.
Make an array of size n+1 with entry 0 set to 0. For i from 1 to n, fill it from a smaller index's known count plus the lowest bit (or plus one). Return the array. Total O(n).

zh: 窗口缩小时，里面不同字符的种类数只会减少或不变。这种单调性对寻找“种类不超过 k 的最长子串”有什么帮助？
用滑动窗口，同时维护窗口内各字符的频次和种类数，两者必须一致：频次从 0 变 1 时种类加一，从 1 变 0 时种类减一。k 为 0 时答案是 0。
右指针加入字符，更新频次和种类数；种类数超过 k 时持续移出左端字符并同步更新，直到不超过 k；每步用窗口长度刷新最大值。
en: Shrinking a window can only keep or reduce its number of distinct characters. How does that monotonicity help find the longest substring with at most k distinct?
Use a sliding window with per-character counts and a distinct-type count kept in sync: a count going from 0 to 1 adds a type, from 1 to 0 removes one. If k is 0, the answer is 0.
Add the right character and update counts and types. While types exceed k, remove the left character and update both. Refresh the maximum window length after each step.

zh: 从 n 中拆出一部分 j 后，剩下的 n-j 有两种选择：保持不拆，或继续往下拆；两种情况都要考虑。
定义“把 i 拆成至少两个正整数后的最大乘积”。拆出 j 后，剩余部分的贡献取它本身和它的最优拆分值中较大的那个，因为“至少拆一次”只约束整体。
i 从 2 推到 n：对每个 i 枚举第一段 j，用 j 乘以“剩余数本身与其最优值中较大者”更新答案。观察结果会发现尽量多拆出 3 最划算，这正是数学解法的来源。
en: After splitting off a part j, the remainder n-j can either stay whole or be split further. Consider both.
Let the state be the best product from splitting i into at least two parts. After taking j, the remainder contributes the larger of itself and its own best, since only the whole must be split.
For i from 2 to n, try every first part j and update with j times the larger of the remainder or its best value. You'll notice cutting as many 3s as possible wins: the math shortcut.

zh: 要求原地修改，只能用常数额外空间。反转之后，第一个字符和最后一个字符的位置是什么关系？
第 i 个字符和倒数第 i 个字符互换位置。两个指针从两端向中间靠拢，交换到相遇时，整个字符串就反转完了。
左指针放在开头，右指针放在末尾。只要左指针在右指针左边，就交换两处的字符，然后左指针右移、右指针左移。长度为奇数时，中间那个字符不用动。
en: You must work in place with constant space. After reversing, how are the first and last characters related?
The i-th character swaps with the i-th from the end. Two pointers moving inward from both ends finish the job when they meet.

Put a left pointer at the start and a right pointer at the end. While left is before right, swap their characters, then move left forward and right backward. With odd length, the middle character stays put.

zh: 只有元音参与反转，其他字符位置不变。可以想象把元音单独拎出来倒序，再放回原来的位置。
两个指针从两端向中间走，各自跳过非元音字符；两边都停在元音上时交换它们，这样就不用额外存储元音序列。
左指针向右找元音，右指针向左找元音，过程中始终保证左在右的左边。交换两个元音后各走一步，重复直到相遇。别忘了大写元音也算。
en: Only vowels get reversed; everything else stays put. Picture pulling the vowels out, reversing them, and putting them back.
Move two pointers inward, each skipping non-vowels. When both rest on vowels, swap them, so you never need to store the vowel sequence.
Advance the left pointer to a vowel and retreat the right pointer to a vowel, keeping left before right. Swap, step both once, and repeat until they meet. Don't forget uppercase vowels.

zh: 结果要保留重复次数：一个数在两边分别出现 a 次和 b 次，它在结果里应该出现几次？
记录较短数组中每个值还剩几次可用，另一个数组每命中一次就消耗一次。如果两个数组已排序，也可以用双指针同步前进。
统计第一个数组各值的出现次数。扫描第二个数组，当前值剩余次数大于零就放进结果并减一。排序做法：两指针比较，小的一方前进，相等则记录并同时前进。
en: The answer keeps multiplicity: if a value appears a times in one array and b times in the other, how many times should it appear in the result?
Track how many copies of each value are still available from the smaller array; each match in the other array uses one up. With sorted input, two pointers work too.
Count frequencies in the first array. Scan the second; if the value's count is positive, add it and decrement. Sorted version: advance the smaller side, and on equality record it and advance both.

zh: 两个维度都必须严格更大才能套进去。如果先按其中一维排好序，问题在另一维上会变成什么？
按宽度升序排后，只需在高度上找严格递增子序列。但同宽的信封不能互套，所以同宽时按高度降序排，它们就不可能同时出现在一条递增序列里。
按宽度升序、同宽高度降序排序；取出高度序列；用最小末尾数组加二分求最长严格递增子序列的长度，这就是答案。
en: Both dimensions must be strictly larger to nest. If you sort by one dimension first, what does the problem become in the other?
Sort by width ascending, then look for a strictly increasing run of heights. Equal widths can't nest, so break ties by height descending; then two same-width envelopes can never both appear.
Sort by width up, height down on ties. Extract the heights. Run the tails-array-plus-binary-search LIS with strict increase; its length is the answer.

zh: 只关心最近 300 秒内的敲击，更早的记录都可以丢掉。时间戳单调不减，所以过期的数据总是排在最前面。
一种做法是用队列存时间戳，查询时从队头弹掉不在最近 300 秒内的记录。另一种是用 300 个环形桶，每个桶记一个秒数和计数，同一秒的多次敲击只累加计数，内存固定。
环形桶写法：hit 时取时间对 300 取模的桶，若桶里记的秒数不是当前时间就重置为当前时间、计数为 1，否则计数加一。getHits 累加所有“与查询时间相差小于 300 秒”的桶的计数。
en: Only hits from the last 300 seconds matter, so older ones can be discarded. Timestamps never decrease, so expired data always sits at the front.
Either queue timestamps and drop expired ones from the front on each query, or use 300 circular buckets each storing a second and a count, so many hits in one second just bump a counter.

Bucket version: on hit, take bucket time mod 300; if its stored second differs, reset it to this second with count 1, else increment. getHits sums counts of buckets whose second is less than 300 before the query time.

zh: 把数排好序后，两两整除的集合会变成一条链：每个数都能整除它后面的数。这让你想到哪种子序列问题？
整除有传递性：a 整除 b、b 整除 c，那么 a 也整除 c。所以只需保证相邻两项整除。设 f[i] 为以 nums[i] 为最大元素的最长链，并记下前驱下标。
排序；对每个 i 枚举更小的 j，若 nums[j] 整除 nums[i] 且能让链更长，就更新 f[i] 和前驱；找出 f 最大的位置，沿前驱指针往回走，把元素收集起来。
en: Once sorted, a pairwise-divisible set becomes a chain where each element divides the next. Which subsequence problem does that look like?
Divisibility is transitive: if a divides b and b divides c, a divides c. So only adjacent links matter. Let f[i] be the longest chain ending at nums[i], and remember its predecessor.
Sort. For each i, scan smaller j; if nums[j] divides nums[i] and gives a longer chain, update f[i] and its predecessor. Start at the best index and follow predecessors back to collect the set.

zh: 设想把最终数组相邻两项的差值记下来。一次“给整段区间加同一个值”的更新，会让这些差值里的几个发生变化？
这就是差分数组：在左端点记“从这里开始多了 inc”，在右端点下一位记“从这里起取消”。对所有标记做前缀和，就能还原每个位置的真实值。
准备一个比结果多一位的差分数组；每次更新只改两个端点；全部处理完后做一遍前缀累加，截取前 length 个返回。
en: Imagine recording the differences between adjacent entries of the final array. How many of those differences does one "add a value to a range" update actually change?
This is a difference array: mark "start adding inc" at the left end and "stop" just past the right end. A prefix sum over the marks recovers each position's real value.
Create a difference array one slot longer than needed. Apply two endpoint updates per operation. After all of them, take a running sum and return the first length values.

zh: 二进制加法在每一位上都可以拆成两部分：不考虑进位时这一位的结果，以及要送到更高一位的进位。
不进位的和可以用按位异或得到，进位是按位与之后左移一位。把这两部分相加，正好回到原问题的形式；反复进行，直到进位变成 0。
只要进位不为 0 就重复：算出新的不进位和与新的进位，替换原来的两个数。Python 的整数没有固定位宽，每一步都要和 32 位掩码相与，最后若结果超过有符号上限，再换算回负数。
en: Binary addition splits at each bit into two parts: the bit you get ignoring carries, and the carry passed to the next higher bit.
The carry-free sum is a bitwise XOR, and the carries are a bitwise AND shifted left by one. Adding those two is the same problem again, so repeat until the carry is 0.

While the carry is nonzero, compute the new carry-free sum and new carry and replace the pair. Python ints are unbounded, so mask to 32 bits each step and convert back to negative if the result exceeds the signed max.

zh: 两个数组都有序，所以最小的和一定来自两个数组的开头。取走一个配对之后，下一个最小的和只可能藏在哪些配对里？没必要把所有配对都算出来。
固定 nums1 的一个元素、依次配 nums2 的元素，和是递增的，于是问题变成合并多条有序链。小顶堆里只放每条链当前最小的候选，弹出一个就补上同一条链的下一个。
先把 nums1 的前若干个元素（不超过 k 个）各自和 nums2 的第一个元素配对，放入按和排序的小顶堆；重复 k 次：弹出最小配对计入答案，若它在 nums2 中还有下一个元素，就把下一个配对入堆。
en: Both arrays are sorted, so the smallest sum uses both first elements. Once you take a pair, where can the next smallest sum possibly hide? There is no need to generate every pair.

Fix one element of nums1 and walk through nums2: the sums increase, so you are merging several sorted lists. A min-heap holds each list's current candidate; after popping one, push the next from the same list.

Pair each of the first min(k, len) elements of nums1 with nums2's first element and push them into a min-heap by sum. Repeat k times: pop the smallest, record it, and push its successor in nums2 if any.

zh: 猜错后，剩下的候选仍是一段连续的数；而要“保证”赢，就得假设答案总落在让你多花钱的那一边。猜大的数本身更贵，所以正中间未必是最好的猜法。
设 cost(l, r) 为在区间 [l, r] 内保证猜中所需的最少钱。猜 x 要先付 x，之后最坏会落入左右两段中更贵的那一段；对所有 x 取最小，就是极小化极大。
空区间和只有一个数的区间花费为 0。按区间长度从小到大填表：枚举区间里每个可能的猜测，算出它的价格加上左右两段较大的花费，取所有猜测中的最小值。答案是 [1, n] 的值。
en: After a wrong guess the candidates still form a contiguous range, and guaranteeing a win means assuming the answer always lands on the costlier side. Bigger guesses cost more, so the middle is not always best.
Let cost(l, r) be the least money that guarantees a win within [l, r]. Guessing x costs x and then the worse of the two sides; minimizing that over x is the minimax step.

Empty and single-number ranges cost 0. Fill ranges by increasing length: for each guess inside, take its price plus the larger side cost, and keep the minimum over guesses. Return the value for [1, n].

zh: 题目里顺序不同就算不同方案，所以你其实在数有序序列。不妨想想：序列的最后一个数是谁？
设 f[t] 为和恰好为 t 的序列个数。任何这样的序列去掉最后一个数，就得到一个和更小的序列，所以 f[t] 只依赖比 t 小的值。
f[0] 设为 1；目标和从 1 递增到 target，对每个 t 枚举每个数字作为最后一项，不超过 t 就把剩余和的方案数累加进来；注意中间值可能溢出。
en: Different orders count as different answers, so you are really counting ordered sequences. Think about which number comes last.
Let f[t] be the number of sequences summing to exactly t. Dropping the last element of any such sequence leaves one with a smaller sum, so f[t] depends only on smaller totals.
Set f[0]=1. For t from 1 to target, try every number as the final element; if it fits, add the count for the remaining sum. Guard against intermediate overflow.

zh: 答案一定落在左上角和右下角两个值之间。如果随便给你一个值 x，能不能快速数出矩阵里有多少个数不超过它？
不超过 x 的个数随 x 单调不减，所以可以在值域上二分。计数时从左下角出发向右或向上走，线性时间完成。第一个使个数达到 k 的 x 就是答案，它一定是矩阵中的值。
在左上角和右下角的值之间二分；对中点用左下角走法计数，个数不少于 k 就收右边界，否则移左边界；相遇时的值即答案。用小根堆做多路归并也行，但更慢。
en: The answer lies between the top-left and bottom-right values. Given any value x, can you quickly count how many entries are at most x?

Counts of entries at most x never shrink as x grows, so binary-search on values. Count in linear time from the bottom-left, moving right or up. The first x reaching k is the answer, always a matrix value.
Binary-search between the top-left and bottom-right values. Count for mid with the corner walk; if at least k, move hi to mid, otherwise move lo past it. A min-heap merge also works but is slower.

zh: 要等概率随机返回一个元素，按下标随机访问数组最方便；问题在于数组中间删除很慢，得想办法让删除总发生在末尾。
用哈希表记录每个值在数组中的下标。删除时，把数组最后一个元素搬到被删元素的位置并更新它的下标，再弹出末尾，数组就始终保持紧凑。
insert 时值已存在就返回 false，否则追加到数组尾并记录下标。remove 时值不存在返回 false，否则用末尾元素覆盖目标位置、修正它的下标、弹出末尾并删掉目标的映射。getRandom 随机取一个下标返回。
en: Uniform random picks are easiest with an array and a random index. The catch is that deleting from the middle of an array is slow, so arrange for deletions to happen at the end.
Map each value to its index in the array. To delete, move the last element into the deleted slot, update its index, then pop the end so the array stays compact.

insert: if present return false, else append and record its index. remove: if absent return false, else copy the last element into the slot, fix its index, pop, and drop the entry. getRandom picks a random index.

zh: 想让随机抽中的概率与出现次数成正比，最省事的是把每个副本都单独放进数组。难点在删除：同一个值占着好几个位置，怎样快速找到其中一个并把它移走？
每个值不再对应一个下标，而是对应一个下标集合。删除时从该值的集合中任取一个下标，把数组末尾元素挪过来，并同步修改末尾那个值的下标集合。
insert 把值追加到数组，并把新下标加入该值的集合，返回加入前集合是否为空。remove 从该值集合中取出一个下标 i；若 i 不是末尾，就把末尾元素放到 i，并在末尾值的集合里把旧末尾下标换成 i；最后弹出末尾。
en: To make picks proportional to multiplicity, store every copy as its own array entry. The hard part is removal: a value occupies several positions, so how do you find one fast and take it out?
Each value now maps to a set of indices rather than one index. To remove, take any index of that value, move the array's last element there, and update the last value's index set to match.

insert appends and adds the new index to the value's set, returning whether the set was empty. remove takes some index i from the set; if i isn't last, move the last element to i and swap its old index for i. Then pop.

zh: 方括号可以嵌套，内层必须先解码完，外层才能拿它去重复。遇到左括号相当于进入新的一层，遇到右括号相当于回到上一层。
进入新一层时，要把外层已经拼好的前缀和这一层的重复次数暂存起来；回到外层时，用暂存的次数重复内层结果，再接到暂存的前缀后面。
扫描时累积多位数字和当前字符串；遇左括号把（当前串，次数）暂存并清空两者；遇右括号取出暂存项，把当前串重复相应次数后接在旧串后面；字母直接追加。
en: Brackets can nest, and an inner part must be fully decoded before the outer part repeats it. An opening bracket means entering a new level; a closing one means returning.
When entering a level, save the outer prefix built so far and this level's repeat count. When returning, repeat the inner result that many times and append it to the saved prefix.
Accumulate a multi-digit number and the current string. On "[", save (string, count) and reset both; on "]", restore the pair and append the repeated current string; letters just append.

zh: 直接滑窗会卡住：窗口变长时，某个字符可能从不足 k 次变成满足 k 次，合法性并不随窗口长度单调变化。
两条路：一是某字符在整个串里出现不足 k 次，就不可能出现在答案中，可以以它为界分治；二是固定窗口里“恰好几种字符”，加上这个限制后窗口重新变得单调。
分治：统计当前串的频次，找出不足 k 次的字符；若没有，整串即答案；否则以这些字符为界切开，对每段递归取最大值。枚举法：种类数从 1 到 26 各跑一遍滑窗。
en: A plain sliding window stalls: as a window grows, a character can go from under k to reaching k, so validity isn't monotone in the window size.
Two fixes: a letter appearing fewer than k times overall can't be in the answer, so split around it; or fix exactly how many distinct letters a window may hold, which restores monotonicity.
Divide and conquer: count letters; if none falls short of k, return the length; otherwise split at the short letters, recurse and keep the max. Or run one window per distinct count from 1 to 26.

zh: 假如每个变量都能写成某个共同“参照变量”的若干倍，任意两个变量的比值就能直接算出。哪些变量能共用一个参照，哪些之间根本没有关系？
已知等式把变量分成若干组，同组内可以层层换算，跨组的查询无解。带权并查集正好合适：每个变量记录自己是父节点的几倍，找根时把沿途的倍数乘起来。
对等式 a/b=k，分别找到两者的根及相对根的倍数，根不同就合并，并按 k 算好两根之间的比例。查询时变量没出现过或根不同返回 -1，否则答案是两者相对根的倍数之比。建图后带着乘积 DFS 也可以。
en: Suppose every variable were written as a multiple of one shared reference variable; any ratio would then be immediate. Which variables can share a reference, and which have no relation at all?

Equations split variables into groups: ratios chain within a group; cross-group queries have no answer. Weighted union-find fits: each variable stores its ratio to its parent, multiplied along the way to the root.

For a/b=k, find each variable's root and ratio to it; if roots differ, merge them with the ratio implied by k. Query: an unknown variable or different roots gives -1, else divide the two ratios. Graph DFS works too.

zh: 两个等长的数比较大小，看的是第一个不同的位。所以让高位变小，比让后面任何一位变小都重要得多。
从左往右看，只要某一位比它后面那一位大，删掉它就能让结果变小。保留下来的数字应尽量从左到右不降，删除次数没用完前不要放过任何下降点。
逐位扫描：还有删除次数且当前数字小于已保留的最后一位时，就删掉那一位并重复；然后保留当前数字。扫完若次数还有剩，就从末尾删。最后去掉前导零，空结果返回“0”。
en: Two numbers of equal length compare at their first differing digit, so making a high digit smaller matters far more than anything to its right.
