Scanning left to right, whenever a digit is larger than the next one, deleting it shrinks the result. Kept digits should be non-decreasing; never skip such a drop while deletions remain.
For each digit: while deletions remain and it is smaller than the last kept digit, remove that digit; then keep it. Spend leftover deletions on the tail, strip leading zeros, and return "0" if empty.

zh: 只知道青蛙站在哪块石头上还不够：下一跳能跳多远，取决于它是用多长的一跳到达这里的。
把状态定义为（石头位置，到达这里的上一跳长度）。每个状态只能扩展出三种新步长：比原来少一、相同、多一。用集合记录每块石头上出现过的步长即可去重。
用哈希表把每块石头映射到一个步长集合，起点放入 0。按位置顺序遍历石头，对每个已有步长尝试三种新步长（必须为正），落点是石头就把新步长加入落点集合。最后看终点的集合是否非空。
en: Knowing which stone the frog is on is not enough: how far it can jump next depends on the length of the jump that got it there.
Make the state (stone, last jump length). Each state branches into only three next lengths: one shorter, the same, or one longer. A set of lengths per stone removes duplicate states.

Map each stone to a set of arrival lengths, seeding the start with 0. Visit stones in order; try the three positive next lengths from each and add them to any stone you land on. Check the last stone's set.

zh: 一个节点是不是“左叶子”，光看它自己判断不出来，还得知道它是父节点的哪一个孩子。
站在父节点上判断：如果它的左孩子存在且没有任何孩子，就把左孩子的值计入；否则继续往下递归。也可以在递归时往下传一个“我是不是左孩子”的标记。
递归：节点为空返回零；若左孩子是叶子就取它的值，否则递归左子树；再加上递归右子树得到的结果；返回总和。
en: Whether a node is a left leaf can't be decided from the node alone; you also need to know which child of its parent it is.
Decide from the parent: if its left child exists and has no children, count that value; otherwise recurse. Or pass a flag down saying whether the current node is a left child.
Recurse: null gives 0. If the left child is a leaf, take its value; otherwise recurse into the left subtree. Add the result of recursing into the right subtree and return the sum.

zh: 回文串左右对称，两侧的字符必须成对出现。正中间那个位置有什么特别之处？
每种字符能贡献的长度，是它出现次数中能凑成对的部分；只要有任何一种字符剩下单个，就可以放一个在正中间。
统计每个字符的出现次数。对每个次数，累加不超过它的最大偶数。如果存在出现奇数次的字符，最后再加一。注意大写和小写算不同的字符。
en: A palindrome mirrors around its center, so characters on the two sides come in pairs. What's special about the very middle?
Each character contributes the paired part of its count; if any character has a single copy left over, one of them can sit in the middle.
Count every character. Add the largest even number not exceeding each count. If any count is odd, add one at the end. Uppercase and lowercase are different characters.

zh: 枚举所有分法根本行不通。换个问法：如果规定每段和不超过某个上限，最少要分成几段？
给定上限时，从左往右尽量往当前段里塞，超了就开新段，这样得到的段数最少。上限越大段数越少，因此可以在最大元素到总和之间二分上限。
在最大元素到总和之间二分上限；对中点贪心地数段，段数不超过 k 就收右边界，否则移左边界；相遇处就是答案。
en: Enumerating all splits is hopeless. Reframe: if each part's sum may not exceed some limit, how few parts can you get away with?
For a given limit, greedily extend the current part left to right and start a new one when it would overflow; this yields the fewest parts. Larger limits need fewer parts, so binary-search the limit.
Binary-search between the largest element and the total sum. For mid, count greedy parts; if at most k, move hi to mid, otherwise move lo past it. They meet at the answer.

zh: 两个子集和相等，就意味着每一半都正好是总和的一半。总和是奇数时可以直接下结论。
问题变成：能否挑出若干个数，和恰好等于总和的一半，每个数最多用一次。用一个布尔数组记录目前哪些和能被凑出来。
先求总和，奇数直接返回否；可达集合起初只有 0；逐个处理数字，和从目标往下扫，若当前和减去该数可达，就标记当前和可达；最后看目标是否可达。
en: Equal halves means each subset must sum to exactly half the total. An odd total settles it immediately.
Now ask: can some subset hit half the total, using each number at most once? Keep a boolean per sum saying whether it's reachable so far.
If the total is odd, return false. Mark sum 0 reachable. For each number, scan sums from the target down; mark s reachable if s minus the number was. Return whether the target is reachable.

zh: 从每个格子出发模拟水往低处流，会重复搜索大量路径。能不能换个出发点，让搜索次数只和海洋的数量有关，而不是和格子数量有关？
从海洋边界出发，逆着水流往内陆走，只能走向高度不低于当前格的邻居。一个格子能流进某片海洋，等价于从这片海洋的边界逆向能走到它。
分别从太平洋一侧（上边、左边）和大西洋一侧（下边、右边）做逆向搜索，各得到一张可达标记，两张都标到的格子就是答案。
en: Simulating water flowing downhill from every cell repeats a lot of work. Could you pick different starting points so the number of searches depends on the oceans, not on the cells?
Start at an ocean's border and walk against the flow, stepping only to neighbors at least as high. A cell drains into an ocean iff that ocean's border can reach it this way.
Run one reverse search from the Pacific edges (top, left) and one from the Atlantic edges (bottom, right). Return the cells marked by both.

zh: 一个窗口能不能变成全是同一个字母，只取决于除了出现最多的那个字母以外，还有多少个其他字符。
需要替换的次数就是窗口里“不是最多那个字母”的字符数，不超过 k 即合法。答案只会在最高频次创新高时变大，所以收缩窗口时这个最高频次不必回退。
维护 26 个字母的频次和历史最高频次；右指针加入字符并更新；若需要替换的数量超过 k，左指针右移一步并减少对应计数；过程中窗口长度的最大值就是答案。
en: Whether a window can become a single repeated letter depends only on how many characters are not its most frequent letter.

Replacements needed are the characters other than the top letter, and the window is valid while that is at most k. The answer only grows when the top count hits a new high, so it need not drop on shrink.
Keep 26 counts and the highest count seen. Add the right character. If the replacements needed exceed k, move the left pointer one step and decrement. The largest window seen is the answer.

zh: 二叉搜索树的哪种遍历恰好按从小到大访问节点？要原地转换，节点已有的左右指针可以分别充当什么角色？
中序遍历时维护“上一个访问的节点”，把它和当前节点双向连接；同时记住第一个访问到的节点作为头。
中序遍历：有上一个节点就互相连上，没有则当前节点就是头；然后把上一个节点更新为当前节点。遍历结束后，把头和最后一个节点首尾相连。空树直接返回空。
en: Which BST traversal visits nodes in ascending order? For an in-place conversion, what roles could each node's existing left and right pointers take on?
During inorder keep the previously visited node and link it with the current one in both directions; also remember the first visited node as the head.
Inorder: link prev and current both ways if prev exists, else mark current as head; then set prev to current. Afterward connect head and the last node. Empty tree returns null.

zh: 遇到带 child 的节点时，要先把整条子链走完，再回到原来的下一个节点。这种“先深入、再回来”的顺序像哪种遍历？
本质是深度优先：展开某个节点的子链时，记住它原来的 next，等子链（可能还有更多层）展平后，把子链的尾和这个 next 双向连好，并把 child 清空。
从头遍历；遇到有 child 的节点：记下原来的 next，把 child 接为它的 next 并设好 prev，child 清空；找到展平后子链的尾，把它和记下的 next 双向连接；继续往后走直到末尾。
en: When a node has a child, you finish the whole child list before returning to the original next. What traversal does that "go deep, then come back" order remind you of?
It's depth-first: when expanding a child, remember the original next; once the child list (possibly multi-level) is flattened, link its tail and that next both ways, and clear child.

Walk from head. At a node with a child: save its next, make the child its next with the right prev, clear child; find the tail of the flattened child list and link it to the saved next both ways. Keep walking.

zh: 每次操作只让某个键的计数加一或减一，所以这个键只会移动到“相邻”计数的分组里，不会跳很远。
用双向链表把计数桶串起来，按计数升序排列，每个桶装着计数相同的键；再用哈希表把键映射到它所在的桶。最小键在头桶里，最大键在尾桶里。
inc 时找到键所在的桶（新键视为在头桶之前），若后一个桶的计数不是加一后的值，就新建一个插在中间，再把键挪过去；dec 同理向前挪，减到 0 就删除该键。空桶从链表摘除。最大、最小键分别从尾桶、头桶任取。
en: Each operation changes one key's count by exactly one, so the key only ever moves to an adjacent count group.
Chain count buckets in a doubly linked list sorted ascending, each holding the keys with that count, plus a map from key to bucket. The min key lives in the head bucket and the max in the tail.

inc finds the key's bucket (a new key starts before the head), creates the next-count bucket beside it if missing, and moves the key. dec moves it back or deletes at 0. Unlink empty buckets. Max/min read tail/head.

zh: 每次只能改一个字符，而且每一步得到的串都必须在基因库里。把每个合法基因看成一个点，“最少变化次数”在这张图上对应什么？
这是无权图上的最短路，用 BFS。基因只有 8 位、每位 4 种字符，一个串最多 24 个候选邻居；只保留在基因库里且还没访问过的即可。
把 bank 放进集合，end 不在其中就返回 -1；从 start 开始逐层 BFS，每一位尝试换成另外三种字母，合法且未访问就入队，到达 end 返回层数，否则返回 -1。
en: You change one character at a time, and every intermediate string must be in the bank. If each valid gene is a node, what does "fewest mutations" correspond to in that graph?
That is a shortest path in an unweighted graph, so use BFS. Genes have 8 positions with 4 letters, so each has at most 24 candidate neighbors; keep those in the bank and not yet visited.
Put bank in a set; if end is missing, return -1. BFS by levels from start, swapping each position to the other three letters; enqueue valid unvisited ones and return the level at end, else -1.

zh: 删得最少，就是留下得最多。如果要从所有区间里先挑一个留下，挑哪一个对剩下的选择限制最小？
每次优先保留结束最早的区间，它给后面留出的空间最大，这样贪心不会更差。注意端点相接不算重叠。
按终点排序，记录上一个保留区间的终点；遍历时起点不小于它就保留并更新终点，否则删除计数加一；返回删除数。
en: Removing the fewest means keeping the most. If you had to pick the first interval to keep, which one restricts the remaining choices the least?
Always keep the interval that finishes earliest; it leaves the most room for the rest, so the greedy choice is never worse. Intervals that only touch at endpoints don't overlap.
Sort by end and track the last kept end. If the next start is at least that end, keep it and update; otherwise count a removal. Return the removal count.

zh: 路径可以从任意节点开始、在任意节点结束，只要一路向下。站在当前节点回看从根到它的这条链，哪些起点能让这一段的和恰好等于目标？
设根到当前节点的前缀和为 s，祖先中每个前缀和等于 s 减目标值的位置，都对应一条以当前节点结尾的合法路径。用哈希表记录前缀和出现次数。
哈希表先放入前缀和 0 出现一次；DFS 时累加前缀和，查表把次数加到答案，再把当前前缀和计数加一；递归完孩子后计数减一，免得影响别的分支。
en: A path may start and end at any node as long as it goes downward. Looking back along the chain from the root to the current node, which starting points make that segment sum to the target?
If the root-to-node prefix sum is s, each ancestor position with prefix sum s minus target gives a valid path ending here. Keep a hash map of prefix-sum counts.
Seed the map with sum 0 once; in DFS update the running sum, add its lookup count to the answer, increment the current sum, recurse, then decrement before returning.

zh: 异位词只看用了哪些字母、各几个，不看顺序。而且长度固定，所以只需检查 s 中每个和 p 等长的窗口。
字母只有 26 个。维护窗口频次与 p 频次的差，或者记录“频次已经对上的字母种数”；一个字符进出只会影响一种字母，更新是常数时间。
统计 p 的字母频次；在 s 上滑动与 p 等长的窗口，每次加入右端字符、移出左端字符并更新差值或匹配数；所有字母都对上时记录窗口起点。
en: Anagrams care only about which letters appear and how often, not order. Their length is fixed, so you only need to check each length-|p| window of s.
With 26 letters, track the difference between window and p counts, or the number of letters whose counts already agree; a character entering or leaving affects only one letter.
Count p's letters. Slide a length-|p| window over s, adding the right character and dropping the left one while updating the differences. Record the start whenever all letters agree.

zh: 值域是 1 到 n，每个数最多出现两次。能不能让每个值在数组里“认领”一个专属位置？
访问值 v 时，看下标 v-1 处的符号：已经是负的，说明之前见过 v，它就是重复数；否则把它翻成负数作为标记。
遍历数组，对每个元素取绝对值得到 v，检查第 v-1 位：是负数就把 v 加入答案，是正数就把它改成负数。一遍扫描即可，不需要额外空间。
en: Values are in 1..n and each appears at most twice. Can each value claim its own slot in the array?
When you see value v, check the sign at index v-1: if it's already negative, you've met v before, so it's a duplicate; otherwise flip it negative as a mark.
Walk the array, take each element's absolute value v, and look at slot v-1: if negative, record v; if positive, negate it. One pass, no extra space.

zh: 数字按高位在前存储，可加法必须从最低位算起，而单链表没法倒着走。怎样才能按从低到高的顺序取出各位数字？
把两条链的数字分别压进栈，弹出的顺序就是从低位到高位；每个新结果节点都插在结果链的最前面，输出就自然是高位在前。
遍历两条链，把值分别压栈；进位设为零，结果头设为空；任一栈非空或还有进位时：各弹出一个数（栈空记零）加上进位，新建节点存个位并指向当前结果头，更新结果头和进位；返回结果头。
en: Digits are stored most significant first, but addition starts from the least significant, and a singly linked list cannot be walked backward. How can you get the digits from lowest to highest?
Push each list's digits onto its own stack; popping then yields the lowest digits first. Prepend each new result node, so the answer comes out most-significant first naturally.

Push both lists' values onto two stacks. Starting with carry 0 and an empty result, while a stack is non-empty or carry remains: pop digits (0 if empty), add carry, prepend a node with the ones digit, update carry.

zh: 长度为 n 的数组装着 1 到 n 的数，缺了几个值就必然多出几个重复。不开额外数组的话，怎样在“看到了值 v”时留下记号，同时不弄丢那个位置原来存的数？
看到值 v 时，就把下标 v-1 处的数变成负数，表示 v 出现过。因为只改了符号，原来的值仍能通过取绝对值读出来。
第一遍：对每个元素取绝对值得到 v，把第 v-1 位标成负数（已经是负数就不动）。第二遍：仍为正数的位置 i 说明 i+1 没出现过，把它们收集起来。
en: A length-n array of values 1..n has exactly as many extra copies as missing values. Without an extra array, how could seeing value v leave a mark somewhere without losing the number stored there?
When you see value v, make the entry at index v-1 negative to mean "v appeared". Only the sign changes, so the original value is still readable via absolute value.
Pass one: take each element's absolute value v and mark slot v-1 negative if it isn't already. Pass two: any slot i still positive means i+1 never appeared; collect those.

zh: 二叉搜索树的形状完全由节点值的大小关系决定，所以不需要像普通二叉树那样把空节点也写进去。
只存前序遍历的值。还原时给每棵子树带上允许的取值范围：当前值落在范围内就属于这棵子树，否则说明这棵子树已经结束，交回上一层处理。
序列化输出前序值列表。反序列化时维护一个读取指针，递归函数带着上下界：指针越界或当前值不在界内就返回空；否则用它建根，构建左子树时上界改为根值，构建右子树时下界改为根值。
en: A BST's shape is fixed by how its values compare, so unlike a general tree you don't need to record null children.
Store only the preorder values. When rebuilding, give each subtree an allowed value range: the next value belongs here if it fits, otherwise this subtree is done and control returns to the caller.

Serialize as the preorder list. Deserialize with a cursor and bounded recursion: return null if tokens run out or the value is out of range; else make a node, build left with it as upper bound, right as lower.

zh: 先像查找一样找到要删的节点，难点在于删掉后怎样用剩下的节点补位，同时保持有序。
没有孩子就直接删；只有一个孩子就让孩子顶上来；有两个孩子时，用右子树中的最小节点（或左子树最大节点）替代它，这个替身最多只有一个孩子。
递归返回删除后的子树根：值更小往左、更大往右，并更新对应指针；找到后按孩子数量分情况处理，两个孩子时把后继的值换上来，再到右子树里删掉那个后继。
en: First locate the node like a search; the hard part is filling the gap afterward while keeping the order.
No children: just remove it. One child: let the child take its place. Two children: replace it with the right subtree's minimum (or left's maximum), which has at most one child.
Recurse returning the new subtree root: go left or right and reassign that pointer; when found, handle by child count; with two, copy the successor's value up and delete it from the right subtree.

zh: 一支箭能射爆一组气球，当且仅当这些区间有公共点。
按右端点排序后，第一支箭射在最早的右端点上最划算：所有起点不超过这里的气球都会被一起射爆。端点重合也算相交。
按右端点排序，第一支箭放在首个右端点；往后扫，遇到起点大于当前箭位的气球就再加一支箭，箭位更新为它的右端点。排序比较时别用相减，以免溢出。
en: One arrow bursts a group of balloons exactly when their intervals share a common point.
Sort by right end. Shooting at the earliest right end is optimal: every balloon starting at or before it bursts too. Touching endpoints count as overlapping.
Sort by right end and fire at the first. Scan on; when a balloon starts after the current arrow, add one at its right end. Compare values directly instead of subtracting, to avoid overflow.

zh: 四重循环是 n 的四次方。四个数组可以怎么分成两组，让一组只需要去另一组“查表”？
先把前两个数组所有配对和各出现几次存下来，再枚举后两个数组的配对和，看它的相反数出现过几次。复杂度就降到了平方级。
双重循环统计 A、B 每种和出现的次数，放进哈希表。再双重循环枚举 C、D 的和，把哈希表里它的相反数对应的次数累加到答案。注意加的是次数，而不是加一。
en: Four nested loops cost n to the fourth. How can you split the four arrays into two groups so that one group just looks up the other?
Store how often each pair sum from the first two arrays occurs, then for each pair sum from the last two, look up how often its negation occurred. That drops the cost to quadratic.
Loop over A and B to count each pair sum in a hash map. Loop over C and D, and for each sum add the stored count of its negation to the answer. Add the count, not just one.

zh: 一块饼干最多给一个孩子，目标是满足尽可能多的人。想想哪个孩子最容易满足，以及该给他多大的饼干才不浪费。
胃口最小的孩子最好满足，给他刚好够的最小饼干最划算：拿更大的饼干喂他，不会让后面的匹配变得更好。
把胃口和饼干都升序排序；用两个指针，当前饼干能满足当前孩子就两者都前进并计数，否则只把饼干指针后移去找更大的。任一方用完就结束，计数即答案。
en: Each cookie goes to at most one child, and you want to satisfy as many children as possible. Which child is easiest to satisfy, and what cookie size avoids waste?
The least greedy child is easiest; giving them the smallest cookie that is big enough is never worse, since a bigger cookie spent on them can't help later matches.
Sort greed factors and cookie sizes ascending. With two pointers, if the cookie satisfies the child, advance both and count; otherwise advance only the cookie. Stop when either runs out.

zh: 直接枚举三个位置太慢。换个思路：固定“1”的位置，它右边需要出现什么样的结构？在所有可选的“2”里，哪一个对你最有利？
从右往左扫时，用单调栈保存还没遇到更大左邻的数；当前数比栈顶大时弹出栈顶，被弹出的数就是一个合格的“2”（当前数是它的“3”），只需记住其中最大的。
从右往左遍历：当前数小于记录的最佳“2”，就说明存在；否则把栈里比当前数小的都弹出并更新最佳“2”，再把当前数压栈。扫完仍没找到就不存在。
en: Trying every triple is too slow. Fix where the "1" sits instead: what must appear to its right, and among all candidate "2"s, which one helps you most?
Scanning right to left, keep a monotonic stack of values not yet beaten by a larger value on their left. When the current value beats the top, the popped value is a valid "2"; remember the largest.
Go right to left: if the current value is below the best "2", return true. Otherwise pop all smaller stack values, updating the best "2", then push the current value. If the scan ends, return false.

zh: 如果字符串由某个子串重复多次构成，把整个串循环移动这个子串的长度，得到的结果和原串一模一样。
原串的所有循环移位，都能在“两份原串首尾相接”的长串里找到。所以只要看原串能否在开头和结尾以外的位置出现。KMP 的前缀函数也能直接给出最小周期。
做法一：拼接两份原串，去掉第一个和最后一个字符，查找原串是否出现。做法二：用前缀函数求出整串的最长相等前后缀长度 b，若 b 大于 0 且 n−b 能整除 n，就返回真。
en: If a string is some substring repeated several times, rotating it by that substring's length gives back exactly the same string.
Every rotation of s appears inside s + s, so check whether s occurs there at some offset other than the very start and end. KMP's prefix function also yields the smallest period directly.

Option A: double the string, trim one character from each end, and search for the original. Option B: get the longest border length b from the prefix function; return true if b > 0 and n − b divides n.

zh: 淘汰规则有两层：先比使用次数，次数相同再比谁最久没被用过。要做到 O(1)，你得能马上找到“使用次数最少的那批键里最旧的一个”。
维护三样东西：键到（值，频次）的映射、频次到按访问顺序排列的键集合的映射，以及当前最小频次。只有当键从最小频次桶移走且该桶变空时，最小频次才加一；插入新键时它重置为 1。
访问一个键时，把它从旧频次桶删掉，频次加一后放到新桶末尾，必要时更新最小频次。put 新键前若已满，从最小频次桶的最前面淘汰一个，再以频次 1 插入。容量为 0 时直接忽略 put。
en: Eviction has two tiers: fewest uses first, then least recent among ties. For O(1), you must instantly find the oldest key among those with the fewest uses.
Keep a key-to-(value, freq) map, a freq-to-ordered-keys map, and the current minimum freq. The minimum rises only when a key leaves the min bucket and empties it; inserting a new key resets it to 1.

On access, move the key from its bucket to the end of the next-frequency bucket and fix the minimum. For a new key at capacity, evict the oldest key in the min bucket, then insert at freq 1. Capacity 0: ignore puts.

zh: 周长只和陆地格子的边有关：每条边要么挨着另一块陆地，要么朝向水或网格外面。
每块陆地本来有 4 条边，和相邻陆地共用的那条边在内部，不算周长；越出网格和挨着水一样，都算露在外面的边。
遍历所有陆地格，检查上下左右四个方向，邻居越界或是水就给周长加一，全部累加起来就是答案。
en: The perimeter depends only on cell edges: each side of a land cell either touches another land cell or faces water or the outside.
Each land cell starts with 4 sides; any side shared with neighboring land is internal and doesn't count. Off-grid counts as exposed, just like water.
Scan every land cell, check its four neighbors, add one for each neighbor that is water or off the grid, and sum it all up.

zh: 每个字符串要么选要么不选，而且同时消耗两种资源：0 的个数和 1 的个数。这像哪类经典问题？
设 best[i][j] 为最多用 i 个 0、j 个 1 时能选的最多字符串数。每个串只能用一次，所以更新时两个维度都要从大往小扫。
先统计每个串的 0 和 1 个数；表格初始全为 0；对每个串，i、j 都从上限倒序扫到它的需求量，比较不选它和选它（剩余容量的值加一）；返回 best[m][n]。
en: Each string is taken or skipped, and it spends two budgets at once: zeros and ones. Which classic problem does that resemble?
Let best[i][j] be the most strings selectable with at most i zeros and j ones. Each string is single-use, so both dimensions are updated from high to low.
Count zeros and ones per string. Start a zero table. For each string, loop i and j downward to its counts, taking the better of skipping it or 1 + the value at the leftover budget. Return best[m][n].

zh: 双方每次只能从两端拿，所以无论怎么拿，剩下的永远是原数组的一段连续区间，可以用区间的左右端点来描述子问题。
不要分别记录两人的得分，而是记录“轮到的人在这段区间上最多能比对手多拿多少”。拿走一端后，对手在剩余区间上的最优净胜分，正是你要扣掉的部分。
长度为 1 的区间，净胜分就是那个数。按长度从小到大处理区间：比较“拿左端，再减去剩余区间的净胜分”和“拿右端，再减去剩余区间的净胜分”，取较大者。整段的值不小于 0 时先手获胜。
en: Players only take from the ends, so whatever happens the remaining numbers are always a contiguous subarray, described by its two endpoints.
Instead of tracking both scores, store how much more the player to move can get than the opponent on a subarray. After you take an end, the opponent's best margin on the rest is what you subtract.

A length-1 range's margin is its single value. By increasing length, take the better of left end minus the margin of the rest, or right end minus the margin of the rest. Player 1 wins if the full margin is at least 0.

zh: 球一旦滚起来就不会中途停下，真正能做选择的只有它停住的位置，途中经过的格子并不重要。
把每个停止点当作图的节点：从一个停止点朝四个方向各滚到撞墙为止，就得到最多四条出边；再用访问集合避免重复。
从起点开始 BFS 或 DFS；对每个停止点，沿四个方向一直滚到下一步会撞墙，得到新的停止点，未访问就加入。碰到终点返回 true，搜完返回 false。
en: Once the ball rolls it can't stop midway, so the only places where choices happen are where it comes to rest. Cells passed over don't matter.
Treat each stopping position as a node. Rolling in each of four directions until hitting a wall gives up to four edges; track visited stops.
BFS/DFS from the start. For each stop, roll each way until the next step is a wall to get a new stop; add it if unvisited. Return true at the destination, false when done.

zh: 答案要保持原数组的顺序，所以不能先排序再去重。想一想：两个相同的值在什么情况下会生成一模一样的子序列？
用回溯，每层从起点往后挑下一个元素，要求不小于路径末尾；同时用一个集合记下本层已经试过的值，同值再次出现就跳过。这个集合只属于当前层，不能跨层共用。
从下标 0 递归，路径长度至少为 2 时记录；新建本层集合，从起点往后遍历：比路径末尾小或已在集合中就跳过，否则放入集合、加入路径、从下一个下标递归、撤销路径。
en: Answers must keep the original order, so you can't sort first and dedupe afterwards. Ask yourself: when do two equal values end up producing the very same subsequence?
Backtrack: each level picks the next element from start onward, at least the path's last value. Keep a per-level set of values already tried and skip repeats; never share it across levels.
Recurse from 0, recording paths of length 2+. With a fresh set, loop from start: skip values below the path's tail or already seen; else add to the set, append, recurse from the next index, pop.

zh: 每个数要么带正号要么带负号，数组就被分成了正号一堆、负号一堆。这两堆的和与总和、target 之间有什么关系？
设正号那堆的和为 P，它减去另一堆的和等于 target，而两堆加起来是总和，所以 P 是个定值。问题变成数和恰好为 P 的子集个数，0 会自然让方案翻倍。
若总和加 target 为奇数，或 target 绝对值超过总和，答案为 0；算出 P；做 0/1 背包计数：和为 0 的方案数为 1，逐个数字倒序更新；返回和为 P 的方案数。
en: Each number gets + or −, so the array splits into a plus group and a minus group. How do their sums relate to the total and the target?
If P is the plus-group sum, P minus the other group equals target, and both groups add to the total, so P is fixed. Count subsets summing to P; zeros naturally double the count.
If total+target is odd or |target| > total, return 0. Compute P. Run a 0/1 counting knapsack: count[0]=1, then for each number update sums downward. Return the count at P.

zh: nums1 只是一组查询，真正要算的是 nums2 里每个数右边第一个比它大的数。先把这些都算好，再按值查表即可。
从右往左看，一旦遇到值 x，它右边所有不超过 x 的数对更左边的元素都没用了，因为 x 更近而且不比它们小。于是保留下来的候选越远越大。
从右往左扫 nums2：先丢掉所有不大于当前值的候选，剩下最近的那个就是答案（没有则为 -1），记入哈希表后再把当前值加入候选。最后按 nums1 查表。
en: nums1 is only a list of queries; the real work is finding, for each value in nums2, the first larger value to its right. Precompute those, then answer by lookup.
Scanning from the right, once you see x, any value to its right that is at most x is useless to elements further left, since x is closer and no smaller. Survivors grow with distance.
Scan nums2 right to left: discard candidates not larger than the current value; the nearest survivor is its answer, or -1. Store it in a map, then add the current value. Answer nums1 from the map.

zh: 资本只增不减，所以现在能启动的项目以后也永远能启动。在这个前提下，每一轮应该怎么选？
每轮都在“当前资本能启动的项目”里挑利润最大的，这样做是最优的；关键是随着资本增长，把新解锁的项目逐步加入候选，而不是每轮重新扫描全部项目。
把项目按资本门槛排序；做 k 轮：用指针把门槛不超过当前资本的项目利润都压进最大堆；堆为空就提前结束；否则弹出最大利润加到资本上。
en: Capital never decreases, so any project you can afford now stays affordable forever. Given that, how should you choose in each round?
Each round, taking the most profitable affordable project is optimal. The trick is to add newly unlocked projects incrementally as capital grows instead of rescanning everything.
Sort projects by required capital. Repeat k times: push profits of all newly affordable projects into a max-heap; if it's empty, stop; else pop the max profit and add it to capital.

zh: 数组首尾相连后，一个元素的下一个更大值可能在它左边，要绕一圈才遇到。想想怎样不真的复制数组，也能看到绕回来的那部分。
任何元素最多往后看 n−1 个位置，所以把数组顺序走两遍就足以覆盖所有绕回的情况；第二遍只负责给第一遍遗留的元素结算。
下标走两轮，用取模得到实际位置；维护一个存下标、值单调不增的等待栈，当前值更大就弹出并填答案；只在第一轮把下标压栈。从未被结算的记为 -1。
en: In a circular array, an element's next greater value may lie to its left, reached only after wrapping around. How can you see the wrapped part without copying the array?
Any element needs to look at most n-1 positions ahead, so walking the array twice covers every wrap. The second pass only settles elements left pending from the first.

Iterate over two passes, using modulo for the real position. Keep pending indices with non-increasing values; pop and fill answers while the current value is larger. Push only in pass one; default -1.

zh: 球只会在撞墙后停下，所以值得关注的位置只有这些停止点。题目要的是最短滚动距离，而每次滚动经过的格数各不相同，这会带来什么影响？
把停止点当作节点，每条边的长度等于这次滚过的格数。边权不相等时，BFS 的层数并不代表距离，要用 Dijkstra：总是先扩展累计距离最小的停止点。
用小根堆按距离取出停止点，若已有更短记录就跳过；朝四个方向滚到底并数格数，新距离更短就更新并入堆。终点第一次出堆时返回距离，否则返回 -1。
en: The ball stops only at walls, so the positions that matter are its stopping points. You want the shortest rolling distance, yet each roll covers a different number of cells. What does that change?
Treat stops as nodes, each edge weighted by the cells rolled. With unequal weights, BFS levels don't reflect distance; use Dijkstra and always expand the stop with the smallest total so far.
Pop stops from a min-heap by distance, skipping stale entries. Roll each way to the wall counting cells; if the new total is better, record and push it. Return it when the destination pops, else -1.

zh: 直接按定义递归时，同一个 F(k) 会被反复计算很多次，画出递归树就能看到大量重复的子树。
每一项只依赖前两项，所以把算过的结果存下来就不用重算；更进一步，计算第 i 项时只需要前两项，不必保留整张表。
先处理 n 为 0 和 1 的情况；用两个变量保存前两项，从 2 循环到 n，每次算出新值后让两个变量向前滑动一位，最后返回较新的那个。
en: Plain recursion recomputes the same F(k) many times; draw the call tree and you'll see whole subtrees repeated.
Each term depends only on the two before it, so caching removes the repeats. Better still, you only ever need the last two values, not a full table.
Handle n = 0 and n = 1. Keep two variables for the last two terms, loop from 2 to n computing the next and sliding both forward, then return the newer one.

zh: 要的是最深一层里最靠左的节点，跟节点值大小无关，关键在于遍历顺序和深度。
层序遍历时，每层第一个出队的就是该层最左节点；如果每层改成先右后左入队，那么最后一个出队的节点就是答案。
按层遍历，每开始新的一层就记下这一层的第一个节点，遍历结束时最后记下的值即为所求。DFS 也行：先左后右，只在深度严格变大时更新。
en: You want the leftmost node on the deepest level; its value doesn't matter, only depth and traversal order do.
In level-order traversal the first node of each level is its leftmost; if you enqueue the right child before the left, the very last node dequeued is the answer.
Traverse level by level and record the first node of each level; the last recorded value wins. Or DFS left-first, updating only when depth strictly increases.

zh: 子序列不要求连续，单靠中心扩展不行。看一个区间的左右两端：相等时怎么用它们？不等时必须放弃谁？
设 P[i][j] 为 s[i..j] 中最长回文子序列的长度。两端相等就一起纳入，再看内部区间；不等就去掉左端或右端，取较优。
单个字符的区间值为 1；按区间长度从短到长（或 i 从后往前、j 从前往后）填表：两端相等取内部加二，否则取去掉一端后的较大值；返回整串对应的格子。
en: Subsequences needn't be contiguous, so center expansion won't do. Look at a range's two ends: how do you use them if they match, and which one must go if they don't?
Let P[i][j] be the longest palindromic subsequence in s[i..j]. Matching ends both join and rely on the inner range; otherwise drop the left or right end and keep the better.
Single chars are 1. Fill by increasing range length (or i descending, j ascending): match → inner + 2, else the max of dropping one end. Return the full-string cell.

zh: 这里只关心用了哪些硬币，不关心顺序，{1,2} 和 {2,1} 算同一种。怎样枚举才能让每组硬币只被数一次？
设 ways[a] 为只用已处理过的硬币凑出 a 的方法数。每种硬币可以无限用，所以处理某种硬币时金额要从小往大推，让它能在同一轮里叠加自己。
ways[0] 设为 1；外层依次拿出每种硬币，内层金额从该面值递增到目标，把去掉这枚硬币后的方法数加到当前金额上；最后读出目标金额的值。
en: Order doesn't matter here: {1,2} and {2,1} are the same way. How can you enumerate so each multiset of coins is counted once?
Let ways[a] count how to reach a using only the coins processed so far. Coins are unlimited, so sweep amounts upward within one coin so it can stack on itself.
Set ways[0]=1. For each coin in turn, sweep amounts from that coin's value up to the target, adding the count for amount minus the coin. Return ways[target].

zh: 子数组和可以写成两个前缀和的差，而“是 k 的倍数”只和除以 k 的余数有关。
两个前缀和余数相同，夹在中间那段的和就是 k 的倍数。每个余数只记最早出现的下标，区间才最长；别忘了余数 0 预先放在下标 -1。
边扫边维护前缀余数：若该余数出现过且与记录下标相差至少 2，返回 true；没出现过才记下当前下标，已有就不覆盖。扫完返回 false。
en: A subarray sum is the difference of two prefix sums, and being a multiple of k only depends on remainders mod k.
If two prefix sums share a remainder, the stretch between them sums to a multiple of k. Keep only the earliest index per remainder so it is as long as possible; seed remainder 0 at index -1.
Scan with a running remainder. If it was seen before and the stored index is at least two back, return true; if unseen, store the current index. Return false at the end.

zh: “0 和 1 个数相等”能否转化成一个关于“和”的条件？想想怎样给 0 和 1 赋值，能让平衡区间的和恰好为 0。
把 0 记作 −1、1 记作 +1，平衡区间就是两端前缀和相等的区间。要最长，就让每个前缀和只记住它第一次出现的位置。
哈希表先记录前缀和 0 出现在下标 −1；遍历时累加 ±1；若当前前缀和已在表里，用当前下标减去最早位置更新答案；否则把当前下标记为它的首次位置。
en: Can "equal numbers of 0s and 1s" be restated as a condition on a sum? Think about what values to give 0 and 1 so that a balanced range sums to zero.
Count each 0 as −1 and each 1 as +1; a balanced range then has equal prefix sums at its two ends. For the longest one, remember only the first index where each prefix sum appears.
Map prefix sum 0 to index −1. Walk the array updating the running sum; if it was seen before, update the answer with the current index minus the stored one; otherwise store the index.

zh: 任意两个值之间的最小差，一定出现在排序后相邻的两个值之间，而 BST 的中序遍历正好给出有序序列。
中序遍历时只需记住上一个访问的值，用当前值减去它来更新答案，用不着把整个序列存下来。
用一个“前驱”变量，初始表示还没有前驱（别用 0 代替，0 可能是合法值）；中序访问每个节点时，有前驱就更新最小差，然后把前驱设为当前值。
en: The minimum difference between any two values occurs between neighbors in sorted order, and BST inorder gives that order.
During inorder you only need the previously visited value; subtract it from the current one to update the answer without storing the sequence.
Keep a predecessor initialized to none (not 0, since 0 can be a real value); at each inorder visit, update the min difference if a predecessor exists, then set it to the current value.

zh: 每个节点的新值是所有不小于它的值之和。如果能按从大到小的顺序访问节点，这个和就能一路累积下来。
把中序遍历反过来，先右、再根、再左，访问顺序就是降序；用一个累加变量记录已访问值的总和。
准备一个从零开始的全局累加值；按右、根、左的顺序遍历，访问节点时先把它的值加进累加值，再把节点值改成累加值。
en: Each node's new value is the sum of all values not smaller than it. If you visit nodes from largest to smallest, that sum builds up naturally.
Reverse inorder (right, node, left) visits in descending order; a single running total holds the sum of values seen so far.
Keep a running total starting at zero; traverse right, node, left; at each node add its value to the total and then overwrite the node with the total.

zh: 在单一元素出现之前，每对相同元素都从偶数下标开始；越过它之后，这个规律就错开了一位。
只检查偶数下标：它和下一个元素相等，说明单一元素还在右边；否则单一元素就在这里或更左。这个判定是单调的。
二分时把中点调整为偶数；与后一个元素相等就把左边界移到中点加二，否则右边界收到中点；左右相遇处就是答案。
en: Before the single element, every pair starts at an even index; past it, that pattern shifts by one.
Check only even indices: if one equals the next element, the single element lies further right; otherwise it is here or to the left. That test is monotonic.
Binary-search, nudging mid to an even index. If it equals the next element, move lo to mid plus two; otherwise move hi to mid. Where lo and hi meet is the answer.

zh: 从每个 1 各自出发去找最近的 0，会把同一片区域反复搜很多遍。如果反过来，从 0 那一侧看这个问题，会不会更省事？
把所有 0 同时作为起点入队、距离为 0，也就是多源 BFS；BFS 第一次到达某个格子时，当前层数就是它到最近 0 的距离。
把所有 0 入队，其余格子标为未访问；依次出队，把未访问的邻居距离设为当前距离加一并入队，直到队列清空。
en: Searching from each 1 separately rescans the same area over and over. What if you approached it from the side of the zeros instead?
Put every 0 in the queue at distance 0, i.e. multi-source BFS. When BFS first reaches a cell, the current level is its distance to the nearest zero.
Enqueue all zeros and mark the other cells unvisited. Pop cells one by one, give each unvisited neighbor the current distance plus one, and enqueue it until the queue is empty.

zh: 最长路径不一定经过根，但它一定会在某个“最高点”拐弯，分成向左和向右两段。
递归返回给父节点的只能是一条往下走的单链长度；而经过当前节点的路径长度是左右两条链之和，用全局变量记录最大值。
后序遍历：拿到左右子树的最长单链，用两者之和更新答案，再把较长的那条加一返回给父节点。注意长度按边数计算。
en: The longest path may skip the root, but it always bends at some highest node into a left part and a right part.
What you return to the parent can only be a single downward chain; the path through the current node is the sum of both chains, tracked in a global max.
Postorder: get the longest chain from each child, update the answer with their sum, then return the longer one plus one. Length is counted in edges.

zh: 边界可以拆成四段：根、左边界（不含叶子）、全部叶子（从左到右）、右边界（不含叶子，倒序）。
左边界的走法是能往左就往左，没有左孩子才往右；右边界与之对称。叶子单独收集，就能保证每个节点只算一次。根本身是叶子时要特殊处理。
先放入根；沿左边界往下走，收集非叶节点；再用 DFS 从左到右收集所有叶子；最后沿右边界收集非叶节点，倒序接在末尾。
en: Split the boundary into four parts: the root, the left edge without leaves, all leaves left to right, and the right edge without leaves in reverse.
The left edge goes left when possible, otherwise right; the right edge mirrors it. Collecting leaves separately ensures each node counts once. Handle a root that is itself a leaf.
Add the root; walk the left edge adding non-leaves; DFS to add leaves left to right; walk the right edge collecting non-leaves and append them reversed.

zh: 省份就是直接或间接相连的一组城市，也就是图里的一个连通块，问题就变成了数连通块。
每次从一个没访问过的城市出发，把它所在的整块都标记掉，正好对应一个省份；用并查集合并相连城市，最后数剩几个根也一样。
遍历每个城市，没访问过就计数加一，并从它出发 DFS，沿邻接矩阵里为 1 的位置标记所有能到的城市。全部遍历完，计数就是省份数。
en: A province is a set of cities linked directly or indirectly, i.e. a connected component. So the task is counting components.
Each traversal launched from an unvisited city marks off exactly one province. Union-find also works: merge connected pairs and count the remaining roots.
For each city, if unvisited, add one to the count and DFS from it, following 1s in the matrix to mark every reachable city. The final count is the answer.

zh: 与其数一条竖线穿过多少块砖，不如反过来想：竖线从哪里穿过，能“躲开”最多的砖？
竖线经过某一行的缝隙时，就不会穿过这一行的砖。所以要找的是被最多行共享的缝隙位置，答案等于总行数减去这个次数。
对每一行累加砖的宽度，得到这一行各条缝的位置；最后一块砖的右边界就是墙的边缘，不能算。用哈希表统计每个位置出现的次数，取最大值，再用总行数减去它。
en: Instead of counting the bricks a line crosses, flip it around: where should the line go to dodge as many bricks as possible?
A line through a gap in a row doesn't cross that row's brick. You want the gap position shared by the most rows; the answer is the row count minus that.

For each row, take running sums of brick widths to get gap positions, skipping the last one, which is the wall's edge. Count positions in a hash map, take the maximum, and subtract it from the row count.

zh: 数组里可能有负数，窗口和不再单调，滑动窗口行不通。换个角度：任何子数组的和都可以写成两个前缀和之差。
以 i 结尾、和为 k 的子数组个数，等于此前有多少个前缀和恰好比当前前缀和小 k。用哈希表记录每个前缀和出现过几次即可。
哈希表先放入“前缀和 0 出现 1 次”；遍历数组累加前缀和，先查表把对应的次数加到答案上，再把当前前缀和的次数加一；最后返回总数。
en: Negative numbers break window monotonicity, so sliding windows fail. Instead, note that any subarray sum is the difference of two prefix sums.
The number of subarrays ending at i with sum k equals how many earlier prefix sums are exactly k less than the current one. A hash map of prefix-sum counts answers that.
Seed the map with prefix sum 0 seen once. For each element, update the prefix sum, add the stored count for the matching earlier prefix, then increment the count for the current prefix.

zh: s2 包含 s1 的某个排列，换句话说就是 s2 里有一段和 s1 等长、字母构成完全相同的子串。
窗口长度固定为 s1 的长度，每滑一步只改变两个字母的频次。维护“频次一致的字母个数”，就能常数时间判断是否完全匹配。
s1 比 s2 长就直接返回假；统计 s1 的频次并初始化 s2 开头的窗口；之后每右移一步更新进出字母的频次和匹配数，26 个字母全部一致时立即返回真。
en: s2 contains a permutation of s1 exactly when some substring of s2 with s1's length has the same letter makeup.
The window length is fixed at |s1|, and each slide changes only two letter counts. Tracking how many letters have matching counts tests a full match in constant time.
If s1 is longer, return false. Count s1, fill the first window of s2, then slide right, updating counts and the match tally for entering and leaving letters. Return true once all 26 match.

zh: 这其实是两件事：在大树里找可能的起点，以及判断两棵树是否完全相同。
两棵树相同要求结构和值逐一对应，叶子下面的空孩子也得一致；子树必须一直匹配到底，不能只对上上半截。
先写一个判断两棵树是否相同的递归；再遍历大树的每个节点，以它为根调用这个判断，只要有一次相同就返回真。
en: There are really two tasks: find candidate starting nodes in the big tree, and check whether two trees are identical.
Identical means structure and values match everywhere, including null children under leaves; a subtree must match all the way down, not just its top part.
Write a recursive same-tree check; then visit every node of the main tree and run that check with the node as root, returning true on any match.

zh: 只能删除，最后两个串变成一样。那么最后剩下的字符串，和两个原串分别是什么关系？
留下来的部分一定是两个串的公共子序列，留得越长，删得越少，所以关键是最长公共子序列。也可以直接设 D[i][j] 为让两个前缀相同的最少删除次数。
求出最长公共子序列长度 L，答案就是两串长度之和减去 2L。若直接算 D：空前缀对应的格子等于另一前缀的长度；末尾字符相同取左上角，否则取删掉某个末尾后的较小值再加一。
en: You can only delete, and the two strings end up equal. How does the surviving string relate to each original?

What survives must be a common subsequence, and the longer it is, the fewer deletions, so the longest common subsequence is the key. Or define D[i][j] as the fewest deletions to equalize two prefixes.

With LCS length L, the answer is the sum of both lengths minus 2L. Computing D directly: an empty prefix costs the other prefix's length; matching last chars take the diagonal, else 1 + the smaller single deletion.

zh: 文件系统本身就是一棵按名字分层的树，每个节点要么是目录（有子节点），要么是文件（有内容）。
每个节点保存一个子节点映射、一个“是否为文件”的标记和文件内容。ls 遇到文件只返回它自己的名字，遇到目录则返回子节点名排序后的列表，可以用有序映射或返回前排序。
写一个按路径逐段往下走的辅助函数，遇到缺失的节点就创建。mkdir 走完整条路径；addContentToFile 走到末端，标记为文件并追加内容；readContentFromFile 返回内容；ls 按节点类型分别处理。
en: A file system is a tree layered by names; each node is either a directory with children or a file with content.
Each node holds a child map, an is-file flag, and content. ls on a file returns just its name; on a directory it returns the sorted child names, via an ordered map or a sort before returning.

Write one helper that walks a path segment by segment, creating missing nodes. mkdir walks it all; addContentToFile walks to the end, marks a file, and appends; readContentFromFile returns content; ls checks type.

zh: 同时遍历两棵树的对应位置，每个位置会出现三种情况：两边都有节点、只有一边有、两边都没有。
只有一边有节点时，直接把那一侧的整棵子树拿来用，不必再往下走；两边都有时，值相加，再分别合并左孩子这一对和右孩子这一对。
递归处理一对节点：任一为空就返回另一个；否则把第二个的值加到第一个上，第一个的左孩子设为合并两个左孩子的结果，右孩子同理；返回第一个节点。
en: Walk both trees in lockstep. At each position there are three cases: nodes on both sides, on only one side, or on neither.
If only one side has a node, reuse that whole subtree as is; no need to go deeper. If both do, add the values and merge the left pair and the right pair.
Recurse on a pair: if either is null, return the other. Otherwise add the second's value to the first, set the first's left to the merged left children and its right likewise. Return the first.

zh: 冷却只限制同种任务，所以真正拖慢进度的是出现次数最多的那种任务。先想想如果只有它，最少需要多少时间。
把最高频任务排开，相邻两次之间至少留 n 个空位，形成一个框架。其他任务可以填进这些空位；只有任务多到把空位全填满时，空闲时间才会变成零。
统计各任务次数，找出最大次数以及有几种任务达到这个次数；用这两个量算出框架的长度，再和任务总数比较，取较大者就是答案。也可以用大顶堆逐轮模拟来验证。
en: Cooldown applies only between identical tasks, so the most frequent task is what really limits progress. First figure out the minimum time if only that task existed.
Lay out the most frequent task with at least n slots between consecutive runs, forming a frame. Other tasks fill those slots; idle time drops to zero only once all slots are filled.

Count tasks, find the maximum frequency and how many tasks share it. Use those two numbers to size the frame, compare with the total task count, and take the larger. A max-heap simulation can cross-check.

zh: 用一块固定大小的数组，加上会“绕回开头”的下标，就能实现队列，而且不用搬动任何元素。
只靠头尾两个指针时，二者相等既可能是空也可能是满，需要额外信息来区分。最直接的是维护元素个数，下标前进统一对容量取模。
记录队头下标和元素个数。入队时满了就返回 false，否则写到“队头加个数”取模的位置，个数加一。出队时队头前进一格并取模，个数减一。Front 读队头，Rear 读最后一个元素的位置。
en: A fixed-size array plus indices that wrap back to the start gives you a queue without ever shifting elements.
With only head and tail pointers, equal pointers could mean empty or full, so you need extra information. The simplest fix is to keep a count, and advance every index modulo the capacity.

Store head and count. Enqueue fails when full; otherwise write at head plus count (mod capacity) and increment count. Dequeue advances head mod capacity and decrements count. Front reads head; Rear reads the last slot.

zh: 先别管选哪些课。假如已经定好一组课，按什么顺序上最容易全部赶在截止前完成？怎样快速判断这组课是否可行？
按截止时间从早到晚上课最稳妥，一组课可行当且仅当每个前缀的总时长都不超过对应截止时间。于是按截止时间扫描，超时就踢掉耗时最长的那门：课数不受影响，总时长却最短。
按截止时间升序排序；用最大堆记录已选课程的时长，并维护总时长；每门课先入堆并累加，若总时长超过它的截止时间，就弹出堆顶并减去；最后堆的大小就是答案。
en: Set aside which courses to pick. Given a fixed set, in what order should you take them to best meet every deadline, and how would you check that the set is feasible?

Earliest deadline first is safest: a set works iff each prefix's total time fits its deadline. So scan by deadline, and when over, drop the longest course: the count is unaffected and total time is minimal.

Sort by deadline. Keep a max-heap of chosen durations and a running total. For each course, push it and add its time; if the total exceeds its deadline, pop the largest and subtract. Answer: heap size.

zh: 合法区间必须从每个列表里各包含至少一个数。可以让每个列表各出一个代表，区间就是这些代表里的最小值到最大值。
想让区间变小，唯一有希望的做法是把当前最小的代表往后挪一步，挪其他代表只会让最大值不变或变大。所以每次只推进最小值所在的列表。
把每个列表的第一个元素放入小顶堆，并记下当前最大值；循环：用堆顶和最大值组成的区间更新答案，弹出堆顶，把它所在列表的下一个元素入堆并更新最大值；有列表用完就停止。
en: A valid range must include at least one number from every list. Pick one representative per list; the range then runs from the smallest representative to the largest.
The only move that can shrink the range is advancing the smallest representative; moving any other one can only keep or raise the maximum. So always step forward in the list holding the minimum.

Push each list's first element into a min-heap and track the maximum. Loop: update the answer with the heap top and max, pop the top, push the next element from its list, update the max; stop when a list runs out.

zh: 用一块固定大小的数组，让下标可以在首尾之间绕圈，两端的插入和删除就都不用搬动任何元素。
维护队头下标和元素个数。从前端插入时，队头要向左退一格，退成负数时先加上容量再取模。队尾的位置始终可以由队头加个数推出来。
每个操作先判满或判空。insertFront 把队头左移一格再写入；insertLast 写到队头加个数的位置；deleteFront 让队头右移；deleteLast 只减个数。别忘了更新个数，并专门测试容量为 1 的情况。
en: Use a fixed-size array whose indices wrap around between its ends; then inserting or removing at either end never requires shifting elements.

Keep the front index and a count. Inserting at the front moves the front one step left; when that goes negative, add the capacity before taking the modulus. The rear is always derived from front plus count.

Check full or empty first. insertFront steps front left and writes; insertLast writes at front plus count; deleteFront steps front right; deleteLast just decrements count. Update the count and test capacity 1.

zh: 1 到 n 里恰好有一个数出现两次、一个数没出现。如果知道每个数各出现了几次，答案就一目了然。
出现两次的是重复值，一次都没出现的是缺失值。想省空间，可以用“下标对应值的符号”来代替计数数组。
扫描时对每个值 v 检查下标 v-1：已经是负数就记下 v 为重复值，否则把它翻成负数。再扫一遍，仍为正数的位置 i 对应的 i+1 就是缺失值。
en: In 1..n, exactly one value appears twice and one is missing. If you knew how often each value occurs, the answer would be obvious.
Seen twice means duplicate, never seen means missing. To save space, sign marks at index v-1 can stand in for a count array.
For each value v, check slot v-1: if it's already negative, v is the duplicate; otherwise negate it. In a second pass, the slot i that is still positive gives the missing value i+1.

zh: 链里的每一对都必须在前一对结束之后才开始，而且是严格大于。想接得尽量多，下一对应该优先挑什么样的？
想给后面留出最多空间，就该每次选结束最早、又能接上的那一对。按右端点排序后贪心即可；也可以写以每对结尾的最长链 O(n²) DP 来对照。
按右端点升序排序；记录当前链末尾的右端点（初始为负无穷）；依次扫描，左端点严格大于末尾就接上，更新末尾并计数加一；返回计数。
en: Each pair must start strictly after the previous one ends. To fit in as many as possible, which kind of pair should you prefer to take next?
To leave the most room, always take the compatible pair that ends earliest. Greedy on sorted right ends works; an O(n²) DP over the longest chain ending at each pair is a good cross-check.
Sort pairs by right end. Track the current chain's end, starting at −∞. Scan: if a pair's left is strictly greater than that end, take it, update the end, and count it. Return the count.

zh: 逐个检查所有子串太慢。每个回文子串都有唯一的对称中心，可能是一个字符，也可能是两个字符之间的空隙。一共有多少个这样的中心？
从一个中心每成功往外扩一步，就多出一个回文子串；一旦两端不等，围绕这个中心更长的串也不可能是回文。位置不同的子串分开计数，哪怕内容一样。
枚举 2n−1 个中心（字符上和两字符之间）；从每个中心往外扩，只要两端相等就计数加一并继续，失配就换下一个中心；返回总数。
en: Checking every substring is too slow. Each palindromic substring has a unique center, either a character or the gap between two. How many possible centers are there?
Each successful outward step from a center adds one palindrome; once the ends differ, nothing wider around that center can be one. Substrings at different positions count separately.
Loop over the 2n−1 centers, on chars and between them. Expand while both ends match, adding one per step. Stop at a mismatch and move on. Return the total.

zh: 整个操作序列可以看成若干个“全选复制 + 粘贴若干次”的块，每个块把当前长度乘以某个倍数。
定义“得到 i 个字符的最少步数”。若最后一次复制时长度为 d，那么 d 必须整除 i，之后再用 i/d 步（一次复制加若干次粘贴）把长度变成 i。
得到 1 个字符需要 0 步；对每个 i 枚举它的因子 d，用“d 的最优步数加上 i/d”更新最小值。进一步会发现答案就是 n 的质因数之和，可以用试除法直接算。
en: The operation sequence is a series of blocks, each a Copy All followed by some Pastes, and every block multiplies the current length by some factor.
Let the state be the fewest steps to reach i characters. If the last Copy All happened at length d, then d divides i, and i/d more steps (one copy plus pastes) bring you to i.
Reaching 1 takes 0 steps. For each i, try every divisor d and minimize d's best plus i/d. You'll find the answer is the sum of n's prime factors, computable by trial division.

zh: 两棵子树重复，要求结构和每个位置的值都一样，所以需要给整棵子树一个可以比较的“指纹”。
后序遍历时，用左子树的标识、当前值、右子树的标识拼出当前子树的标识，空节点也要有占位。再把标识映射成整数编号，避免字符串越拼越长。
用哈希表统计每个标识出现的次数；后序算出当前子树的标识后计数加一，计数恰好变成 2 时把当前节点加入结果，这样每种结构只报告一次。
en: Duplicate subtrees need identical structure and values everywhere, so each subtree needs a comparable fingerprint.
In postorder, build a subtree's key from the left ID, the value, and the right ID, with a placeholder for null. Mapping keys to integer IDs stops them growing long.
Count keys in a hash map; after computing a node's key increment its count, and when it becomes exactly 2 add the node to the answer, so each shape is reported once.

zh: 题目的定义本身就是递归的：最大值当根，它左边那段建左子树，右边那段建右子树。
直接递归最坏是平方复杂度。换个角度：每个元素的父节点，是它左右两侧最近的更大元素中较小的那个，而这正是单调栈擅长找的。
递归版：在区间里找最大值下标，两侧分别递归。线性版：维护递减栈，新元素到来时弹出所有更小的元素，最后弹出的那个当它的左孩子，再把它挂成栈顶的右孩子；栈底就是根。
en: The definition is recursive: the maximum becomes the root, the part to its left forms the left subtree, the part to its right the right subtree.
Naive recursion is quadratic in the worst case. Note each element's parent is the smaller of its nearest greater neighbors on both sides, which a monotonic stack finds.

Recursive: split at the range max. Linear: keep a decreasing stack; pop smaller nodes, the last popped becomes the new node's left child; make the new node the top's right child and push it. The bottom is the root.

zh: 宽度要把中间的空位也算进去，光数节点不够，需要知道每个节点在“补满之后的树”里处于什么位置。
按堆的方式给节点编号：左孩子 2i、右孩子 2i+1，每层宽度就是最右编号减最左编号再加一。编号会随深度指数增长，必须控制。
按层 BFS，队列里存节点和编号；每层先减去该层第一个编号做归一化，再给孩子编号。用每层首尾编号更新最大宽度。
en: Width counts the gaps between nodes too, so counting nodes isn't enough; you need each node's position as if the tree were full.
Index nodes heap-style (left 2i, right 2i+1); a level's width is last index minus first index plus one. Indices grow exponentially with depth, so keep them small.
BFS storing (node, index); at each level subtract the level's first index before indexing children. Update the max width from each level's first and last indices.

zh: 一个节点超出范围被删掉时，它某一侧的子树里可能还有合法节点，不能整棵扔掉。
当前值小于下界时，它和整个左子树都不合法，答案只可能在右子树里；大于上界时只看左子树。值在范围内就保留，再分别修剪两侧。
递归返回修剪后的根：空返回空；值太小就返回右子树的修剪结果；值太大就返回左子树的修剪结果；否则修剪左右孩子重新挂上，返回当前节点。
en: When an out-of-range node is removed, one of its subtrees may still contain valid nodes, so you can't discard everything below it.
If the value is below low, it and its whole left subtree are invalid and the answer lies in its right subtree; above high, only the left. In range, keep it and trim both sides.
Recurse returning the trimmed root: null returns null; too small returns the trimmed right subtree; too large returns the trimmed left; otherwise trim and reattach both children.

zh: 只算出最长长度还不够，还得知道有多少种方式能达到这个长度。对每个结尾位置，你需要同时记两样东西。
对每个 i 维护 len[i]（以 i 结尾的最长长度）和 cnt[i]（达到该长度的方案数）。从前驱 j 转来时，得到更长的长度就覆盖计数，长度相同就累加计数。
所有 len、cnt 初值为 1；对每个 i 枚举之前比它小的 j，按更长则重置、等长则累加来更新；最后找出全局最长长度，把所有达到它的位置的 cnt 加起来。
en: Knowing the length isn't enough; you also need how many ways reach it. Track two things for each ending position.
For each i keep len[i] (longest ending at i) and cnt[i] (ways to get that length). From a predecessor j, a longer length overwrites the count; an equal length adds to it.
Initialize every len and cnt to 1. For each i, scan earlier smaller j: a longer length resets cnt, an equal one adds to it. Find the global max length and sum cnt over every position that reaches it.

zh: “恰好改一个字符”意味着长度必须相同，而且两个单词恰好只有一个位置不同；和字典里某词完全一样并不算数。
可以把字典词的每一位依次换成占位符，生成若干“模式”，并记录每个模式来自哪些原词。查询词生成同样的模式，只要某个模式对应着一个与查询词不同的原词，就算成功。
buildDict 时，对每个词的每个位置生成“该位替换成占位符”的模式，模式映射到原词集合。search 时对查询词逐位生成模式，检查映射里是否存在不等于查询词本身的词，有就返回 true，否则返回 false。
en: Changing exactly one character means the lengths must match and the words differ in exactly one position. A word identical to a dictionary entry does not count.

Replace each position of every dictionary word with a wildcard to form patterns, remembering which words produced each pattern. The query matches if one of its patterns came from some word other than the query itself.
In buildDict, map each wildcard pattern of each word to its set of source words. In search, build the query's patterns and return true if any maps to a word different from the query; otherwise false.

zh: 星号有三种含义，直接枚举会指数爆炸。换个角度：扫到某个位置时，未匹配的左括号数量可能落在哪些值上？
维护未匹配左括号数的最小可能值和最大可能值；最大值一旦变负就无解，最小值不能低于零（低了就夹回零），最后最小值为零即合法。
从左到右扫描：遇左括号上下界都加一，遇右括号都减一，遇星号下界减一、上界加一；上界小于零立即返回假；下界小于零时重置为零；结束时检查下界是否为零。
en: Trying all three meanings of each '*' blows up exponentially. Instead ask: at a given position, what range of unmatched '(' counts is still possible?
Track the lowest and highest possible number of unmatched '('. If the high end goes negative, fail; clamp the low end at zero. The string is valid iff the low end is zero at the end.
Scan left to right: '(' raises both bounds, ')' lowers both, '*' lowers the low and raises the high. Fail if high < 0; reset low to 0 if it dips below. At the end, return whether low is 0.

zh: 所有加括号的方式其实都可以归结为：每次从剩下的数里挑两个，用某种运算合并成一个，直到只剩一个数。
状态就是“当前剩下的数字列表”。挑两个数时顺序有意义（减法和除法不对称），结果放回列表后继续递归。因为有除法，要用浮点数，并以很小的误差判断是否等于 24，除数接近 0 时跳过。
把 4 个数转成浮点数；递归：只剩一个数时检查它与 24 的差是否足够小；否则枚举有序的两个下标和每种运算结果，构造“其余数 + 该结果”的新列表递归，任一成功就返回真。
en: Every parenthesization boils down to: pick two of the remaining numbers, combine them with one operator, and repeat until one number is left.
State is the list of remaining numbers. Pair order matters for - and /. Use floats because of division, compare to 24 with a small tolerance, and skip dividing by near-zero.
Convert to floats. With one number left, check it's within epsilon of 24. Else for each ordered pair and operator result, recurse on the others plus that result; return true on any success.

zh: 先像判断普通回文一样，从两端往中间比较。只要两端一直相等，就没必要删除任何字符。
第一次遇到两端不相等时，被删掉的必须是这两个字符之一，否则这对失配会一直存在。所以只剩两种候选。
双指针从两端向内比较；遇到第一次失配时，分别检查跳过左字符或跳过右字符后的剩余区间是否为回文，任一成立即为真；全程没有失配也为真。
en: Compare from both ends inward as for an ordinary palindrome. As long as the ends match, there is no reason to delete anything.
At the first mismatch, the deleted character must be one of those two; otherwise the mismatched pair survives. That leaves just two candidates.
Move pointers inward. At the first mismatch, check whether the range skipping the left character or the one skipping the right is a palindrome; true if either is. No mismatch also means true.

zh: 树上再多加一条边，一定会形成恰好一个环；多余的那条边，连接的是两个早就相通的点。
按输入顺序一条条加边，用并查集维护当前的连通情况；第一次碰到两端已在同一集合的边，它就是把环闭合的那一条。
初始化并查集，逐条处理边：两端的根相同就直接返回这条边，否则合并后继续。按顺序找到的第一条冲突边，恰好也是环上最后出现的那条，符合题意。
en: A tree plus one extra edge always contains exactly one cycle. The redundant edge joins two nodes that were already linked.
Add edges in input order and track connectivity with union-find. The first edge whose endpoints already share a set is the one that closes the cycle.
Init union-find. For each edge, find both roots; if equal, return this edge, otherwise union them. That first conflict is also the latest cycle edge in the input, as required.

zh: 要让 b 成为重复后的 a 的子串，重复次数至少要让总长度不小于 b。那最多重复多少次，就可以下结论了？
设 k 为刚好让总长度不小于 b 的最少次数。由于 b 的起点可能落在某份 a 的中间，最多再多加一份就够了；k+1 份里还找不到，再加也找不到。
先算出 k，把 a 重复 k 次，检查 b 是否为子串，是就返回 k；否则再拼一份 a 检查，是就返回 k+1；仍然不行就返回 -1。子串查找可以用内置函数或 KMP。
en: For b to be a substring of repeated a, the total length must reach at least b's length. What's the most repetitions you'd ever need before giving up?
Let k be the smallest count whose length reaches b's. Since b may start partway through a copy of a, one extra copy is enough; if k+1 copies don't contain b, more won't help.
Compute k, repeat a k times, and check whether b is a substring; if so return k. Otherwise append one more copy and check for k+1. If that fails too, return -1. Use a built-in search or KMP.

zh: 目标串最多只有 15 个字符，这么小的规模值得留意。贴纸能无限次使用，先贴哪张后贴哪张也不影响结果，真正要紧的是目标里还剩哪些字母没凑到。
以目标中还缺哪些字符为状态（位掩码或剩余计数），值为凑齐它的最少贴纸数。为了不重复搜同一组合的不同顺序，每次只试能覆盖第一个缺失字符的贴纸。
先统计每张贴纸的字母频次；从全缺状态出发做记忆化搜索或 BFS：找第一个缺的字符，只试含它的贴纸，尽量填补后得到新状态并加一；凑齐返回 0，不可达返回 -1。
en: The target has at most 15 letters, a size worth noticing. Stickers are reusable and their order doesn't matter; what really counts is which target letters are still missing.
State = the target letters still needed (bitmask or leftover counts); value = fewest stickers to finish. To avoid permutations, only try stickers that contain the first missing letter.

Precount letters per sticker. From the all-missing state, run memoized search or BFS: find the first missing letter, try each sticker with it, fill what it can, recurse + 1. Done = 0; unreachable = -1.

zh: 上下左右相连的陆地格子组成一座岛，也就是网格中的一个连通块。问题变成：怎样数出每一块有多少格，再从中取最大？
让每次遍历返回它覆盖的格子数：当前格算一个，再加上向四个方向扩展得到的面积。格子一访问就要立刻标记，防止重复计入。
扫描网格，遇到未访问的陆地就启动 DFS 或 BFS 统计这座岛的面积，并用它更新最大值；没有陆地时答案为零。
en: Land cells joined up, down, left, or right form an island, i.e. a connected component of the grid. So how do you count the cells in each one and keep the largest?
Have each traversal return its cell count: one for the current cell plus the areas from its four neighbors. Mark cells visited immediately to avoid double counting.
Scan the grid; for each unvisited land cell run DFS or BFS to measure that island's area and update the maximum. With no land the answer is zero.

zh: 二叉搜索树里，左子树的值都比根小，右子树的值都比根大。拿目标值和根比一次之后，你能排除掉哪些节点？
每比较一次，答案只可能在其中一侧，另一侧整棵子树都不用看。于是查找就是沿着一条从根往下的路径走，耗时与树高成正比。
从根开始：相等就返回当前节点；目标更小往左走，更大往右走；走到空说明不存在。用循环实现还能省掉递归栈。
en: In a BST, everything in the left subtree is smaller than the root and everything in the right is larger. After one comparison with the root, which nodes can you rule out?
Each comparison leaves only one side as a candidate; the other subtree never needs checking. So the search follows a single root-to-leaf path, costing time proportional to the height.
From the root: equal means return the node; smaller goes left, larger goes right; reaching null means not found. A loop avoids the recursion stack.

zh: 新值总能作为叶子插进去，不需要调整已有节点的结构。
像查找一样往下走，第一个碰到的空位置就是新节点该放的地方，有序性自然得到保持。
树为空就直接返回新节点；否则从根开始比较，往左或往右走，直到对应方向的孩子为空，把新节点挂上去，最后返回原来的根。
en: A new value can always be added as a leaf; no existing nodes need rearranging.
Walk down as if searching; the first empty spot you reach is exactly where the new node belongs, which keeps the order intact.
If the tree is empty return the new node; otherwise compare and move left or right until the child in that direction is null, attach the node there, and return the root.

zh: 第 k 大只和最大的那 k 个数有关；一个值一旦比这 k 个都小，以后就再也不会影响答案。
用一个大小不超过 k 的最小堆，保存目前最大的 k 个数。堆顶是这 k 个数中最小的那个，也就是第 k 大。
构造时把初始数逐个加入堆，堆的大小超过 k 就弹出堆顶；初始数不足 k 个也没关系。add 时同样先插入，超过 k 就弹出，然后返回堆顶。每次更新耗时 O(log k)。
en: The kth largest only depends on the k largest values; anything smaller than all of them can never matter again.
Keep a min-heap of at most k elements holding the k largest values seen so far. Its top is the smallest of those k, which is exactly the kth largest.
In the constructor push each initial value and pop whenever size exceeds k; fewer than k initial values is fine. add pushes, pops if size exceeds k, and returns the top. Each update costs O(log k).

zh: 插入和删除时，真正要改的是目标位置前一个节点的指针。可头节点前面没有节点，于是头部操作总要单独处理。能不能让它也有一个前驱？
在头节点前放一个不存数据的哑节点，所有插入删除都变成“修改某个节点的后继”。再维护链表长度，操作前就能判断下标是否合法；从哑节点走 index 步，正好到达第 index 个位置的前驱。
初始化哑节点和长度 0。get 校验下标后往后走到目标节点；addAtIndex 允许下标等于长度，找到前驱后接入新节点；deleteAtIndex 找到前驱后跳过目标。头尾插入直接复用 addAtIndex，并记得更新长度。
en: Inserting or deleting really means rewiring the node before the target position. The head has no such node, so head operations keep needing special cases. Could you give it a predecessor too?
Put a data-free dummy before the head so every insert and delete edits some node's successor. Track the length to reject bad indices; walking index steps from the dummy lands on the predecessor.

Start with a dummy and length 0. get validates then walks to the node; addAtIndex allows index equal to length and links after the predecessor; deleteAtIndex unlinks the target. Head/tail adds reuse addAtIndex.

zh: 沿着有序循环链表走，值一直不下降，只在“最大值跳回最小值”的地方出现一次下降。新值插在哪儿，取决于它和这些位置的关系。
插入点有两类：新值恰好夹在相邻两个节点之间；或者在断点处（前大后小），且新值不小于最大值或不大于最小值。绕完一整圈都没找到，说明所有值都相同，插在哪都行。
空链表时新建一个指向自己的节点并返回；从给定节点开始，逐个检查当前节点和它的下一个：满足上面两类之一就插入；绕回起点仍没插入，就插在当前节点之后；返回给定节点。
en: In a sorted circular list, values never decrease except at one drop where the maximum wraps to the minimum. Where the new value belongs depends on those positions.
Insert either between two neighbors that bracket the value, or at the drop when the value is at least the max or at most the min. If a full lap finds neither, all values are equal and any spot works.

If empty, create a node pointing to itself and return it. From the given node, check each node and its next; insert when either case above holds. After a full lap, insert after the current node. Return the given node.

zh: 盯住两个串的末尾字符：相同的话可以一起留下；不同的话，至少有一个要删掉。每做一次这样的选择，问题都会缩成更短前缀上的同一个问题。
设 C[i][j] 为让 s1 前 i 个字符和 s2 前 j 个字符变得相同的最小删除代价。一侧为空时，另一侧只能全部删掉，代价是它所有字符 ASCII 值之和。
先填第一行、第一列的累计删除代价；逐格比较末尾：相等取左上角，不等时比较删掉 s1 末尾和删掉 s2 末尾（各加上被删字符的码值），取较小者；返回右下角。
en: Look at the last characters of both strings: if they match, both can stay; if not, at least one must go. Each such choice shrinks the problem to the same question on shorter prefixes.
Let C[i][j] be the min cost to make the first i chars of s1 equal the first j of s2. If one side is empty, the other must be deleted entirely, costing the sum of its ASCII values.
Fill the first row and column with cumulative ASCII costs. For each cell: match → diagonal; else the cheaper of deleting s1's last char or s2's last char, each adding its code. Return bottom-right.

zh: 数组元素都是正整数，子数组越长乘积越大。固定右端点后，满足条件的左端点会形成一段连续区间。
对每个右端点，找到让乘积小于 k 的最远左端点，那么以该右端点结尾的合法子数组个数正好是当前窗口长度，可以一次性累加。
k 不超过 1 时直接返回 0；右指针乘入元素，乘积不小于 k 时不断除掉左端元素并右移左指针；每步把当前窗口长度加到答案上。
en: All elements are positive, so longer subarrays have larger products. For a fixed right end, the valid left ends form one contiguous range.
For each right end, find the farthest left end that keeps the product under k. Then the number of valid subarrays ending there equals the window length, so add it at once.
If k is at most 1, return 0. Multiply in the right element; while the product is at least k, divide out the left one and advance. Add the window length to the total each step.

zh: 没有手续费时，把每一段上涨都吃下来就是最优。有了手续费，把一段连续上涨拆成好几笔交易就要多付几次钱。那么，什么时候该继续拿着，什么时候值得卖掉？
这种“拿着还是卖掉”的取舍可以交给动态规划：每天记两个值，手里有股票时的最大收益，和手里没股票时的最大收益。手续费每笔只扣一次，约定在卖出时扣就不会重复。
持股初始为负的首日价格，不持股为 0；每天约定在卖出时扣手续费，不持股取保持与卖出的较大者，持股取保持与买入的较大者，必要时先暂存旧值；返回不持股的值。
en: Without fees, capturing every upswing is optimal. With a fee, splitting one long rise into several trades pays the fee several times. So when should you keep holding, and when is selling worth it?
Let dynamic programming settle hold-or-sell: each day track the best profit while holding a share and while holding none. Charge the fee once per trade, say on selling, so it's never counted twice.
Start hold at −price[0] and cash at 0. Each day, charge the fee on selling: cash = better of staying or selling minus fee; hold = better of staying or buying. Save old values if needed. Return cash.

zh: 数对有平方级那么多，全部列出来再排序太慢。先把数组排个序看看：固定一个右端元素，左边的搭档离它越远，两者的差就越大。这种有序性能帮你什么？
与其直接找第 k 小的距离，不如问“差不超过 d 的数对有几个”。这个个数随 d 单调不减，第 k 小的距离就是让个数达到 k 的最小 d，可以对 d 二分。
排序；在 0 到最大值减最小值之间二分 d；计数时右指针逐个前进，左指针只右移不回退，把差超过 d 的左端排除，累加窗口内的对数；个数达到 k 就收右边界，否则移左边界。
en: There are quadratically many pairs, too many to list and sort. Sort the array first: for a fixed right element, the farther left its partner, the larger the difference. How can that order help?
Instead of hunting the k-th distance directly, ask how many pairs differ by at most d. That count never decreases as d grows, so the answer is the smallest d whose count reaches k: binary-search d.

Sort, then binary-search d in [0, max − min]. To count, advance the right pointer and move the left one forward (never back) past elements too far away, adding the window size. Count ≥ k: lower hi; else raise lo.

zh: 名字相同不代表是同一个人，真正把账户连起来的是共同的邮箱；而且这种“是同一个人”的关系可以传递。
这种可以传递的“同属一人”关系，正适合用并查集维护。每个账户不必让邮箱两两相连，只要把它的邮箱都并到同一个代表上；最终根相同的邮箱属于同一个人。
遍历账户，把其余邮箱都并到该账户第一个邮箱上，并记下每个邮箱对应的名字；再按根把邮箱分组，每组排序后在最前面加上名字输出。
en: Same name doesn't mean same person; shared emails are what link accounts, and that same-person relation is transitive.

A transitive same-person relation is exactly what union-find handles. No need to link every pair of emails in an account; just union them all into one representative. Emails sharing a root belong to one person.
For each account, union its other emails into its first email and record each email's name. Group emails by root, sort each group, and prepend the owner's name.

zh: 在每个位置都重新求左右两边的和，会做大量重复工作。整个数组的和是固定的，能不能借它少算一边？
从左往右扫的时候维护左侧累计和，右侧的和就能由总和、左侧和与当前元素直接推出来，不必另外计算。
先求总和；从左到右遍历，若左侧和等于右侧和就返回当前下标，否则把当前元素计入左侧和；遍历结束仍没找到就返回 −1。
en: Recomputing both side sums at every index repeats a lot of work. The total sum is fixed; can it save you from computing one side?
While scanning left to right, keep the running left sum. The right sum then follows directly from the total, the left sum and the current element, with no extra pass.
Compute the total. Walk left to right: if the left sum equals the right sum, return the index; otherwise add the current element to the left sum. Return −1 if nothing matches.

zh: 化学式就是一种嵌套表达式：括号里的一组原子作为整体，乘上后面的倍数。想想怎样在读到右括号时把倍数一次作用到整组上。
每进入一层括号就开一张新的“原子→个数”表；读到右括号时，读出它后面的数字，把这张表的每项乘上它，再并入外层的表。
逐字符解析：大写字母加后面的小写字母是原子名，再读可选的多位数（默认为一）计入当前表；左括号新开一表，右括号乘倍数后合并到上层。最后按原子名字典序输出，个数为一时省略。
en: A formula is a nested expression: a parenthesized group of atoms is multiplied by the number after it. Think about applying that multiplier to the whole group when it closes.
Open a fresh atom-to-count map at each "(". At ")", read the following number and merge the inner map into the outer one, multiplying every count by it.

An uppercase letter plus trailing lowercase letters is a name, then an optional multi-digit count (default 1) for the current map. "(" opens a map; ")" merges it scaled. Output sorted names, omitting 1.

zh: 从起点出发，上下左右相邻且颜色相同的格子会连成一片，要改的就是这一整片。
改色本身就能当作“已访问”标记：只有颜色仍等于原色的格子才继续扩散。但如果新颜色和原色一样，这个标记就失效了，会陷入死循环。
先记下起点原色，和新颜色相同就直接返回原图；否则从起点 DFS 或 BFS，把等于原色的格子改成新颜色并向四个方向扩展，越界或颜色不符就停。
en: Starting from the given cell, same-colored cells connected up, down, left, or right form one region, and that whole region is what changes.
Repainting doubles as the visited mark: only cells still of the old color keep spreading. But if the new color equals the old one, that mark fails and you loop forever.
Save the start's color; if it equals the new color return the image as is; otherwise DFS or BFS from the start, repaint matching cells and expand in four directions, stopping at bounds or mismatches.

zh: 只有“左边往右飞、右边往左飞”的一对才会相撞。从左往右处理时，一颗往左飞的小行星只会撞上它左边幸存下来、往右飞的那些。
已处理的幸存者里，可能被后来者撞到的只有末尾那段连续往右飞的；新来的往左飞者先撞最近的一颗，再撞下一颗。增删都只发生在末尾，正好用栈来存幸存者。
依次处理：往右飞的直接加入幸存者；往左飞的就反复和幸存者末尾的往右飞者比较，小的被摧毁，一样大则同归于尽；若它最后还活着（左边已没有往右飞的），就加入幸存者。
en: Only a right-moving asteroid followed by a left-moving one can collide. Processing left to right, a left-mover can only hit surviving right-movers to its left.
Among survivors so far, only the trailing run of right-movers can still be hit, and a new left-mover hits the nearest first. Since changes happen only at the end, keep the survivors on a stack.
A right-mover just joins the survivors. A left-mover repeatedly fights the last surviving right-mover: the smaller explodes, equals both explode. If it survives with no right-mover left, it joins.

zh: 每一天要找之后第一个更暖的日子。换个角度：新的一天到来时，它能替前面哪些还在等待的日子给出答案？
还在等待的日子，从早到晚温度不会上升，否则早的那天早就被解决了。所以新的一天只需从最近的等待者开始比较。
逐天遍历，把下标存进等待列表；今天比列表末尾那天更暖时，就把那天取出并记下天数差，重复直到不再更暖，再把今天加入。始终没被取出的日子答案为零。
en: Each day needs the first warmer day after it. Flip the view: when a new temperature arrives, which earlier days that are still waiting can it resolve?
Days still waiting have non-increasing temperatures from oldest to newest; otherwise an older one would already be resolved. So a new day only compares against the newest waiters.
Iterate days, keeping indices of waiting days. While today is warmer than the newest waiter, remove it and record the index difference; then add today. Days never removed get zero.

zh: 把所有数按数值摆到数轴上看：选中 x 只会牵连紧挨着的 x−1 和 x+1，和其他数值毫无关系。这种只与左右邻居冲突的结构，能不能沿着数轴从小到大逐个决定？
同一个数值的所有副本命运相同，可以合成一项，收益是数值乘以出现次数。问题于是变成：在按数值排好的一排收益里挑若干项，相邻数值不能同时选，求最大总和。
统计每个数值的总点数，按数值从小到大放进数组，不存在的记 0；从左往右递推，每个位置取“不选它时前一位的最优值”和“它的收益加上前两位的最优值”中的较大者，两个滚动变量即可。
en: Lay the numbers out on the number line: taking x only affects its neighbors x−1 and x+1, nothing else. With conflicts only between adjacent values, can you decide value by value from smallest to largest?
All copies of one value share the same fate, so merge them into one item worth value × count. Now pick items from a row sorted by value, never two adjacent values, to maximize the total.

Sum points per value into an array indexed by value, 0 where missing. Sweep left to right: each slot takes the larger of the best up to the previous slot, or its own gain plus the best two slots back.

zh: 信号沿所有边同时传播，所以每个节点收到信号的时间，就是从源点到它的最短路径长度；整体用时由最晚收到的那个决定。
边权都非负，所以当前距离最小、还没确定的节点，它的最短距离已经不会再变；把它确定下来，再用它去更新邻居。
建邻接表，用小根堆从 k 出发；弹出的节点若已确定就跳过，否则确定它并松弛所有出边。最后有节点没被确定就返回 -1，否则返回所有最短距离里的最大值。
en: The signal travels along every edge at once, so each node's arrival time is its shortest-path distance from k. The total time is set by the last node reached.
With nonnegative weights, the unsettled node with the smallest tentative distance is already final; settle it, then use it to improve its neighbors.
Build adjacency lists and run a min-heap from k: skip pops that are already settled, otherwise settle and relax outgoing edges. If any node stays unsettled, return -1; else return the max distance.

zh: 同时限定前缀和后缀，普通前缀树一次只能照顾一端。可以想办法把两个条件压缩成一次查找。
单词长度很短，可以在构造时就枚举每个单词所有的“前缀和后缀组合”，拼成一个键存进哈希表，值为下标。后面的词覆盖前面的，查到的自然就是最大下标。
构造时遍历每个单词和它的下标，双重循环枚举前缀长度和后缀长度，把“前缀加分隔符加后缀”作为键写入哈希表。查询时用同样方式拼键直接查，查不到返回 -1。这是拿空间换查询时间。
en: Filtering by prefix and suffix at once is awkward for a plain trie, which handles one end at a time. Look for a way to fold both conditions into a single lookup.

Words are short, so at build time enumerate every prefix and suffix pair of each word, join them into one key, and store the index. Later words overwrite earlier ones, so lookups return the largest index.

For each word and index, loop over all prefix lengths and suffix lengths and store prefix + separator + suffix in a hash map. A query builds the same key and looks it up, returning -1 if missing. Space buys query speed.

zh: 你可以从第 0 或第 1 阶出发，楼顶是数组末尾之后的那个位置；先想清楚费用是在离开台阶时付，还是踏上台阶时付。
定义“到达位置 i 的最小花费”：只能从 i-1 或 i-2 过来，离开时要付那一阶的费用。到达第 0、1 阶都不花钱，答案是到达位置 n 的花费。
位置 0 和 1 的花费设为 0；从位置 2 推到位置 n，每个位置取“从前一阶过来”和“从前两阶过来”两种走法中更便宜的；两个滚动变量即可完成。
en: You may start on step 0 or 1, and the top is the spot just past the last step. First decide whether a step's cost is paid when you leave it or when you land on it.
Let the state be the minimum cost to reach position i. You arrive from i-1 or i-2 and pay the cost of the step you leave. Reaching 0 or 1 is free; the answer is position n.
Set positions 0 and 1 to 0. For positions 2 through n, take the cheaper of arriving from one step back or two steps back, each paying the step left. Two rolling variables suffice.

zh: 如果没有死亡数字，每个轮子各自转到目标的最短圈距加起来就是答案。正是那些死亡数字可能逼你绕路，所以得系统地搜索，而不能逐位贪心。
每拨一次的代价都相同，“最少拨几次”就适合用广度优先搜索按步数一层层向外扩展。每个密码拨一次能得到 8 个新密码；死亡数字既不能进入，也不能从它继续往下走。
把 deadends 放进集合，若 0000 本身就在其中返回 -1；从 0000 开始 BFS，逐层生成 8 个邻居（9 和 0 首尾相接），跳过死亡和已访问的，碰到 target 返回层数，否则返回 -1。
en: Without dead ends, the answer is just the sum of each wheel's shortest circular distance to its target. Dead ends may force detours, so you need a systematic search, not digit-by-digit greed.
Every turn costs the same, so breadth-first search, expanding level by level, gives the fewest turns. Each code yields 8 new codes in one move; a dead end can't be entered or expanded from.
Put deadends in a set; if 0000 is dead, return -1. BFS from 0000, generating 8 neighbors per state (9 and 0 wrap) and skipping dead or visited ones. Return the level at target, else -1.

zh: 所有人都空闲的时间，就是把所有人的忙碌时间叠在一起之后剩下的空隙。
不用区分是谁的区间：把全部忙碌区间放到一起按起点排序再合并，相邻合并块之间的间隔就是公共空闲，首尾两侧的无限时间不算。
收集所有区间按起点排序（或用堆做多路归并）；维护目前最远的终点，遇到起点大于它的区间就记录这段空隙，再更新终点。端点相接不产生空隙。
en: Time when everyone is free is exactly the gaps left after stacking everyone's busy time together.
Ownership doesn't matter: pool all busy intervals, sort by start, and merge. Gaps between consecutive merged blocks are common free time; the unbounded ends don't count.
Gather all intervals sorted by start, or merge per-employee lists with a heap. Track the furthest end; when an interval starts after it, record the gap, then update. Touching intervals leave no gap.

zh: 同一个字母必须全部落在同一段里，所以一段只要包含了某个字母，就得一直延伸到这个字母最后出现的位置。
从段的开头往右走，这一段的右边界是段内所有字母最后出现位置中的最大值。走到的下标正好等于这个边界时，这段已不必再延伸，可以切开。
先记录每个字母最后一次出现的下标；遍历字符串，不断用当前字母的最后位置更新段的右边界；下标到达右边界时记下这一段的长度，从下一位开始新的一段。
en: All copies of a letter must land in one part, so any part containing a letter must extend at least to that letter's last occurrence.
Walking right from a part's start, its end is the largest last occurrence among letters seen so far. When the index reaches that end, nothing forces the part to grow, so cut there.
Record each letter's last index. Walk the string, extending the current end with each letter's last index. When the index equals the end, record the part's length and start a new part after it.

zh: 先判断能不能做到：某个字母出现得太多时，无论怎么排都会有两个挨在一起。想想这个“太多”的临界值是多少。
只要最高频字母不超过长度的一半（向上取整），就一定能构造。每一步优先放剩余最多的字母，可以防止它最后扎堆；只需避免和上一个放的字母相同。
统计频次，最大频次超过界限就返回空串；否则用按剩余次数排序的大顶堆，每次取出最多的两种字母各放一个，次数减一后放回，直到堆为空。
en: First decide feasibility: if one letter appears too often, two copies must touch no matter how you arrange them. What is that threshold?

As long as the top frequency is at most half the length rounded up, a layout exists. Placing the letter with the most remaining copies first keeps it from piling up; just avoid repeating the previous letter.

Count letters; if the top count exceeds the limit, return "". Otherwise, with a max-heap by remaining count, repeatedly take the two most frequent letters, place one each, decrement, and push them back.

zh: 一对括号里是一个完整的子表达式，算完之后，从外面看它就只是一个普通的数。先不管括号，只含加减乘除的表达式你会怎么算？
把“计算一段不含括号的表达式”写成能调用自己的过程：遇到左括号就递归算到对应的右括号，返回值当作普通数字参与运算。
用一个共享的读取位置逐字符前进；每一层按乘除优先的规则维护各项；遇左括号就递归求值并把结果当数字；遇右括号或末尾时结束本层，返回各项之和。
en: A parenthesized part is a complete subexpression; once evaluated, it looks like a plain number from outside. Ignoring parentheses for now, how would you evaluate an expression with only + - * /?
Write "evaluate a flat expression" as a routine that can call itself: on "(", recurse until the matching ")" and treat the returned value as an ordinary operand.
Advance a shared read position. At each level keep terms with * and / taking precedence; on "(" recurse and use the result as a number; on ")" or the end, return the sum of terms.

zh: 与其琢磨一套移动技巧，不如先看规模：2×3 的棋盘一共只有 720 种摆法。把所有能到达的局面都试一遍，代价其实很小。
把棋盘压成 6 位字符串当作状态，每次移动代价相同，按步数一层层广度优先扩展即可。0 在每个位置能和哪些格交换是固定的，可以事先列表；另外有一半排列根本到不了。
从初始状态开始 BFS：找到 0 的位置，按事先列好的相邻表逐个交换得到新串，没见过就入队；碰到 123450 返回步数，队列空了返回 -1。
en: Rather than inventing a solving strategy, look at the size: a 2×3 board has only 720 arrangements. Trying every reachable position is actually cheap.

Encode the board as a 6-char string. Moves all cost one, so expand breadth-first by step count. The cells 0 can swap with depend only on its index; precompute them. Half of all arrangements are unreachable.
BFS from the start state: find the 0, swap it with each precomputed neighbor to form new strings, and enqueue unseen ones. Return the step count at 123450, else -1.

zh: 在时刻 t，你能在所有高度不超过 t 的相连格子里随意游动；所以答案取决于路径上最高的那个格子。
要找一条从左上到右下、路径上最大高度尽量小的路。可以用优先队列每次扩展当前最低的边界格子，也可以按高度从低到高把格子逐个加入并查集。
用小根堆按高度扩展：从起点开始，记录到目前为止弹出过的最大高度；每弹出一个最低格就更新这个最大值，若它是终点就返回，否则把未访问邻居入堆。
en: At time t you can roam every connected cell with height at most t, so the answer depends on the highest cell along your route.
Find a path from top-left to bottom-right that minimizes the max height on it. Either always expand the lowest frontier cell with a heap, or add cells to union-find in order of height.
Use a heap keyed by height from the start, tracking the highest value popped so far. Each pop updates that max; if it's the target, return the max, otherwise push unvisited neighbors.

zh: 数字没有大小写之分，只有字母会产生两种选择，所以结果数量是 2 的“字母个数”次方。
按下标逐个处理字符：数字只有一条路往下走，字母则分成小写和大写两条分支，走到末尾就得到一个答案。
把字符串转成可修改的字符数组，从下标 0 递归：到末尾就记录；是数字直接进入下一位；是字母就先设成小写递归一次，再设成大写递归一次。
en: Digits have no case; only letters create a choice. So the answer count is 2 raised to the number of letters.
Walk characters by index: a digit has a single path forward, while a letter splits into lowercase and uppercase branches. Reaching the end yields one answer.
Make the string a mutable char array and recurse from 0: at the end, record it; on a digit, move on; on a letter, set it lowercase and recurse, then uppercase and recurse.

zh: 二分图就是能把点涂成两种颜色，让每条边两端颜色不同；可以边遍历边涂色，看会不会出现矛盾。
一个点的颜色定下来后，它所有邻居的颜色也被强制确定；只有出现一条边两端同色（也就是奇数环）时才不行。图可能不连通，每个分量都要查。
对每个还没染色的点，先涂颜色 A 再 BFS/DFS；邻居没染色就涂相反色，已经染色且和当前同色就返回 false。所有分量都通过则返回 true。
en: Bipartite means you can 2-color the nodes so every edge joins different colors. Try coloring as you traverse and watch for clashes.
Once a node's color is fixed, all its neighbors are forced to the opposite color. It fails only when an edge has same-colored ends (an odd cycle). The graph may be disconnected.
For every uncolored node, color it A and start BFS/DFS. Give uncolored neighbors the opposite color; if a neighbor already has the same color, return false. Return true at the end.

zh: 普通最短路只关心花费，但这里还限制了中转次数；一条更贵但中转更少的路线，往后反而可能更有用。
状态里必须包含已经坐了几段航班。一种简单做法是只做 k+1 轮松弛，每轮只用上一轮的结果往外多扩展一段航班，第 i 轮得到的就是最多坐 i 段时的最低花费。
源点花费设为 0，其余设为无穷大；重复 k+1 轮：先复制上一轮的数组，再用上一轮的值遍历所有航班去更新副本。结束后目的地仍是无穷大就返回 -1。
en: Ordinary shortest paths only care about cost, but here stops are limited too. A pricier route with fewer stops might turn out to matter later.
The state must include flights taken. A simple approach: run k+1 rounds of relaxation, where each round extends paths by one flight using only the previous round's values.
Set the source's cost to 0 and all others to infinity. Repeat k+1 times: copy the array, relax every flight using the old values into the copy. If the destination is still infinite, return -1.

zh: 旋转就是把开头一段挪到末尾。试着把 s 的所有旋转结果写出来，看看它们能不能都在某个由 s 构造出的更长字符串里找到。
s 的每一种旋转，恰好都是“s 接上 s 自己”里长度为 n 的一个子串；但这个结论只在两串等长时才成立，长度不同会误判。
先比较两串长度，不相等直接返回假；相等时把 s 复制一份接在后面，检查 goal 是否作为子串出现在其中。
en: A rotation moves a prefix to the back. Write out every rotation of s and ask whether they all appear inside one longer string you can build from s.
Every rotation of s is exactly a length-n substring of s followed by itself. The claim only holds when both strings have the same length.
If the lengths differ, return false. Otherwise build s written twice in a row and check whether goal occurs in it as a substring.

zh: 一个节点不安全，当且仅当从它出发有路能走进环里；没有出边的终端节点显然是安全的。
给节点打三种状态：未访问、在当前递归路径上、已确认安全。DFS 时碰到还在路径上的点就说明有环；每个点的结论一旦确定就缓存下来。
对每个节点 DFS：先标成“访问中”，遍历所有后继，只要有后继不安全或正处于访问中，当前点就不安全；全部后继都安全才把它标为安全。最后按编号输出安全节点。
en: A node is unsafe exactly when some path from it can enter a cycle. Terminal nodes with no outgoing edges are obviously safe.
Use three states: unvisited, on the current recursion path, and confirmed safe. Hitting an on-path node during DFS means a cycle. Cache each verdict once known.
DFS each node: mark it in-progress and visit successors. If any is unsafe or in-progress, this node is unsafe; if all are safe, mark it safe. Output safe nodes in ascending order.

zh: 把字符串看成一段段“字符 + 连续次数”。按段比较 s 和单词，会比逐个字符比较清楚得多。
对应段的字符必须相同；s 的段长和单词相等可以，比单词长时 s 的这一段至少要有 3 个；s 的段比单词短则一定不行。
对每个单词，用双指针同时走 s 和单词，分别数出当前段的字符和长度并按规则检查；段数对不上或任一段不合格就排除，最后统计合格单词数。
en: View each string as a sequence of runs: a character plus how many times it repeats. Comparing run by run is far cleaner than comparing characters.
Paired runs need the same character. A run in s may equal the word's run, or be longer only if it has length at least 3. A shorter run in s always fails.
For each word, walk s and the word with two pointers, measure the current run on each side and check the rule. Reject on unequal run counts or a bad run; count the rest.

zh: 题目问的是最少坐几辆车，而不是经过多少站；在同一条线路上坐多少站都只算一次。
把线路当作 BFS 的节点：上了一条线路，就能一次到达它的所有站。事先建好站点到线路的映射，并保证每条线路、每个站点都只展开一次。
source 和 target 相同就返回 0；建站点到线路的表，把经过 source 的线路入队并记为 1 辆。出队时遍历该线路所有站，碰到 target 就返回当前车数，否则把经过这些站的未访问线路入队。
en: You're asked for the fewest buses, not stops. Riding any number of stops on one route still counts as a single bus.
Make routes the BFS nodes: boarding a route reaches all its stops at once. Precompute stop-to-routes, and expand each route and each stop only once.

If source equals target, return 0. Build stop-to-routes; enqueue routes through source as 1 bus. For each route, scan its stops: at target return the count, else enqueue unvisited routes through those stops.

zh: 每个工人最多做一项工作，而同一项工作可以被很多人做。对某个工人来说，他只关心“难度不超过我能力的工作里，哪个最赚钱”。
如果按能力从小到大处理工人，他们能做的工作集合只会不断扩大，于是“目前可做工作中的最高收益”可以一路累积，不必回头。
把工作按难度排序，工人按能力排序；用指针扫工作，把难度不超过当前工人能力的都纳入并更新最高收益；把这个最高收益加进总和，再处理下一个工人。
en: Each worker does at most one job, and a job can be done by many workers. For one worker, all that matters is the best-paying job whose difficulty they can handle.
If you process workers in increasing ability, the set of doable jobs only grows, so the best profit seen so far can be carried forward without ever looking back.
Sort jobs by difficulty and workers by ability. Advance a job pointer while difficulty is within the current ability, updating a running max profit; add that max to the total for each worker.

zh: 拿到的钥匙一直有效，用不着考虑开门顺序。真正的问题只是：从 0 号房出发，顺着钥匙一路能打开哪些房间，有没有房间始终拿不到钥匙？
把房间看成节点、钥匙看成有向边，这就是图上的可达性问题：从 0 号房出发能遍历到的点，就是你能进入的全部房间。
从 0 号房开始 DFS/BFS，进入一个房间就标记它，并把里面钥匙对应的未访问房间加入待访问；最后看访问数是否等于房间总数。
en: Keys never expire, so the order of opening doors doesn't matter. The only question is which rooms you can reach by following keys from room 0, and whether some room's key is never found.
Treat rooms as nodes and keys as directed edges; this is graph reachability. The nodes reachable from room 0 are exactly the rooms you can enter.
DFS/BFS from room 0: mark each room you enter and push the unvisited rooms its keys open. At the end, check whether the visited count equals the number of rooms.

zh: 一个字符会不会被删，取决于它后面的退格符。从左往右看很难当场判断，换个方向会不会简单些？
从右往左扫时，记一个“还欠几次退格”的计数：遇到“#”加一；遇到普通字符时计数大于 0 就跳过它并减一，否则它就是最终保留下来的字符。
两个指针分别从两串末尾出发，各自用上面的方法找到下一个保留字符；两者不同或只有一边先用完就返回假；相同则继续，两边同时用完返回真。
en: Whether a character survives depends on the backspaces after it. That is hard to see scanning left to right; would the other direction be easier?
Scanning right to left, keep a count of pending backspaces: '#' increments it; a normal character is skipped while the count is positive (decrementing it), otherwise it survives.
Start a pointer at the end of each string and find each one's next surviving character. Return false if they differ or only one string runs out; return true when both run out together.

zh: 节点和边都可以重复经过，所以普通的“访问过就不再走”会出错；但节点最多只有 12 个，提示你可以把去过哪些点也记下来。
状态是（当前节点，已访问节点集合的位掩码），每步代价为 1，可以在这个状态空间里 BFS；起点不固定，所以把每个节点都当作起点同时入队。
把每个（节点 i，只含 i 的集合）以距离 0 入队并标记；出队后走向每个邻居，把邻居加入集合，新状态没见过就入队。全集第一次出现时返回当前步数。
en: Nodes and edges may be revisited, so a plain visited check breaks. But n is at most 12, a hint that you can track which nodes you've already seen.
State is (current node, bitmask of visited nodes) and each move costs 1, so BFS works. The start is free, so enqueue every node as a source at once.
