Enqueue (i, mask with only i) at distance 0 for every i. From each state, step to each neighbor and add it to the mask; enqueue unseen states. Return the step count when the full mask first appears.

zh: 山脉数组先严格上升再严格下降，每个位置都能判断自己处在上坡还是下坡。
“比右邻居小”这个性质在峰顶左侧都成立，从峰顶开始都不成立，是一个单调的分界，峰顶就是第一个不成立的位置。
只在能安全访问右邻居的范围内二分：中点在上坡就把左边界移过去，否则收右边界；相遇处即峰顶。峰顶不会在两端，可以只搜内部。
en: A mountain array strictly rises then strictly falls, so every position can tell whether it is on the up slope or the down slope.
"Smaller than the right neighbor" holds before the peak and fails from the peak on. That is a monotonic boundary, and the peak is the first index where it fails.
Binary-search over indices whose right neighbor is safe to read. If mid is on the up slope, move lo past it; otherwise move hi to it. They meet at the peak, which is never at either end.

zh: 同一组里工资必须和质量成正比，也就是说全组共用一个“每单位质量的价格”。这个价格是由谁决定的？
全组的单价由组内“最低期望工资除以质量”最大的那个人决定，总成本就是这个单价乘以组内质量之和；固定单价上限后，只需让质量和尽量小。
按这个比值从小到大排序工人；依次把每个人当作比值上限，把他的质量放进最大堆并累加；堆里超过 k 人时弹出质量最大的；恰好 k 人时用当前比值乘质量和更新最小值。
en: Within a group, pay is proportional to quality, so everyone shares one price per unit of quality. Which worker sets that price?
The price is the largest wage-to-quality ratio in the group, and total cost is that ratio times the group's total quality. Fix the max ratio, then make total quality as small as possible.
Sort workers by ratio ascending. For each, push their quality into a max-heap and add it to a sum; if more than k, pop the largest quality. With exactly k, update the answer with ratio times sum.

zh: 子数组和可以写成两个前缀和之差。有负数时，窗口变大不一定让和变大，普通双指针依赖的单调性就失效了。
对左端点候选来说，若一个更早的前缀和不小于某个更晚的前缀和，那么更早的那个永远不会更优：它更远，差值还更小。另外，左端点一旦和某个右端点配成功，后面的右端点用它只会更长。
先算前缀和；按顺序处理每个前缀和：先从队首不断取出能让差值达到 K 的下标并更新最短长度；再从队尾弹出所有前缀和不小于当前值的下标；最后把当前下标加入队尾。
en: A subarray sum is a difference of two prefix sums. With negative numbers, growing the window may shrink the sum, so the usual two-pointer monotonicity breaks.

An earlier prefix sum that is at least a later one is never a better left end: it is farther and gives a smaller difference. And once a left end matches a right end, later right ends can only do worse with it.

Build prefix sums. For each in order: pop from the front while the difference reaches K, updating the shortest length; pop from the back while those sums are at least the current one; then append the current index.

zh: 距离为 K 的节点可能在 target 下方，也可能要先往上走再拐进别的分支。可树的指针只能往下走，这是难点。
先记下每个节点的父节点，把树当成无向图：每个节点最多有左孩子、右孩子、父节点三个邻居。
第一遍遍历建立父节点表；再从 target 开始 BFS，用访问集合防止走回头路，恰好扩展 K 层后，队列里剩下的节点就是答案。
en: Nodes at distance K may be below the target or reached by going up and then into another branch, but tree pointers only go downward.
Record each node's parent so the tree becomes an undirected graph where each node has up to three neighbors: left, right, and parent.
First pass builds a parent map; then BFS from target with a visited set, expand exactly K layers, and the nodes left in the queue are the answer.

zh: 目标是让 nums1 赢的位置尽量多。先想一个极端情况：碰到我方谁都赢不了的对手，派谁去输掉这一场最不心疼？
按对手从强到弱处理：我方剩下最强的若能赢，就派它上，因为更强的对手已经处理完，不算浪费；若它都赢不了，那谁也赢不了，就派我方最弱的去输。
把 nums1 排序，nums2 的下标按值从大到小排序；用两个指针指向 nums1 的最大和最小。对每个对手，最大的能赢就派最大的，否则派最小的，结果写到对手的原下标处。
en: You want nums1 to win as many positions as possible. Start with an extreme case: facing an opponent nobody on your side can beat, whom can you best afford to lose with?
Handle opponents from strongest to weakest. If your strongest remaining value wins, use it, since no tougher opponent is left. If it can't win, nobody can, so sacrifice your weakest.

Sort nums1 and sort nums2's indices by value descending. Keep pointers at nums1's largest and smallest. For each opponent, send the largest if it wins, otherwise the smallest, writing to the opponent's original index.

zh: 不必在经过加油站的那一刻就决定加不加。可以假装路过时先把油“存起来”，等真的开不动了再回头决定用哪一站。
每当油不够开到下一个位置，就从已经路过、还没用过的加油站里挑油量最大的补上；这样每次加油都把可达距离推得最远，次数自然最少。
把终点当作最后一站；按位置依次前进，到不了下一站时，反复从最大堆里取出最大油量加上并计数，堆空了还不够就返回 -1；到达一站后把它的油量放进堆里。
en: You don't have to decide at a station whether to refuel there. Pretend you can "bank" every station you pass and decide later, when you actually run short.
Whenever fuel can't reach the next point, refuel from the largest unused station already passed. Each stop then extends your reach as far as possible, which minimizes the count.
Treat the target as a final station. Go station by station; while you can't reach the next, pop the biggest fuel from a max-heap and count a stop (empty heap: -1). Push each reached station's fuel.

zh: 斐波那契式序列里，只要知道最后两项，前面每一项都能倒推出来。只记一个末尾值，能确定整条序列吗？
状态要用一对下标 (j, i) 表示最后两项。再往前一项的值由这两项唯一确定，数组严格递增，用值到下标的哈希表就能 O(1) 找到它。
建立值到下标的映射；枚举 i 和 j < i，算出所需的前一项，若存在且下标 k 小于 j，这一对的长度就是 (k, j) 的长度加一，否则记为 2；最大值不足 3 时返回 0。
en: In a Fibonacci-like sequence, the last two terms determine everything before them. Can a single tail value pin down the sequence?
Use an index pair (j, i) as the last two terms. The term before them is fixed by those two; since arr is strictly increasing, a value-to-index map finds it in O(1).
Map values to indices. For each i and j < i, look up the needed earlier value; if it sits at k < j, length(j, i) = length(k, j) + 1, else 2. Return the max, or 0 if it's below 3.

zh: 吃得越快，需要的小时数只会减少、不会增加。换个问法：如果直接给你一个速度，你能不能很快判断它在 h 小时内来不来得及？
给定速度时，每堆耗时是堆大小除以速度向上取整，各堆相加就是总耗时。“来得及”随速度单调变化，所以可以在 1 到最大那一堆之间对速度二分。
在这个范围内二分速度；对中点算总耗时，不超过 h 就尝试更慢（右边界收到中点），否则加快（左边界移过中点）；最终左边界就是最小可行速度。
en: Eating faster can only reduce the hours needed, never increase them. Flip the question: given a specific speed, can you quickly tell whether it finishes within h hours?
At a given speed, each pile takes its size over the speed, rounded up; summing gives total time. Feasibility is monotonic in speed, so binary-search speeds from 1 to the largest pile.
Binary-search speed in that range. Compute total hours for mid; if within h, try slower by moving hi to mid, otherwise move lo past mid. lo ends at the minimum feasible speed.

zh: 不想先数一遍长度？想象两个人同时从头出发，其中一个人的速度是另一个人的两倍。
慢指针每次走一步、快指针每次走两步，快指针到达末尾时慢指针正好在中间；偶数长度时题目要的是第二个中点，终止条件要按这个来选。
快慢指针都从头开始；只要快指针和它的下一个节点都存在，就让慢指针走一步、快指针走两步；循环结束时返回慢指针。
en: Don't want to count the length first? Imagine two runners starting at the head, one moving twice as fast as the other.
Slow moves one step and fast moves two; when fast reaches the end, slow is in the middle. For even lengths the problem wants the second middle, which decides your stopping condition.
Start both at head. While fast and the node after it both exist, move slow one step and fast two steps. When the loop ends, return slow.

zh: 每种犯罪选或不选，人数是硬上限，利润只要达到下限即可。利润超过 minProfit 以后，具体多出多少还重要吗？
设 cnt[g][p] 为用了 g 人、利润为 p 的方案数，所有不低于 minProfit 的利润都并进 minProfit 这一格。这样利润维度只有 minProfit+1 种取值。
初始 0 人、利润 0 有 1 种；逐个犯罪，人数倒序遍历，把每个已有状态转到人数加上该犯罪人数、利润加收益后封顶的格子，超过 n 人的丢弃；最后把封顶那一列相加取模。
en: Each crime is in or out; members are a hard cap, and profit only needs to reach a floor. Once profit passes minProfit, does the exact excess still matter?
Let cnt[g][p] count schemes using g members with profit p, where any profit at or above minProfit lands in the single bucket minProfit. That cap keeps the table small.

Start with one scheme at 0 members, 0 profit. For each crime, iterate members downward and move each state to (members + group, capped profit + gain), dropping those over n. Sum the capped column mod 1e9+7.

zh: 每艘船最多两人，还有重量上限，要用最少的船。从最难安排的人想起：最重的那个人，谁最有可能和他同船？
最重的人无论如何都要占一条船。如果连最轻的人都不能和他同乘，他就只能独坐；如果可以，让最轻的人陪他不会比让别人陪更差。
按体重排序，左指针指最轻、右指针指最重；每次给右指针的人开一条船，两人重量和不超限就让左指针的人也上船并右移左指针；右指针左移。两指针交错时，船数即答案。
en: Each boat carries at most two people within a weight limit; minimize boats. Start with the hardest person to place: who could possibly share a boat with the heaviest person?
The heaviest person needs a boat regardless. If even the lightest can't join, they ride alone; if the lightest can join, pairing them is never worse than pairing anyone else.

Sort weights; point left at the lightest and right at the heaviest. Each boat takes the right person, plus the left person if their sum fits, moving left inward. Move right inward. Count boats until they cross.

zh: 互相讨厌的两个人必须分在不同组。如果把人看成点、讨厌关系看成边，题目其实在问这张图具有什么性质？
分成两组且每条边两端都在不同组，正好等价于这张图能否二染色；讨厌关系是双向的，建图时两个方向都要加。
用 dislikes 建无向邻接表；遍历 1 到 n 每个人，没染色就涂一种颜色并 BFS/DFS，给邻居涂相反色，遇到同色冲突返回 false，全部完成返回 true。
en: Two people who dislike each other must be in different groups. With people as nodes and dislikes as edges, what property of the graph is the problem really asking about?
Splitting into two groups with every edge crossing between them is exactly 2-colorability. Dislike is mutual, so add edges in both directions.
Build an undirected adjacency list from dislikes. For each person 1..n, if uncolored, color and BFS/DFS, giving neighbors the opposite color; a same-color clash returns false, otherwise true.

zh: 两个篮子各装一种水果、只能连续采摘，换个说法就是：找一段最长的连续子数组，里面最多只出现两种不同的数。
用滑动窗口：记录窗口内每种水果的数量，右端不断扩展；一旦出现第三种水果，就从左端收缩，直到窗口里只剩两种。
右指针每走一步就把该水果计数加一；种类数超过 2 时，移出左端水果，计数归零就删掉这一种；每步用窗口长度更新答案。
en: Two baskets, one fruit type each, picking consecutive trees: that is just the longest contiguous subarray containing at most two distinct values.
Use a sliding window: track how many of each fruit it holds and keep extending the right end. When a third type enters, shrink from the left until only two types remain.
Increment the count of each fruit as the right pointer advances. While more than 2 types exist, remove the left fruit and drop its type at count 0. Update the best length each step.

zh: 直接枚举所有子数组太慢。换个角度：每个元素会在多少个子数组里当最小值？总和就是每个元素的值乘上这个次数再相加。
以元素 i 为最小值的子数组，左端最远能延伸到上一个更小值之后，右端到下一个更小值之前。为了不让相等的值被重复计算，一侧用严格小于、另一侧用小于等于作边界。
用单调栈分别求出每个位置左右两侧的边界，得到左边可选的起点个数和右边可选的终点个数；该元素的贡献就是值乘以两个个数。全部相加，并按题目要求取模。
en: Enumerating all subarrays is too slow. Instead ask: in how many subarrays does each element act as the minimum? The total is each value times that count, summed.
For element i, the subarray can reach left to just after the previous smaller value and right to just before the next smaller one. To avoid double-counting ties, use strict on one side only.

Use a monotonic stack to find each position's left and right boundaries, giving the number of choices on each side. Its contribution is value times both counts. Sum everything modulo the given number.

zh: 每掷一次骰子算一步，问最少几步到终点，本质还是无权最短路；难点在于先把编号正确对应到格子上。
棋盘从左下角开始编号，每一行的方向交替（蛇形）。落在有蛇或梯子的格子上必须立刻跳到目标格，但跳过去之后不会再连续跳第二次。
写一个把编号换算成行列的函数；从 1 号格开始 BFS，每个位置尝试走 1 到 6 步，落点有蛇梯就换成其终点，未访问则入队。到达 n² 返回步数，否则返回 -1。
en: Each die roll is one move and you want the fewest to reach the end: an unweighted shortest path. The tricky part is mapping numbers to cells.
Numbering starts bottom-left and alternates direction each row. Landing on a snake or ladder forces a jump to its end, but you never chain a second jump.

Write a helper mapping a square number to (row, col). BFS from square 1; try moves of 1 to 6, replace the landing square with its snake/ladder target if any, and enqueue if unvisited. Return steps at n², else -1.

zh: 数据规模不小，测试里还可能有已排序或大量重复的数据。哪些排序算法在最坏情况下依然稳妥？
归并排序最坏也是 n log n 且稳定，但需要额外数组；快排原地、常数小，但必须随机选基准并处理好重复值，否则会退化成平方级。
归并：递归拆成两半，各自排好后用双指针合并到辅助数组再拷回。快排：随机选基准，用三路划分分成小于、等于、大于三段，只对两端继续递归。
en: Inputs are large, and tests may include already-sorted data or many duplicates. Which sorting algorithms stay safe in the worst case?
Merge sort is n log n in the worst case and stable but needs a buffer; quicksort is in place and fast but needs a random pivot and duplicate handling, or it degrades to quadratic.

Merge: split in half, sort each half recursively, merge with two pointers into a buffer, copy back. Quick: pick a random pivot, three-way partition into less/equal/greater, recurse on the outer parts.

zh: 非字母字符像钉子一样钉在原位，只有字母需要倒序。倒序之后，从左数第 i 个字母的位置上，应该放原来的哪一个字母？
第 i 个字母要和倒数第 i 个字母互换。用双指针从两端往中间找，碰到非字母就跳过，两边都停在字母上时交换。
把字符串转成可修改的字符数组。左指针向右找字母，右指针向左找字母，找到后交换并各走一步，直到相遇。判断字母时大小写都要算，连字符、数字等都不算。
en: Non-letters stay pinned in place; only the letters reverse. After reversal, which original letter should sit in the slot of the i-th letter from the left?
The i-th letter swaps with the i-th letter from the right. Run two pointers inward from both ends, skip non-letters, and swap whenever both rest on letters.
Turn the string into a mutable array. Move left forward to a letter and right backward to a letter, swap, step both, and repeat until they meet. Both cases count as letters; dashes and digits don't.

zh: 子数组可以绕过数组末尾接回开头。想一想：一段跨过首尾的子数组，被它跳过的那部分长什么样？
跨首尾时，没被选中的部分是中间连续的一段，所以这种情况的最优值是“总和减去和最小的中间一段”；不跨首尾时就是普通的最大子段和（Kadane）。
一次扫描同时求最大子段和、最小子段和与总和；答案取最大子段和与“总和减最小子段和”中的较大者。若所有数都是负数，后者对应空数组，不合法，直接返回前者。
en: A subarray may wrap past the end back to the start. For a subarray that wraps, what does the part it skips look like?
If it wraps, the skipped part is one contiguous middle block, so the best wrap is the total minus the min-sum block. Without wrapping, it is plain Kadane max subarray sum.

In one pass compute the max subarray sum, the min subarray sum, and the total. Return the larger of max and total minus min, unless all numbers are negative: then the latter is an empty array, so return max.

zh: 左右括号总数相等并不代表合法，比如“)(”。关键在于从左往右读的过程中，某一时刻右括号是不是多于前面能用的左括号。
两个计数就够了：还在等待配对的左括号数，以及出现时没有左括号可配的右括号数。后者每出现一个，就必须在前面补一个左括号。
扫描：遇左括号，等待数加一；遇右括号，若等待数为正就减一，否则需补的左括号数加一。最后答案是两者之和，因为剩下的每个左括号都要补一个右括号。
en: Equal totals don't guarantee validity, as ")(" shows. What matters is whether, at some point while reading left to right, closers outnumber the openers available before them.
Two counters suffice: openers still waiting for a match, and closers that appeared with nothing to match. Each such closer forces one added opener.

Scan: an opener increments the waiting count; a closer decrements it if positive, otherwise increments the needed-openers count. The answer is the sum of both, since each leftover opener needs a closer.

zh: 单调递增的二进制串一定长成前面一段 0、后面一段 1。扫描时你只可能处于还在 0 段，或已经进入 1 段这两个阶段之一。
设 z 为把当前前缀全变成 0 的翻转数，o 为当前前缀合法且已进入 1 段的最少翻转数。一旦进入 1 段，就回不到 0 段了。
z 和 o 都从 0 开始。读到 1：先把 o 更新为 o 与 z 的较小值，再把 z 加一；读到 0：o 更新为 o 与 z 的较小值再加一（把它翻成 1），z 不变。最后返回两者较小值。
en: A monotone binary string is some 0s followed by some 1s. While scanning, you're either still in the 0-block or already in the 1-block.
Let z be the flips to make the prefix all 0s, and o the min flips for a valid prefix that has entered the 1-block. Once in the 1-block, you can't go back.
Both start at 0. On '1': set o to min(o, z), then add one to z. On '0': set o to min(o, z) + 1 for flipping it to 1, and leave z alone. Return min(z, o).

zh: 和为 goal 的子数组，对应一对相差 goal 的前缀和。
以当前位置结尾的合法子数组数，等于之前有多少个前缀和恰好等于“当前前缀和减 goal”。用频次表计数，连续的 0 自然不会漏算，单个滑动窗口则容易出错。
前缀和 0 先记一次；逐个累加元素，把“当前前缀和减 goal”的出现次数加到答案，再记录当前前缀和。也可以用“和不超过 goal 的个数”减“和不超过 goal-1 的个数”。
en: A subarray with sum goal corresponds to a pair of prefix sums that differ by goal.
Valid subarrays ending here equal how many earlier prefixes equal the current prefix minus goal. A frequency table handles runs of zeros naturally, unlike a single sliding window.
Count prefix 0 once. For each element, extend the running sum, add the frequency of the running sum minus goal, then record the running sum. Or compute at-most(goal) minus at-most(goal-1).

zh: 每个格子只能从上一行的正上方、左上方、右上方落下来，所以一行的最优值完全由上一行决定。
定义“落到 (i, j) 的最小路径和”：当前值加上上一行 j-1、j、j+1 三个状态中的最小者，越界的列直接忽略。更新时必须读取上一行的旧值，而不是本行刚算出的新值。
把第一行作为初始状态；之后每一行都新建一个数组（或两行交替使用），按上述规则逐列计算，越界列不参与取最小；处理完最后一行后返回整行的最小值。
en: A cell can only be entered from directly above, upper-left, or upper-right, so each row's best values depend only on the row above.
Let the state be the minimum sum falling into (i, j): its value plus the smallest of the previous row's j-1, j, j+1, ignoring invalid columns. Always read old-row values, not ones just updated.
Start with the first row. For each next row, build a fresh array (or alternate two rows), computing each column by the rule above and skipping invalid columns. Return the minimum of the last row.

zh: 网格里恰好有两座岛，最少要翻转的水格数，可以看成从一整座岛出发走到另一座岛的最短距离。
先找出其中一座岛的全部格子作为多源起点，每跨过一层水就是多翻一格，BFS 第一次碰到另一座岛时的层数就是答案。
找到任意一块陆地，用 DFS 标记整座岛并把这些格子全部入队；然后逐层向外扩展水格，一旦碰到没被标记的陆地，就返回当前层数。
en: There are exactly two islands. The minimum number of flips is the shortest distance from one whole island to the other.
Use every cell of one island as BFS sources. Each layer of water crossed is one flip, so the level when you first touch the other island is the answer.
Find any land cell, DFS to mark its whole island, and enqueue all of it. BFS outward layer by layer over water; when you hit unmarked land, return the current layer count.

zh: 遍历全部节点当然能做，但 BST 的有序性可以告诉你哪些子树整个落在区间之外。
当前值比下界还小时，左子树只会更小，可以整棵跳过；比上界还大时同理，右子树可以跳过。
递归时：空节点返回零；值小于下界只去右边；值大于上界只去左边；否则返回当前值加上左右两侧的结果。
en: Visiting every node works, but BST ordering tells you which subtrees lie entirely outside the range.
If the current value is below the low bound, the whole left subtree is smaller still and can be skipped; symmetrically skip the right side above the high bound.
Recurse: null returns zero; below low, only go right; above high, only go left; otherwise add the current value to both sides' results.

zh: 每次只能加一，所以每个数只能往上挪。想想如果先把数组排好序，冲突会集中出现在什么地方？
排序后，每个位置的最终值至少要比前一个最终值大一，也不能比它自己小；只要恰好贴着这个下界取值，总增量就最小。
先排序；从第二个数开始，若它不超过前一个最终值，就把它提到前一个最终值加一，并把差值累加进答案；否则保持不变；扫完即得结果。
en: You can only increase values, so numbers only move up. Once the array is sorted, where do the collisions show up?
In sorted order, each final value must exceed the previous final value and can't drop below its own value; taking exactly that lower bound keeps the total increment minimal.
Sort the array. Walk left to right; if a value is not above the previous final value, raise it to one more than that and add the difference to the answer; otherwise leave it.

zh: 每个元素被弹出的那一刻，必须正好在栈顶。如果某个元素此刻就在栈顶，而且正是 popped 下一个要的，现在不弹，以后还有机会吗？
不必猜何时出栈，按 pushed 的顺序真实模拟一个栈：栈顶一等于 popped 下一个值就立刻弹出。元素互不相同，推迟弹出只会让它被后来的元素压住。
按 pushed 依次入栈，每入一个就循环检查栈顶是否等于 popped 当前指针所指的值，相等就出栈并移动指针。全部入栈后，栈为空则合法，否则不合法。
en: Every element must be on top of the stack at the moment it is popped. If the top already equals the next value in popped, would waiting ever give you another chance?
Simulate a real stack in pushed order, popping as soon as the top equals the next value in popped. Values are distinct, so delaying only buries that value under later pushes.
Push values in order; after each push, keep popping while the top matches popped at the current pointer, advancing the pointer. After all pushes, the sequence is valid only if the stack is empty.

zh: 有两种操作：花能量换一分，或者花一分换能量。为了最划算，买分时该挑什么样的令牌，卖分时又该挑什么样的？
买分用最便宜的令牌，换能量用最贵的令牌，所以排序后从两端取。注意换能量会暂时掉分，最终答案应取过程中出现过的最高分，而不是结束时的分数。
令牌排序后左右指针各指一端：能量够买左端就买，加分并更新最高分；否则若手里有分且还剩不止一枚令牌，就卖掉右端换能量并减分；两者都不行就停止。返回记录的最高分。
en: You can spend energy to gain a point, or spend a point to gain energy. Which tokens are the best deals for buying points, and which for selling them?

Buy points with the cheapest tokens and sell for energy with the priciest, so sort and work from both ends. Selling lowers the score for a while, so the answer is the best score ever reached, not the final one.

Sort tokens with pointers at both ends. If energy covers the left token, buy it, gain a point, update the best. Otherwise, if you have a point and more than one token remains, sell the right one. Else stop.

zh: 按层从左到右看，完全二叉树的节点是连续排满的，不会出现中间有空位、后面又冒出节点的情况。
层序遍历时把空孩子也放进队列，一旦遇到第一个空位，之后就不应再出现任何非空节点。
用队列做 BFS，空节点也入队；用一个标记记录是否已见过空位。见过空位后又取出非空节点就返回假，遍历完没有冲突就返回真。
en: Read a complete tree level by level, left to right: nodes are packed contiguously, and no real node ever appears after a gap.
During level-order traversal, enqueue null children too; once the first null shows up, no non-null node may follow.
BFS including nulls, with a flag for gap seen. If a non-null node comes out after the flag is set, return false; finishing without conflict means true.

zh: 作为左端点，如果某个位置左边已经有更小或相等的值，那它永远不会是最优的左端点，因为更左边那个能形成更宽的坡。
所以有用的左端点就是从左到右的前缀最小值，它们的值严格递减。对每个右端点，最佳搭档是这些候选里最靠左、且值不超过它的那个。
先正序扫描，把每个刷新前缀最小值的下标存入栈；再从右往左枚举右端点，只要栈顶的值不大于当前值就弹出，并用下标差更新答案。弹出是安全的，因为之后的右端点更靠左，只会更窄。
en: A left endpoint is never optimal if some earlier position has a smaller or equal value, since that earlier one would form a wider ramp.
So the useful left endpoints are the prefix minimums, whose values strictly decrease. For a right endpoint, the best partner is the leftmost candidate whose value does not exceed it.
Scan forward and push each index that sets a new prefix minimum. Then sweep right endpoints from the end; while the top's value is at most the current one, pop it and update with the index gap.

zh: 任何子数组和都是两个前缀和之差，而能否被 K 整除只看余数。
两个前缀和余数相同，中间那段就能被 K 整除，所以只需知道每种余数出现过几次。负数取余要先调整到 0 到 K-1 之间。
用表记录各余数的出现次数，余数 0 先记一次；遍历时更新前缀和并求规范化余数，把该余数已有的次数加到答案，再把次数加一。
en: Any subarray sum is a difference of two prefix sums, and divisibility by k only cares about remainders.
Two prefixes with the same remainder bound a divisible subarray, so you only need how often each remainder has appeared. Shift negative remainders into 0 to k-1 first.
Keep a count per remainder, with remainder 0 counted once. For each element, update the prefix sum, normalize its remainder, add that remainder's count to the answer, then increment it.

zh: 有负数时平方后的顺序会被打乱，但平方最大的那个元素一定在数组的最左端或最右端。
比较两端的绝对值，较大者的平方就是剩余元素里最大的平方。所以结果数组适合从后往前填。
左右指针放两端，写入位置从结果末尾开始；把绝对值较大一端的平方写入当前位置，对应指针向内移，写入位置前移，直到填满。
en: Negatives scramble the order after squaring, but the largest square always comes from the leftmost or rightmost element.
Compare absolute values at both ends; the larger one gives the biggest remaining square. That makes the result easy to fill from the back.
Put pointers at both ends and a write position at the end of the output. Write the square of the larger-magnitude end, move that pointer inward, step the write position back, and repeat.

zh: 题目保证同一个键的 set 时间戳严格递增，所以每个键的历史版本天然就是按时间顺序追加的。
每个键对应一个按时间排好序的版本列表。查询要找的是“时间戳不超过 t 的最后一个版本”，也就是前驱，可以二分完成。
set 把（时间戳，值）追加到该键列表末尾。get 时键不存在就返回空串；否则二分出第一个时间戳大于 t 的位置，它前一个就是答案；若这个位置是 0，说明查询早于第一个版本，返回空串。
en: Timestamps for set are strictly increasing, so each key's versions are naturally appended in time order.
Each key owns a time-sorted list of versions. A query asks for the last version with timestamp at most t, a predecessor search that binary search handles.

set appends (timestamp, value) to the key's list. get returns empty if the key is missing; else binary-search the first timestamp greater than t and take the entry before it. Position 0 means too early: return empty.

zh: 只有旅行的那几天需要被覆盖。每个旅行日要么由当天买的票覆盖，要么已经被之前买的某张票覆盖了。
设 C[i] 为从第 i 个旅行日起覆盖之后所有旅行日的最小花费。在这一天买 1 天、7 天或 30 天票后，直接跳到第一个不再被这张票覆盖的旅行日。
从后往前处理旅行日；对每种票，找出票过期后的第一个旅行日下标（用指针或二分），票价加上那个位置的值作为候选；越过末尾记为 0；返回 C[0]。
en: Only travel days need coverage. Each travel day is covered either by a pass bought that day or by one bought earlier.
Let C[i] be the min cost to cover travel days from index i onward. Buying a 1-, 7-, or 30-day pass on day i jumps you to the first travel day that pass doesn't cover.
Go through travel days from last to first. For each pass, find the first travel day after it expires (pointer or binary search) and try its price plus that value; past the end is 0. Return C[0].

zh: 两份列表各自有序、内部不重叠，可以像归并两个有序数组那样同时往前走。
两个区间的交集从较晚的起点到较早的终点，非空才算。终点更早的那个区间不可能再与对方后面的区间相交，可以直接丢掉。
两个指针分别指向两份列表；每轮算交集，合法就加入结果；然后推进终点较早的那一侧，直到任一列表走完。
en: Both lists are sorted and internally disjoint, so you can walk them together the way you merge two sorted arrays.
Two intervals overlap from the later start to the earlier end, if that is non-empty. The one ending first can't meet anything further in the other list, so it can be dropped.
Keep a pointer in each list. Each round, compute the overlap and record it if valid, then advance the pointer whose interval ends earlier. Stop when either list runs out.

zh: 同一行同一列可能落着好几个节点，题目要求它们按值从小到大排列，所以光靠遍历的先后顺序已经不够了。
给每个节点记下列、行、值三项，排序时依次按列、行、值比较，排完后同一列的元素自然挨在一起且顺序正确。
遍历整棵树收集所有三元组并排序，然后顺序扫描，列号一变就开启新的一组，把值依次放进去。
en: Several nodes can share the same row and column, and the problem wants them ordered by value, so traversal order alone is not enough.
Record a (column, row, value) triple per node; sorting by column, then row, then value makes each column's entries contiguous and correctly ordered.
Traverse the whole tree collecting triples, sort them, then scan in order, starting a new group whenever the column changes.

zh: “恰好 k 种”不好直接滑窗：固定右端点后，左端点太靠左种类太多，太靠右又太少，一个窗口兜不住。有没有更容易统计、又能拼出“恰好”的量？
“恰好 k 种”的个数等于“至多 k 种”减去“至多 k−1 种”。而“至多”可以滑窗统计：固定右端点后，合法左端点连成一段，个数就是窗口长度。
写一个辅助过程：滑窗维护频次和种类数，种类超过上限就收缩，每步累加窗口长度；分别以 k 和 k−1 为上限调用一次，两者相减即为答案。
en: Exactly k distinct is awkward for one window: with the right end fixed, left ends too far left see too many values and too far right see too few. Is there an easier count you could combine?
Exactly k equals at-most-k minus at-most-(k−1). At-most counts suit a sliding window: for each right end, the valid left ends form one range, contributing the window length.
Write a helper: slide a window with counts and a distinct tally, shrink when over the limit, add the window length each step. Call it with k and with k−1, then subtract.

zh: 所有烂橘子同时向四周传染，每过一分钟往外推进一格。某个新鲜橘子什么时候烂，取决于它离最近的烂橘子有多远。
把所有初始烂橘子一起放进队列作为第 0 层，BFS 的层数就对应分钟数；同时记下还剩多少个新鲜橘子。
先数新鲜橘子并把烂橘子入队；逐层出队，把四周的新鲜橘子变烂并入队，这一层有新感染就把分钟加一。最后仍有新鲜的返回 -1，否则返回分钟数。
en: Every rotten orange spreads at once, one cell outward per minute. When a fresh orange rots depends on how far it is from the nearest rotten one.
Seed a queue with every initially rotten orange as layer 0; BFS layers correspond to minutes. Keep a running count of fresh oranges.
Count fresh oranges and enqueue rotten ones. Process level by level, rotting adjacent fresh ones; add a minute when a level infects anything. Return -1 if any fresh remain.

zh: 一段区间能翻成全 1，只要它里面的 0 不超过 k 个。固定右端点时，左端点最远能伸到哪？右端点右移后，这个位置会往回退吗？
最远左端点只会右移、不会回退，所以可以用双指针维护一个窗口，并记下窗口里 0 的个数；一旦超过 k，就推进左端，直到移出一个 0。
右指针扫描，遇到 0 计数加一；计数超过 k 时左指针右移，移出的是 0 就减一，直到计数回到 k；每步用窗口长度更新答案。
en: A range can become all 1s exactly when it holds at most k zeros. For a fixed right end, how far left can the left end reach? As the right end moves on, can that spot ever move back?
The farthest valid left end only moves right, so two pointers can maintain a window with a count of its zeros. When the count exceeds k, advance the left end until a zero leaves.
Scan with the right pointer, counting zeros. While the count exceeds k, advance the left pointer and decrement when a zero leaves. Update the best length each step.

zh: 最终整行相同的那个值，必须在每张骨牌上至少出现一次。第一张骨牌能告诉你什么？
目标值只可能是第一张骨牌上面或下面的数，候选最多两个；对每个候选独立检查是否可行，并统计需要翻转的次数。
依次取两个候选值；遍历所有骨牌，若某张两面都不是该值，这个候选就失败；否则分别数“上面不是它”和“下面不是它”的张数，取较小者；两个候选取最优，都失败返回 -1。
en: The value that ends up filling a whole row must appear on every domino. What does the very first domino tell you about the possible values?
Only the two faces of the first domino can be the target, so there are at most two candidates; for each, check feasibility and count rotations independently.
For each candidate, scan all dominoes; if one has it on neither face, the candidate fails. Otherwise count tops missing it and bottoms missing it, take the smaller. Return the best, or -1.

zh: 两两枚举是平方级的。一首歌长 t，什么样的歌能和它凑成 60 的倍数？这些搭档能不能归成一类，一次就查出个数？
按除以 60 的余数给歌分类，一共只有 60 类。余数 r 的搭档是余数 60−r 的歌，r 为 0 时搭档也是余数 0，所以一张 60 格的计数表就够了。
从左到右扫：先把搭档余数已出现的次数加进答案，再把自己余数的计数加一。每对歌只在后一首出现时被数一次，余数 0 和 30 自己配自己的情况也自然正确。
en: Checking every pair is quadratic. For a song of length t, which songs complete it to a multiple of 60? Can those partners be grouped so one lookup counts them?
Group songs by length mod 60, giving only 60 classes. Remainder r pairs with 60 − r, and 0 pairs with 0, so a 60-slot count table is all you need.
Scan left to right: add the count of the partner remainder seen so far, then increment your own. Each pair is counted once, when its later song arrives, and the self-pairing 0 and 30 cases just work.

zh: 船的载重越大，需要的天数只会越少，所以“能否在 D 天内送完”关于载重是单调的。
给定载重时，按顺序往当天装货，装不下就换到下一天，这样贪心得到的天数最少。载重的下限是最重的单件包裹，上限是所有包裹总重。
在这两个界限之间二分载重；对中点模拟所需天数，不超过 D 就收右边界，否则移左边界；相遇处即最小载重。
en: A larger capacity can only reduce the days needed, so "can we finish within D days" is monotonic in capacity.
For a fixed capacity, load packages in order and start a new day when the next won't fit; this greedy gives the fewest days. Capacity ranges from the heaviest package to the total weight.
Binary-search capacity between those bounds. Simulate the days for mid; if within D, move hi to mid, otherwise move lo past it. They meet at the minimum capacity.

zh: 只能往 pattern 里插入小写字母，所以 query 里的大写字母一个都不能“凭空多出来”。
用一个指针在 pattern 上走：query 当前字符与 pattern 当前字符相同就前进；不同时，小写字母可以当作插入的，大写字母则直接判失败。
对每个 query 从左到右扫描，按上面的规则匹配或跳过；扫完后还要确认 pattern 已经全部匹配完，两个条件都满足才算匹配。
en: You may only insert lowercase letters into the pattern, so no uppercase letter in a query can appear for free.
Walk one pointer along the pattern: on an equal character, advance it; on a mismatch, a lowercase character counts as an insertion, but an uppercase one means failure.
Scan each query left to right with that rule. At the end, also require that the whole pattern was consumed. Both conditions must hold.

zh: 公差不再固定，只记以某个位置结尾就不够了：同一个末尾可能同时属于好几条公差不同的等差序列。
把公差也放进状态：对每个下标 i 维护一张表，记录以 i 结尾、公差为 d 的最长长度。i 和更早的某个 j 组成一对，就确定了 d。
对每个 i，枚举所有 j < i 并算出差 d；取 j 在公差 d 下的长度（没有就视为只含 j，长度 1），加一后写进 i 的表并保留较大值；全程维护最大值。
en: With no fixed difference, ending at index i isn't enough: one endpoint can belong to several progressions with different gaps.
Add the difference to the state: for each index i keep a map from gap d to the longest progression ending at i with that gap. Pairing i with any earlier j fixes d.
For each i and each j < i, compute d. Take j's length for d (a missing entry counts as 1, just j), add one, and store the larger value in i's map. Track the overall max.

zh: 每个人必须去两地之一，而且两地各去一半人。不妨先假设所有人都去 A 城，再考虑该把哪一半人改派到 B 城。
把一个人从 A 改派到 B，总费用的变化恰好是他去 B 与去 A 的差价，和其他人无关。于是问题变成：选出差价最小的那一半人。
算出每个人“去 B 减去去 A”的差价并从小到大排序；前一半去 B，后一半去 A，把对应费用加起来即可。
en: Everyone goes to one of two cities, half to each. Pretend first that everyone flies to city A, then decide which half to switch to city B.
Switching one person from A to B changes the total by exactly their B-minus-A difference, independent of everyone else. So pick the half with the smallest differences.
Compute each person's B-minus-A difference and sort ascending. Send the first half to B and the rest to A, then add up the chosen costs.

zh: 连线互不相交，意味着两排上连线的先后顺序必须一致：上面先连左边的数，下面也得先连左边的数。
所以一组不相交的连线，恰好对应两个数组的一个公共子序列，最多能连的线数就是最长公共子序列的长度。
设表格记录两个数组各取一段前缀时的最多连线数；末尾两数相等就取左上角加一，否则取丢掉某一侧末尾后的较大值；填完返回右下角。
en: Non-crossing means the lines keep the same left-to-right order on both rows. If the top connects an earlier number, the bottom must too.
So a set of uncrossed lines is exactly a common subsequence of the two arrays, and the max number of lines is the LCS length.
Let a table hold the best count for each pair of prefixes. If the last numbers match, take diagonal + 1; otherwise take the better of dropping one side's last element. Return bottom-right.

zh: 在凸多边形里画一个三角形，它会把剩下的部分切成几块。每一块是不是仍是由一段连续顶点围成的凸多边形？
所以子问题可以用一段连续顶点 i 到 j 来描述，设 T[i][j] 为它的最低得分。边 (i, j) 必定属于某个三角形 (i, k, j)，枚举 k 就把这段拆成两段，这是区间 DP。
相邻顶点之间没有三角形，值为 0；按 j−i 从小到大填表：对 i 和 j 之间的每个 k，把左右两侧的值与三角形 i、k、j 的得分相加，取最小；返回 T[0][n−1]。
en: Draw one triangle inside a convex polygon and it splits the rest into pieces. Is each piece still a convex polygon formed by a run of consecutive vertices?
So a subproblem is a run of vertices i..j; let T[i][j] be its min score. Edge (i, j) lies in some triangle (i, k, j), and choosing k splits the run in two: interval DP.
Adjacent vertices give 0. Fill by increasing j − i: for each k between i and j, add the left and right values to the score of triangle (i, k, j), keeping the min. Return T[0][n−1].

zh: 每段里的数都会变成段内最大值，所以一段的价值就是段长乘段内最大值。从开头看：第一段有几种切法？切完之后剩下的是什么？
第一段长度只能是 1 到 k，切掉后剩下的后缀和原题结构完全一样。设 g[i] 为从下标 i 开始的后缀能得到的最大和，枚举第一段的长度来转移。
从右往左算 g，g[n] 为 0。对每个 i，让第一段从 i 往右延伸 1 到 k 个元素（不越界），边延伸边更新段内最大值，用“最大值乘段长加上段后的 g 值”更新 g[i]。返回 g[0]。
en: Every number in a piece becomes the piece's max, so a piece is worth its length times its max. Look from the front: how many ways can you cut the first piece, and what's left after?
The first piece has length 1 to k, and what remains is a suffix with the same structure. Let g[i] be the best sum for the suffix starting at i, and branch on the first piece's length.
Compute g right to left with g[n] = 0. For each i, extend the first piece right by 1 to k elements within bounds, track its max, and update g[i] with max × length + g after the piece. Return g[0].

zh: 先别管“最长”：如果只问是否存在长度恰好为 L 的重复子串，怎样才能接近线性地回答？逐个比较子串太慢，能否把每个子串压成一个数？
用滚动哈希：窗口右移时去掉离开的字符、加入新字符，常数时间得到下一个哈希；碰撞用双模数或命中后逐字比对防范。长度 L 可行时更短的也都可行，于是可以对 L 二分。
在 1 到 n−1 之间二分长度；每次把所有该长度子串的哈希放进集合，出现重复就记下起点并尝试更长，否则缩短；最后按记录的起点和长度截出答案。
en: Forget "longest" for now: can you tell in near-linear time whether some substring of exactly length L repeats? Comparing substrings directly is too slow; could each one be squeezed into a number?
Use a rolling hash: sliding drops one char and adds one, giving the next hash in O(1); guard collisions with two moduli or a recheck. If length L works, shorter ones do too, so binary search L.
Binary search lengths from 1 to n−1. Hash every substring of that length into a set; on a repeat, record its start and try longer, otherwise try shorter. Slice out the recorded answer.

zh: 每一轮都要找出当前最重的两块石头，而结果还要放回去。什么数据结构能反复高效地取最大值、又能插入新值？
用大顶堆保存所有石头，取最大和插入都是对数时间。两块一样重就都消失，否则只把差值放回去。
把所有重量放入大顶堆；只要还有至少两块，就取出最重的两块，不相等就把差值放回。结束时堆为空返回 0，否则返回剩下那块的重量。
en: Every round needs the two heaviest stones, and the result goes back into the pile. Which structure lets you repeatedly take the maximum and insert new values efficiently?
A max-heap gives logarithmic removal of the largest and insertion. Equal stones both vanish; otherwise only their difference goes back.
Put all weights into a max-heap. While at least two remain, take the two largest and push back their difference if nonzero. Return 0 if empty, otherwise the last weight.

zh: 删掉一对相邻相同字符后，原本被隔开的两个字符会变成新邻居，可能又要接着删。想想怎样只扫一遍就处理掉这种连锁反应。
把目前确定保留的字符看成一个序列，新来的字符只需要和这个序列的最后一个字符比较。
从左到右读字符：若与已保留序列的最后一个相同，就把那个字符去掉，当前字符也不加入；否则追加当前字符。读完后保留下来的序列就是结果。
en: Deleting an adjacent equal pair can make two previously separated characters neighbors, which may trigger another deletion. How can a single pass handle that chain reaction?
Treat the characters kept so far as a sequence; each new character only needs to be compared with that sequence's last character.
Read left to right: if a character equals the last kept one, remove that kept character and drop the new one; otherwise append it. The kept sequence at the end is the answer.

zh: 前驱一定比后继恰好短一个字符。如果按长度从短到长处理，轮到某个词时，它所有可能的前驱都已经算好了。
用哈希表记录以每个词结尾的最长链长度。与其去找哪些短词插一个字符能变成当前词，不如反过来：删掉当前词的某个字符，看结果在不在表里。
按长度排序；每个词先记为 1，依次删掉每个位置的字符得到候选前驱，若在表中就用它的长度加一更新；存回表中，同时维护全局最大值并返回。
en: A predecessor is always exactly one character shorter. Process words from short to long, and every possible predecessor is ready when you reach a word.
Map each word to the longest chain ending at it. Rather than searching for shorter words you could insert into, go backward: delete one character from the current word and look it up.
Sort by length. For each word, start at 1, delete each position in turn to form a candidate predecessor, and if it's in the map, take its value + 1. Store it, track the global best, return it.

zh: 把碰撞想成两块石头互相抵消重量。到最后，每块石头其实都站到了两个阵营之一，剩下的重量和两个阵营各自的总重有什么关系？
剩下的重量就是两堆总重之差。要让它最小，就从石头里挑一部分，使其总重尽量接近总重量的一半且不超过，这是 0/1 背包。
求出总重量和它的一半；用 0/1 背包标记哪些重量能凑出，逐块石头倒序更新；找到不超过一半的最大可达重量，用总重量算出两堆之差就是答案。
en: Think of each smash as two stones cancelling out weight. In the end every stone has effectively joined one of two camps. How does the leftover relate to each camp's total weight?
The leftover is the difference between two piles. To minimize it, pick a subset whose total is as close to half the overall weight as possible without going over: a 0/1 knapsack.

Compute the total and half of it. Run a 0/1 reachability knapsack over the stones with descending capacity. Take the largest reachable weight not over half; the gap between the two piles is the answer.

zh: 老板不生气的那些分钟，顾客本来就满意，用不用技巧都一样。技巧真正带来的，只是它覆盖的生气分钟里的那些顾客。
把总满意人数拆成两块：不生气时的顾客总数是固定的；再找一个长度为 minutes 的窗口，使窗口内生气分钟的顾客数之和最大。
先累加所有不生气分钟的顾客数；再用定长滑动窗口只统计生气分钟的顾客数，求它的最大值；两者相加就是答案。
en: Customers in non-grumpy minutes are satisfied regardless of the technique. The technique only adds the customers in grumpy minutes inside its window.
Split the total: non-grumpy customers are a fixed base. Then find the window of length minutes whose grumpy-minute customers add up to the most.
Sum customers over all non-grumpy minutes. Slide a fixed window counting only grumpy-minute customers and track its maximum. Add the two together.

zh: 枚举四条边再求和显然太慢。如果先把上下两条边固定下来，剩下要选的只有左右边界，问题还剩几维？
固定上下行后，把每列在这几行里的和压成一个一维数组，问题就变成数它有多少个和为 target 的子数组，可以用前缀和配合哈希表计数。
对每个上边界，逐行向下扩展下边界并累加列和；每扩展一次，就用前缀和频次表统计一维数组中和为 target 的子数组数并累加。总复杂度是行数平方乘列数。
en: Enumerating all four edges and summing is far too slow. If you fix the top and bottom rows first, only the left and right edges remain. How many dimensions are left?
With top and bottom fixed, sum each column across those rows into a 1D array. Now count its subarrays summing to target, using prefix sums with a hash map of frequencies.
For each top row, extend the bottom row downward while accumulating column sums. After each step, count target-sum subarrays with a prefix-sum frequency map. Cost: rows squared times columns.

zh: 要数的是不同的字母序列，两张相同字母的牌互换并不会产生新序列，所以按“具体哪张牌”枚举会重复计数。
把牌换成“每种字母还剩几张”的计数表；每一步按字母种类来选，而不是按牌来选，这样同一位置上相同的字母只会被尝试一次。
统计 26 个字母的剩余数量；递归时遍历每种还有剩余的字母：先给答案加一（得到一个新序列），把它的数量减一后递归累计更长的序列，再恢复数量。
en: You're counting distinct letter sequences. Swapping two identical tiles gives nothing new, so enumerating physical tiles double-counts.
Replace tiles with a count of how many of each letter remain. Branch by letter type, not by tile, so each letter is tried only once per position.
Count each letter. In the recursion, for every letter with stock left: add 1 for the new sequence, decrement it, recurse to count longer ones, then restore.

zh: 每走一步代价都一样，求最少步数就是在无权图上找最短路；注意这里可以斜着走。
每个格子有 8 个邻居，BFS 第一次到达终点时的层数就是答案；路径长度按经过的格子数算，起点本身算 1。
起点或终点是 1 就直接返回 -1；把起点入队并标记，逐层向 8 个方向扩展未访问的 0 格，到达右下角就返回当前长度，队列空了返回 -1。
en: Every step costs the same, so the fewest steps is an unweighted shortest path. Note that diagonal moves are allowed.
Each cell has 8 neighbors. The BFS level at which you first reach the target is the answer; length counts cells, so the start counts as 1.
If the start or end is blocked, return -1. Enqueue the start, expand level by level into unvisited 0 cells in all 8 directions, and return the length at the corner, else -1.

zh: 最短公共超序列里，两个串共有的部分只需要写一次。它们最多能共享多少？
能共享的最多就是两串的最长公共子序列，超序列长度也就由此确定。真正的难点在于把具体的字符串构造出来。
先填好公共子序列的表；从右下角往回走：末尾相等就输出该字符并斜向后退，否则朝表值更大的方向后退，并输出被跳过那一侧的字符；某串走完后输出另一串剩余前缀，最后反转结果。
en: In the shortest common supersequence, anything both strings share only needs to be written once. How much can they share at most?
They share at most their LCS, which fixes the supersequence length. The real challenge is rebuilding the actual string, not just its length.

Fill the LCS table. Walk back from bottom-right: on a match emit that char and move diagonally; otherwise move toward the larger value and emit the char you skip. Flush the leftover prefix, then reverse.

zh: 车上人数只在上车点和下车点发生变化，中间路段保持不变。
把每趟行程看成在 from 处加人、在 to 处减人。乘客到 to 就下车了，所以该站的下车要先于上车结算；按位置把变化量合并起来就自动满足。
按位置建变化量数组（或把事件按位置排序，同位置先下后上）；从小到大累加人数，一旦超过容量就返回 false，扫完返回 true。
en: The passenger count only changes at pickup and drop-off locations; between them it stays constant.
Model each trip as +passengers at from and -passengers at to. Riders leave at to, so drop-offs there must settle before pickups; summing all changes per location handles this automatically.
Build a change array over locations, or sort events with drop-offs first on ties. Sweep with a running total, return false once it exceeds capacity, otherwise true.

zh: 山脉数组整体不是有序的，但峰顶两侧各自是有序的。
先用“比较中点与右邻居”的方法二分出峰顶；之后左侧升序、右侧降序，分别做普通二分。题目要最小下标，所以先查左侧。
二分找峰顶；在左侧升序部分二分 target，找到就返回；否则在右侧降序部分做比较方向相反的二分；都没找到返回 -1。把读过的下标值缓存起来，避免超出调用次数限制。
en: The mountain array isn't sorted as a whole, but each side of the peak is sorted on its own.

First binary-search the peak by comparing mid with its right neighbor. Then the left side ascends and the right side descends; search each normally. The smallest index is required, so try the left first.

Find the peak. Binary-search the ascending left part and return on a hit. Otherwise search the descending right part with the comparison flipped. Return -1 if absent; cache reads to stay under the call limit.

zh: 每条预订都是给一段连续航班加同一个数，逐个航班去加会太慢。
区间整体加值只需改两处：起点加上座位数，终点后一位减掉。对这些标记做前缀累加，就得到每个航班的真实总数。
开一个长度 n+1 的标记数组；每条预订修改起点和终点后一位（注意编号从 1 开始）；最后从左到右累加，返回前 n 个值。
en: Each booking adds the same amount to a contiguous range of flights; adding flight by flight is too slow.
A range add needs only two marks: add the seats at the start and subtract them just past the end. A running sum over the marks rebuilds every flight's total.
Allocate a marker array of size n+1. For each booking, update the start and the slot after the end (convert from 1-based). Take a running sum and return the first n values.

zh: 删掉一个节点后，它保留下来的子节点会各自成为一棵新树的根。想一想：一个节点在什么情况下会成为森林中某棵树的根？
节点成为根的条件：自身保留，并且父节点被删了或它本来就是整棵树的根。递归时把“是否为新根”往下传，返回处理后的节点（被删则返回空），父节点据此断开指针。
待删的值放进哈希集合。从根开始 DFS 并传入根标记：当前节点保留且是根，就加入结果；递归孩子时，根标记取决于当前节点是否被删；用返回值更新左右指针。
en: Deleting a node turns its surviving children into roots of new trees. So when exactly does a node become the root of some tree in the forest?

A node is a root if it survives and either its parent was deleted or it's the original root. Pass an is-root flag down and return the node after processing (null if deleted) so the parent can cut the link.
Put the values to delete in a hash set. DFS from the root with the flag: a surviving root joins the forest; a child's flag is whether this node is deleted; reassign child pointers from the returns.

zh: 最深的叶子可能不止一个。从根往下看：如果它们全在左子树里，答案会在哪一边？如果左右两侧都有最深叶子呢？
判断最深叶子在哪一侧，只需比较左右子树的高度。让递归一次返回两样东西：子树高度，以及子树内所有最深叶子的最近公共祖先，避免重复求高度。
后序处理每个节点：左右高度相等时，当前节点就是祖先；否则沿用较高一侧返回的祖先。向上返回较大高度加一，最终取根处得到的祖先。
en: There may be several deepest leaves. Looking down from the root: if they all sit in the left subtree, where must the answer be? What if both sides have one?
Comparing subtree heights tells you where the deepest leaves are. Have the recursion return two things at once: the subtree's height and the LCA of its deepest leaves, so heights aren't recomputed.
Postorder: if the two heights are equal, the current node is the ancestor; otherwise inherit the taller side's ancestor. Return the larger height plus one, and take the ancestor at the root.

zh: 到达同一个节点时，最后一条边是红还是蓝，决定了下一步能走哪种颜色的边，所以只记节点不足以描述状态。
把状态定为（节点，到达它的那条边的颜色）；每条边代价相同，所以在这个翻倍的状态图上做 BFS，节点的答案取两种颜色状态中较小的距离。
分别建红、蓝邻接表；把（0，红）和（0，蓝）都以距离 0 入队。出队后只沿与上一条颜色相反的边走，新状态没见过就入队记距离。最后每个节点取两种状态的最小值，都没到过则为 -1。
en: When you reach a node, whether the last edge was red or blue decides which edges you may take next, so the node alone isn't a full state.
Use state (node, color of incoming edge). All edges cost the same, so BFS over this doubled state graph; a node's answer is the smaller of its two state distances.

Build red and blue adjacency lists. Enqueue (0, red) and (0, blue) at distance 0. From each state, follow only edges of the opposite color, enqueuing unseen states. Take each node's min; unreachable is -1.

zh: 每学期可以同时修任意多门课，只要先修都已完成；所以最少学期数取决于依赖链有多深。
按拓扑顺序一层一层处理：同一层的课入度都已降为 0，可以放在同一学期修完；层数就是答案，前提是图里没有环。
统计入度，把入度为 0 的课作为第一学期入队；每处理完一整层学期数加一，并把后继入度减一，降到 0 的进入下一层。修完的课少于 n 则返回 -1。
en: You can take any number of courses per semester as long as prerequisites are done, so the minimum depends on how deep the dependency chains go.
Process a topological sort layer by layer: every course in a layer has in-degree 0 and fits in one semester. The number of layers is the answer, if there's no cycle.
Compute in-degrees and queue in-degree-0 courses as semester one. After each full layer, add a semester and decrement successors, queuing those at 0. If fewer than n are taken, return -1.

zh: 无论之前怎么拿，剩下的永远是从某一堆开始的一段后缀。想一想：要完整描述一个局面，除了从哪一堆开始，还需要记住什么？
局面由（起始堆 i，当前 M）确定。设 f(i, M) 为此时轮到的人最多能拿多少。石子总数固定，自己所得等于剩余总数减去对手接下来最多能拿的数，用后缀和换算，再配合记忆化。
预处理后缀和。若剩余堆数不超过 2M，当前玩家全部拿走。否则枚举拿 x 堆（1 到 2M），用后缀和减去对手在 i+x 处、M 变为 max(M, x) 时的结果，取最大值并缓存。答案是 f(0, 1)。
en: However the game goes, the remaining piles always form a suffix. To fully describe a position, what else do you need besides where that suffix starts?
A position is (start pile i, current M). Let f(i, M) be the most the player to move can get. Totals are fixed, so that equals the remaining sum minus the opponent's best afterward; memoize.
Precompute suffix sums. If at most 2M piles remain, take them all. Otherwise try taking x piles for x from 1 to 2M: suffix sum minus f(i+x, max(M, x)). Keep the max, memoize, and return f(0, 1).

zh: 两个字符串都只看前缀，比较它们各自的最后一个字符：相等时能做什么？不相等时，可以放弃哪一个？
末尾字符相等时，直接让这对字符配对不会吃亏；不相等时，两个末尾里至少有一个不在公共子序列中，分别去掉试试，取较优。子问题始终是两个前缀，可以按前缀长度建表。
建 (m+1)×(n+1) 的表，空前缀的行列为 0；逐格填写：相等取左上角加一，不等取上方与左方的较大值；右下角即答案，需要具体序列时从右下角按来源回溯。
en: Look at prefixes of both strings and compare their last characters. What can you do when they match? What can you give up when they don't?

If the last characters match, pairing them never hurts. If not, at least one of them is outside the LCS, so try dropping each and keep the better. Subproblems are always two prefixes, so tabulate by prefix lengths.
Build an (m+1)×(n+1) table with zero borders. Fill row by row: on a match take diagonal + 1, else the max of up and left. Bottom-right is the answer; backtrack from it to recover a sequence.

zh: 每次快照都复制整个数组代价太高，而且两次快照之间，大多数位置根本没有被改过。
给每个下标单独记录修改历史，即一串按快照编号排序的（快照编号，值）。同一个快照内的多次写入只保留最后一次；查询时找快照编号不超过目标的最后一条记录。
每个下标的历史初始化为（0，0）。set 时若历史末尾的快照编号等于当前编号就直接覆盖，否则追加一条。snap 返回当前编号后再加一。get 在该下标的历史上二分，找编号不超过 snap_id 的最后一项。
en: Copying the whole array on every snapshot is too expensive, and most positions don't change between snapshots anyway.
Keep a per-index history of (snap id, value) pairs sorted by snap id. Multiple writes within one snapshot keep only the last; a query wants the last record whose snap id is at most the target.

Seed each index with (0, 0). set overwrites the last record if it has the current snap id, otherwise appends. snap returns the current id then increments it. get binary-searches that index's history for the target.

zh: 题目每次只允许新建最后一层：上一级路径还不存在时，不能直接创建更深的路径。判断能否创建，需要查哪些路径的信息？
不必真的建一棵树，把每条完整路径当作键存进哈希表就够了。创建前确认两点：该路径尚不存在；去掉最后一段得到的父路径已存在，或者父路径就是根。
初始化时把空串放进表里，代表根。createPath 时路径已存在就返回 false；截取最后一个斜杠之前的部分作为父路径，父路径不在表中也返回 false；否则存入并返回 true。get 查不到时返回 -1。
en: Each call may add only the last level: you can't create a deeper path before its parent exists. Which paths do you need to look up to decide whether creation is allowed?
No real tree is needed; a hash map keyed by full path is enough. Before creating, check that the path is new and that its parent (path minus the last segment) exists or is the root.

Seed the map with the empty string as the root. createPath returns false if the path exists or its parent (text before the last slash) is missing; otherwise store it and return true. get returns -1 when missing.

zh: 每户的水最终都来自某一口井：要么自己打，要么经管道从别家引来。如果想象所有井都通向同一个地下水源，会怎样？
把这个水源当成一个额外的点，在某户打井就是从水源向它接一根“管道”，费用为打井价。问题变成：用最少费用让包括水源在内的所有点连成一体。
把两类“管道”合在一起按费用从小到大处理；用并查集判断两端是否已连通，已连通就跳过，否则选用并累加费用。选满 n 根时停止，累计费用即答案。
en: Every house's water comes from some well, either its own or one reached through pipes. What happens if you imagine all wells drawing from one shared underground source?
Treat that source as an extra point; digging a well at a house is a 'pipe' from the source costing the well price. Now connect every point, source included, as cheaply as possible.

Merge both kinds of pipes and process them cheapest first. With union-find, skip a pipe whose ends are already connected; otherwise take it and add its cost. Stop after n pipes; the total is the answer.

zh: 一段连续节点的和为零，换个说法就是：这段开始之前的前缀和，等于这段结束处的前缀和。
用哈希表记录每个前缀和最后一次出现在哪个节点；从哑节点出发，若某个前缀和在后面还会再出现，就可以直接跳到那次出现的节点之后，中间那整段和为零。
建一个前缀和为零的哑节点；第一遍计算前缀和，让每个前缀和映射到它最后出现的节点；第二遍重新累加前缀和，把每个节点的 next 改成表中同一前缀和对应节点的 next；返回哑节点的下一个。
en: A run of consecutive nodes summing to zero means the prefix sum just before the run equals the prefix sum at its end.
Map each prefix sum to the last node where it occurs. From a dummy, if a node's prefix sum shows up again later, jump straight past that later node; everything in between sums to zero.

Add a dummy with prefix 0. Pass one: compute prefix sums and map each to its last node. Pass two: recompute sums and set each node's next to the next of the mapped node for that sum. Return the node after the dummy.

zh: 删除机会只有一次，所以扫描时以每个位置结尾的子数组只会处在两种状态之一：还没删过，或者已经删掉了一个。
设 keep 为以当前位置结尾、没删过的最大和，del 为已删过一个元素的最大和。del 可以来自之前已删、现在保留当前数，也可以来自之前没删、现在删掉当前数。
keep 初始为第一个数，del 初始为极小值（结果不能为空）；从第二个数起，先用旧 keep 和旧 del 算出新 del，再按普通最大子数组和的方式更新 keep；每步用两者较大值更新答案。
en: You get one deletion, so any subarray ending at the current index is in one of two modes: nothing deleted yet, or one element already deleted.
Let keep be the best sum ending here with no deletion, del the best with one deletion. del either deleted earlier and keeps this number, or deletes this number from a keep run.
Start keep at the first value and del at −∞ (the result can't be empty). From the second value, compute new del from old keep and old del, then update keep like Kadane. Track the max of both.

zh: 每遇到一对括号就把里面的串翻转一次，嵌套很深时会反复复制，最坏是平方级。注意：被奇数层括号包住的部分最终是反的，偶数层是正的。
先把每个括号和它的配对位置对应起来。读取最终结果时，一碰到括号就跳到它的配对括号处，同时调转前进方向，这就相当于进入或离开一层翻转。
用栈预处理每对括号的配对下标；然后从开头出发、方向向右：遇到字母就输出，遇到括号就跳到配对位置并调转方向，再沿新方向走一步，直到走出字符串。
en: Reversing the inside of each pair as you meet it copies text repeatedly, quadratic when nesting is deep. Notice text inside an odd number of pairs ends up reversed; even means forward.
First link every parenthesis to its partner. When reading out the answer, hitting a parenthesis means jumping to its partner and flipping the walking direction, entering or leaving one reversal.
Precompute partner indices with a stack. Start at index 0 moving right: output letters; at a parenthesis, jump to its partner, reverse direction, then step on. Stop when you leave the string.

zh: 一条边是关键连接，当且仅当它不在任何环上；也就是说删掉它以后，它一侧的部分没有别的路能回到另一侧。
DFS 时给每个点记录发现时间，以及它的子树借助一条返祖边最早能回到的时间。若子节点最早能回到的时间仍晚于父节点的发现时间，这条树边就是桥。
从任一点 DFS，进入时打时间戳，low 初始为自己的时间；遍历邻居时跳过来时的父边：未访问就递归，回来后用子节点的 low 更新自己并判断是否为桥；已访问就用它的时间戳更新 low。
en: An edge is critical exactly when it lies on no cycle: after removing it, the part on one side has no other route back.

In DFS, record each node's discovery time and the earliest time its subtree can reach via one back edge. If a child's earliest time is still later than the parent's discovery time, that edge is a bridge.

DFS assigning timestamps; low starts at the node's own time. For each neighbor except the parent edge: if unvisited, recurse, pull in its low, test for a bridge; if visited, lower low with its timestamp.

zh: 先看小例子：有交换对 (0,1) 和 (1,2)，能不能把 s[0] 和 s[2] 互换？反复使用交换对时，哪些位置之间的字符其实可以自由流动？
能通过一串交换对间接相连的下标归为一组，组内字符可以排成任意顺序，组与组互不影响。要字典序最小，组内就该让较小的字符占据较靠前的下标。
用并查集合并 pairs，再按根把下标分组；每组取出对应字符排序，按下标从小到大依次填回去。
en: Try a small case: with pairs (0,1) and (1,2), can s[0] and s[2] trade places? Under repeated swaps, which positions can freely exchange characters?
Indices linked through a chain of pairs form a group whose characters can be arranged in any order, independent of other groups. For the smallest string, put smaller characters at earlier indices.
Union the pairs, then group indices by root. For each group, sort its characters and write them back into its indices in ascending order.

zh: 如果把 s 的某段子串改成与 t 相同所需的花费不超过预算，那么它内部任何更短的子串也一定不超过。这个性质能帮你做什么？
这说明可以用左右两个指针维护一段区间：右端不断扩张，一旦超支就移动左端，左端从不需要回退。每一位的花费就是两个字符编码之差的绝对值。
右指针每走一步，把这一位的花费加进总和；总和超过预算时，不断减去左端的花费并右移左指针；每步用当前区间长度更新最大值。
en: If a substring of s can be changed to match t within budget, every shorter substring inside it can too. How can you exploit that?
So two pointers suffice: extend the right end, and when the cost overflows, advance the left end, which never moves back. Each position costs the absolute difference of the two character codes.
As the right pointer moves, add that position's cost. While the total exceeds the budget, subtract the leftmost cost and advance the left pointer. Track the longest window.

zh: 删掉一组相同字符后，两侧的字符会拼到一起，可能再次凑满 k 个，引发连锁删除。每次都回头数末尾有几个相同字符会太慢。
从左到右构建结果时，真正需要的只是末尾那段连续相同字符的长度。把结果按“字符＋连续个数”分组记录，最后一组的个数就是它。
扫描每个字符：与最后一组相同就把个数加一，否则新开一组、个数记为一；个数达到 k 时整组移除。最后把每组按个数展开拼起来。
en: Removing a group joins its two sides, which may form k in a row again and set off a cascade. Recounting the trailing identical characters each time is too slow.
While building the result left to right, all you need is the length of its trailing run. Store the result as (character, count) runs; the last run's count is exactly that.
For each character: if it matches the last run, increment its count, otherwise start a new run with count one; when a count reaches k, drop that run. Finally expand the runs in order.

zh: 公差已经固定，所以每个数在等差子序列里的前一项是唯一确定的值。还需要回头枚举所有之前的位置吗？
用哈希表把值映射到目前为止以这个值结尾的最长等差子序列长度。看到 x 时，只需查 x 减去公差对应的那一项。
从左到右扫描；对每个 x，查前一项的长度（没有就当 0），加一后写到 x 名下；先查后写，公差为 0 和重复值都能正确处理；同时维护最大值并返回。
en: The difference is fixed, so each number's previous term is a single known value. Do you still need to scan every earlier index?
Map each value to the longest valid subsequence ending in that value so far. When you see x, you only need the entry for x minus the difference.

Scan left to right. For each x, read the length stored for its predecessor value (0 if absent), add one, and write it under x. Reading before writing keeps zero difference and duplicates correct. Track the max.

zh: 先数一数：哪些字母超过了 n/4，各多出几个？被替换的子串里至少要包含这些多出来的字母。
问题就变成：找最短的子串，使其中每种字母的个数都不少于它的超出量。子串越长越容易满足，所以可以用左右指针求最短窗口。
算出每种字母的超出量，全为 0 就返回 0。右指针扩张时累计窗口内各字母个数；每当所有字母都达到超出量，就记录长度并移出左端字符尝试收缩。返回最短长度。
en: Start by counting: which letters exceed n/4, and by how much? The replaced substring must contain at least those surplus letters.
Now find the shortest substring holding at least each letter's surplus. Longer substrings satisfy this more easily, so two pointers can find the shortest window.

Compute each letter's surplus; if all are 0, return 0. Extend the right end, counting letters in the window. Whenever every surplus is covered, record the length and drop the left character to shrink.

zh: 每份工作只有做或不做两种选择。如果决定做某份工作，那些能排在它之前、时间不冲突的工作有什么规律？
按结束时间排序后，结束不晚于某份工作开始时间的工作恰好构成一段前缀。设 best[i] 为只考虑前 i 份工作时的最大收益，做第 i 份时用二分找到这段前缀的末尾。
按结束时间排序；依次处理每份工作，二分找出最后一个能接上的位置；新值取“跳过它、沿用上一项”和“做它，用其收益加上那个位置的最优值”中的较大者；最后一项即答案。
en: Each job is taken or skipped. If you take a job, what pattern do the earlier, non-overlapping jobs follow?
Sorted by end time, the jobs ending no later than a job's start form a prefix. Let best[i] be the max profit using the first i jobs; taking job i means binary-searching that prefix's end.

Sort by end time. For each job, binary-search the last compatible job, then keep the larger of skipping it (previous best) or taking it (its profit plus the best at that compatible point). Return the last value.

zh: 自身就有重复字母的字符串永远不能选，可以先过滤掉；剩下的问题是挑一个字符串子集，要求字母两两不冲突。
把每个字符串表示成 26 位掩码：是否冲突就看两个掩码按位与是否为 0，合并就是按位或。递归状态为“当前下标 + 已用字母掩码”。
预处理：跳过含重复字母的串，其余转成掩码；从下标 0 递归，每个串选或不选，不冲突时才允许选，选后合并掩码；到末尾时用掩码中 1 的个数更新最大长度。
en: A string with a repeated letter can never be used, so filter it out first. What remains is choosing a subset of strings whose letters never overlap.
Encode each string as a 26-bit mask: a conflict is a nonzero AND, combining is an OR. Recursion state: current index plus the mask of used letters.
Drop strings with internal repeats and convert the rest to masks. Recurse from 0, skipping or taking each string (only if no conflict, OR-ing in its mask). At the end, update with the bit count.

zh: 固定一段恰好含 k 个奇数的子数组，它的左右两端还能各自往外伸多远，而奇数个数保持不变？
把所有奇数的下标按顺序记下来。对每组连续的 k 个奇数，起点可以落在前一个奇数之后到首个奇数之间的任意位置，终点同理，两种选择数相乘就是包含这组奇数的子数组数。
在奇数下标列表两端各补一个哨兵 -1 和 n；依次取连续 k 个奇数为一组，用“首个与前一个的下标差”乘以“后一个与末个的下标差”累加。奇数不足 k 个时答案为 0。
en: Fix a subarray with exactly k odd numbers. How far can each end stretch outward while the odd count stays the same?

Record the indices of all odd numbers. For each run of k consecutive odds, the start can be anywhere after the previous odd up to the first one, the end likewise on the right; multiply the two counts.
Pad the odd-index list with sentinels -1 and n. For each group of k consecutive odds, add (first minus previous index) times (next minus last index). With fewer than k odds, the answer is 0.

zh: 要删得最少，就只删那些确实配不上的括号。想想从左往右扫描时，哪些右括号和哪些左括号注定没有搭档。
右括号能配上，当且仅当它前面还有没配对的左括号；扫描结束后仍没配对的左括号也都是多余的。需要记住的是这些多余括号的位置，而不只是个数。
遍历字符串：左括号记下位置；右括号若有记录就取出一个配对，否则标记删除；字母不动。扫完后把剩下记录的左括号也标记删除，最后跳过所有标记位置拼出结果。
en: To remove as few as possible, delete only parentheses that truly cannot be matched. Which closers and which openers are doomed when you scan left to right?
A closer can match only if some unmatched opener precedes it; openers still unmatched at the end are extra too. You need their positions, not just their count.
Walk the string: record an opener's index; a closer takes a match if one is recorded, otherwise mark it for removal. Mark leftover openers too, then rebuild the string skipping marked positions.

zh: 单词之间唯一的牵连是共用同一份字母库存，与选取顺序无关。单词最多 14 个，逐个决定选或不选，一共有多少种情况？
用一个 26 格的字母库存表做共享状态：选一个单词就扣掉它需要的字母，有字母变成负数就说明这条分支不可行；回溯时把字母加回去。
统计库存并预先算出每个单词的得分；从下标 0 递归并带上当前得分：到末尾更新最大值；先走不选分支，再尝试扣减该单词的字母，都不为负就带着它的得分递归，最后恢复库存。
en: Words interact only through the shared letter inventory; order doesn't matter. With at most 14 words, how many take-or-skip combinations are there?
Use a 26-slot letter inventory as shared state: taking a word subtracts its letters, and any negative count kills the branch. Add the letters back when backtracking.
Count the inventory and precompute word scores. Recurse with a running score: at the end, update the max. Try skipping; then subtract the word's letters and, if none go negative, recurse; restore.

zh: 统计所有正方形时，可以按“右下角”分类：每个格子作为右下角能贡献多少个正方形，全部加起来就是总数。
设 f(i, j) 为以 (i, j) 为右下角的全 1 正方形的最大边长。若它等于 k，边长 1 到 k 的正方形都以这里为右下角，恰好 k 个，所以 f 就是这个格子的贡献。
求 f：格子为 0 记 0；为 1 时取左、上、左上三格 f 的最小值再加一，位于第一行或第一列的直接记 1。把所有 f 加起来就是答案。
en: Classify squares by their bottom-right corner: add up how many squares each cell contributes as a bottom-right corner and you have the total.
Let f(i, j) be the side of the largest all-ones square with bottom-right corner (i, j). If it is k, squares of sides 1 to k all end there, exactly k, so f is the cell's contribution.
Computing f: a 0 cell gets 0; a 1 cell gets one plus the min of f to its left, above, and upper-left, or 1 on the first row or column. Sum all f values.

zh: 除数越大，每一项向上取整后的商越小，总和只会跟着变小。
有了这种单调性，就能对除数二分：判断某个除数下各项向上取整商之和是否不超过阈值。除数取最大元素时每项都是 1，一定可行。
在 1 到最大元素之间二分；对中点逐项算向上取整的商并累加，不超过阈值就收右边界，否则移左边界；最终左边界就是最小除数。
en: A larger divisor makes every rounded-up quotient smaller, so the total can only shrink.
That monotonicity lets you binary-search the divisor, testing whether the sum of rounded-up quotients stays within the threshold. Using the largest element makes every term 1, always feasible.
Binary-search from 1 to the largest element. For mid, sum the rounded-up quotients; if within threshold, move hi to mid, otherwise move lo past it. lo ends at the smallest divisor.

zh: 区间 A 被区间 B 覆盖，意味着 B 的起点不晚于 A、终点不早于 A。能不能安排一个处理顺序，让每个区间只需和之前见过的区间比较？
起点升序、起点相同时终点降序排列。这样扫描时，只要之前见过的最大终点不小于当前终点，当前区间就一定被覆盖。
按上述规则排序，记录目前最大终点；遍历时当前终点不超过它就跳过，否则计数加一并更新最大终点；返回计数。
en: Interval A is covered by B when B starts no later and ends no earlier. Can you choose a processing order so each interval only needs comparing with ones already seen?
Sort by start ascending and, for equal starts, by end descending. Then an interval is covered exactly when the largest end seen so far is at least its own end.
Sort as above and keep the maximum end so far. Skip an interval whose end doesn't exceed it; otherwise count it and update the maximum. Return the count.

zh: 只记位置是不够的：站在同一个格子上，手里还剩几次消除机会，后面能走的路完全不同。
把状态定为（行，列，剩余消除次数），每走一步代价都是 1，所以在这个扩展后的状态空间里做 BFS 即可。k 很大时可以直接走曼哈顿距离。
起点带满 k 次入队；每次向四邻扩展，进入障碍格就消耗一次（不够就不能走），新状态没见过才入队。第一次到达终点时的层数就是答案，否则返回 -1。
en: Position alone isn't enough: standing on the same cell with different eliminations left leads to very different futures.
Use state (row, col, eliminations left). Every move costs 1, so plain BFS over this expanded state space works. If k is huge, the Manhattan distance is reachable directly.
Enqueue the start with full k. Expand to four neighbors; entering an obstacle spends one elimination (skip if none left). Enqueue unseen states and return the level at the target, else -1.

zh: 看任意一个区间：两端字符相同，它们天然配成一对；不同的话，就得在某一侧补一个字符，去和另一端配对。
设 I[i][j] 为把 s[i..j] 变成回文的最少插入数。两端相等时等于内部区间的值；不等时等于去掉左端或右端后的较小值再加一。
长度为 1 的区间值为 0；按区间长度递增填表，套用相等看内部、不等补一个的规则；返回整串的值。可以用串长减去最长回文子序列长度来交叉验证。
en: In any range, matching end characters pair up naturally; if they differ, one side needs an inserted character to mirror the other end.
Let I[i][j] be the min insertions to make s[i..j] a palindrome. Matching ends give the inner range's value; otherwise take the smaller of dropping either end, plus one.
Single chars cost 0. Fill by increasing range length using match → inner, mismatch → 1 + better side. Return the full-string value; cross-check it against n minus the longest palindromic subsequence.

zh: 相邻格子要求和的区域大部分重叠，每个格子都重新累加一遍会做大量重复工作。能不能先存好一些和，让任意矩形的和都能直接算出来？
预先算出每个位置与左上角围成的矩形之和（二维前缀和），多开一行一列省去边界判断。任意矩形的和都能由四个角的值加减得到，但矩形要先截到网格内。
先建前缀表；对每个格子算出上下左右边界并截断到合法范围；用四个角的值组合出该矩形的和，填入答案。
en: Neighboring cells need heavily overlapping regions, so re-adding each region from scratch repeats lots of work. Could you store some sums up front so any rectangle's sum is quick to get?

Precompute, for each position, the sum of the rectangle from the top-left corner to it (a 2D prefix sum), padded by a row and column. Any rectangle is four corners added and subtracted, after clipping.
Build the prefix table. For each cell, compute the four bounds and clamp them into range. Combine the four corner values into the block sum and store it.

zh: 每次操作是拔掉一根线再接到别处。先想清楚：什么样的线拔掉之后，不会影响现有的连通情况？
把 c 个互不相连的块串起来需要几根线？而那些在块内形成环的线正好是多余的、可以挪用的；只要线的总数够，答案就只和连通块个数有关。
线的总数少于 n-1 时无论如何都不够，返回 -1；否则用并查集或 DFS 数出连通块个数，每多一个块就需要挪一次线，即块数减一。
en: Each operation unplugs one cable and plugs it elsewhere. First ask: which cables can be removed without breaking existing connectivity?
How many cables does it take to join c separate groups? Cables that close a cycle are spare. As long as there are enough cables in total, only the component count matters.
With fewer than n-1 cables, return -1. Otherwise count connected components with union-find or DFS; each extra component costs one move, so the answer is components minus one.

zh: 想让字典序最小，就要在尽量靠前的位置把字符改小。但回文是对称的，有些位置改完之后字符串依然是回文。
改前半段的字符一定会破坏对称，而奇数长度正中间那个字符改了仍是回文。所以有效的“改小”只能落在前半段某个不是 a 的字符上。
长度为 1 时无解，返回空串；否则在前半段找第一个不是 a 的字符改成 a；若前半段全是 a，就把最后一个字符改成 b。
en: To be lexicographically smallest, make a character smaller as early as possible. Symmetry matters, though: some changes leave the string a palindrome.
Changing a character in the first half breaks symmetry, while changing the exact middle of an odd-length string does not. So a useful decrease must hit a non-'a' in the first half.
If the length is 1, no answer exists, so return empty. Otherwise change the first non-'a' in the first half to 'a'. If that half is all 'a', change the last character to 'b'.

zh: 工作按顺序分给 d 天，每天做连续的一段，当天难度是这段的最大值。想想最后一天：它负责的是哪一部分工作？
设状态为“用 j 天完成前 i 项工作的最小总难度”。最后一天负责的是一段后缀，从右往左扩展这段时可以顺手维护最大值。每天至少一项，所以 i 不能小于 j。
工作数少于天数时直接返回 -1。按天数从 1 到 d 填表：对每个前缀终点，倒着枚举最后一天的起点，边走边更新段最大值，用前一天对应前缀的最优值加上这个最大值更新。答案是 d 天做完全部工作的值。
en: Jobs are split in order across d days, each day a contiguous block whose difficulty is its maximum. Think about the last day: which jobs does it cover?

State: min difficulty to finish the first i jobs in j days. The last day covers a suffix block; growing it right-to-left lets you keep its max incrementally. Each day needs a job, so i must be at least j.

If there are fewer jobs than days, return -1. Fill days 1..d: for each prefix end, walk the last day's start leftward, update the block max, and combine with the previous day's best for the shorter prefix.

zh: 选中一个值就会删掉它的所有出现。想用尽量少的值删掉至少一半元素，每次选哪个值最划算？
只有每个值的出现次数重要，值本身是什么无所谓。先选出现次数最多的值，用交换论证可知不会更差。
统计每个值的频次并从大到小排序；依次累加，每加一个就把选取数加一，累计删除的个数达到数组长度的一半时停下，选取数就是答案。
en: Choosing a value deletes all its occurrences. To remove at least half the elements with as few values as possible, which value is the best pick each time?
Only the occurrence counts matter, not the values themselves. Taking the most frequent value first is never worse, by a simple exchange argument.
Count each value's frequency and sort the counts descending. Add them one by one, counting picks, and stop once the removed total reaches half the array length.

zh: 如果某个子串已经包含了 a、b、c 三种字符，那么把它往右延长得到的子串也一定都包含。
对每个左端点，找到让窗口包含三种字符的最小右端点，之后更长的右端点全都合法，可以一次性加上。左端点右移时，这个最小右端点不会往左退。
维护三种字符的计数，右指针不断扩展；当三种都出现时，把“从当前右端到串尾”的所有扩展个数加入答案，然后移出左端字符、左指针右移，重复直到不再满足。
en: If a substring already contains a, b and c, every extension of it to the right contains them too.
For each left end, find the smallest right end covering all three; every longer right end works too, so add them in one go. As the left end moves right, that smallest right end never moves left.
Keep counts of the three letters and expand the right end. While all three are present, add the number of extensions up to the string's end, then remove the left character and advance.

zh: 团队表现等于速度之和乘以最低效率，两个因素互相牵制。试着先固定其中一个，再看另一个怎么取最优。
如果规定某个人的效率就是团队最低效率，那么能选的只有效率不低于他的人，此时应在其中挑速度最大的至多 k 个（包括他本人）。
按效率从高到低排序；依次遍历，把速度放进最小堆并累加；人数超过 k 时弹出最小速度并减掉；每一步用速度和乘当前效率更新答案，最后再取模。
en: Performance is the speed sum times the minimum efficiency, and the two pull against each other. Try fixing one of them first, then optimize the other.
If a given engineer's efficiency is the team minimum, only engineers at least that efficient are eligible, and you want the fastest up to k of them, that engineer included.

Sort by efficiency descending. For each, push speed into a min-heap and add it to a sum; if size exceeds k, pop the smallest speed. Update the answer with sum times current efficiency; mod at the end.

zh: 三种字母各有数量上限，且不能有三个相同字母相连。想想：如果某种字母剩得特别多，什么情况下它会被“卡住”用不出去？
因此每一步都应尽量消耗剩余最多的字母；只有它会造成三连时，才临时换成剩余第二多的把它隔开。如果第二多的也已用完，就只能停止。
循环：按剩余数量给三种字母排序；若最多的那种和结果末尾两个字符相同，就改用第二多的（数量为零则结束）；否则放最多的。每放一个就把对应数量减一，直到放不下去。
en: Each of the three letters has a limit, and no three identical letters may be adjacent. If one letter has far more left than the others, when does it get stuck unused?
So each step should spend the letter with the most remaining; only when that would make a triple, switch to the second-most to break it up. If that one is used up too, stop.
Loop: sort letters by remaining count. If the top letter matches the last two characters, use the second (stop if it has none left); otherwise use the top. Decrement the used count and repeat.

zh: 拿走的牌一定是左端连续几张加上右端连续几张，两边合计 k 张，所以拿法只有 k+1 种。
枚举从左边拿 i 张、右边拿 k−i 张。从“全部从右边拿”开始，每次把右边的一张换成左边的下一张，总分的变化可以常数时间算出。
先算最后 k 张的和作为初值；i 从 1 到 k，每步加上左边第 i 张，减去右侧那段中最靠左的一张，并更新最大值。
en: The cards you take are always some from the left end plus some from the right end, k in total, so there are only k+1 ways to take them.
Try taking i from the left and k−i from the right. Starting from all-right, each step trades one right card for the next left card, so the score changes in constant time.
Start with the sum of the last k cards. For i from 1 to k, add the i-th card from the left and subtract the leftmost card of the remaining right block. Track the maximum.

zh: 一段子数组是否合法，只取决于其中最大值与最小值之差；把这段缩短，差不会变大。难点在于区间变动时怎样快速知道最值。
用左右指针维护窗口，再配两个单调队列：递减队列的队首是窗口最大值，递增队列的队首是最小值；下标滑出窗口时从队首弹出。
右指针加入新元素，分别从两个队列尾部弹出被它“压住”的元素再入队；若两个队首之差超过限制，就右移左指针并弹掉过期的队首；每步用窗口长度更新答案。
en: Whether a subarray is valid depends only on its max minus min, which never grows when the subarray shrinks. The hard part is tracking the extremes as the range changes.
Use two pointers for the window plus two monotonic deques: a decreasing one whose front is the max, an increasing one whose front is the min. Pop a front when its index leaves the window.
Push the new element into both deques after popping dominated tails. While the fronts differ by more than the limit, advance the left pointer and pop stale fronts. Track the longest window.

zh: 判断一个节点“好不好”，只需要知道从根到它这条路上出现过的最大值，用不着整条路径。
DFS 时把路径最大值当参数往下传；当前值不小于它就计数，并把更新后的最大值传给孩子。
从根出发，初始最大值取根的值；每个节点比较后计数，再带着新的最大值递归左右子树，把计数加起来返回。
en: To judge whether a node is good, you only need the maximum value on the path from the root, not the whole path.
Carry the path maximum down in DFS; if the current value is at least that maximum, count it and pass the raised maximum to the children.
Start at the root with its own value as the max; at each node compare and count, recurse into the children with the updated max, and sum the counts.

zh: 所有长度为 k 的子串里，相邻两个只差一个进来的字符和一个出去的字符，没必要每次从头数一遍。
维护当前窗口里的元音个数：右边进来的是元音就加一，左边出去的是元音就减一，每次更新都是常数时间。
先数出前 k 个字符里的元音数作为初值；之后窗口每右移一步，按进出字符调整计数并更新最大值；计数达到 k 时可以提前结束。
en: Neighboring windows of length k differ by just one incoming and one outgoing character, so there is no need to recount from scratch.
Keep the vowel count of the current window: add one if the incoming character is a vowel, subtract one if the outgoing one is. Each step takes constant time.
Count vowels in the first k characters. Then slide right one step at a time, adjusting for the characters entering and leaving, and track the maximum. Stop early once it hits k.

zh: 查询的是间接的先修关系，而且查询可能很多；每次临时去搜会很慢，不如先把所有关系一次性算好。
课程最多 100 门，可以用一张 n×n 的布尔表记录一门课是否是另一门的先修；这种关系可以传递，先修的先修也是先修。
按拓扑序处理课程：每遇到一条 u 指向 v 的边，就把 u 本身以及 u 的所有先修都标记为 v 的先修。全部处理完后，每个查询直接查表回答。
en: Queries ask about indirect prerequisites and there can be many. Searching per query is slow, so precompute every relationship once.
With at most 100 courses, keep an n×n boolean table for whether one course is a prerequisite of another. The relation is transitive: a prerequisite's prerequisite counts too.
Process courses in topological order: for each edge u to v, mark u and everything that is a prerequisite of u as prerequisites of v. Then answer each query by table lookup.

zh: 道路本身构成一棵树，忽略方向时所有城市都是连通的；真正的问题只是哪些边的方向背离了 0 号城市。
从 0 出发沿无向树往外遍历，每条边恰好经过一次；如果它原来的方向是从靠近 0 的一端指向更远的一端，就需要反转。
建图时每条边存两次：原方向标记为 1（需要翻转），反方向标记为 0。从城市 0 开始 DFS/BFS，走向未访问的邻居时，把这条边的标记加到答案里。
en: The roads form a tree, so ignoring direction everything is connected. The only question is which edges point away from city 0.
Traverse the undirected tree outward from 0, crossing each edge once. An edge whose original direction points from the 0-side to the far side must be reversed.
Store each edge twice: original direction tagged 1 (needs a flip), reverse tagged 0. DFS/BFS from city 0; when moving to an unvisited neighbor, add that edge's tag to the answer.

zh: 浏览记录就是一条线性的网址列表，加上一个表示“当前在哪”的游标；后退和前进只是在移动游标。
用数组存历史，再记一个“有效末尾”。访问新页面时，游标之后的前进记录全部作废，只要把有效末尾挪到游标处即可，不必真的删除。
visit 时游标加一，在该位置写入新网址，并把有效末尾设为游标。back 让游标减去步数但不低于 0；forward 让游标加上步数但不超过有效末尾。两者都返回游标处的网址。
en: Browser history is a linear list of URLs plus a cursor marking where you are; back and forward just move the cursor.
Store history in an array along with a valid end. A new visit invalidates everything after the cursor, so just move the valid end to the cursor instead of deleting anything.

visit advances the cursor, writes the URL there, and sets the valid end to the cursor. back moves the cursor left but not below 0; forward moves right but not past the valid end. Both return the URL at the cursor.

zh: 先排除无解：m 束花共需 m×k 朵，花不够就不可能。有解时，答案一定是某一朵花开放的那一天。
日子越晚开的花越多，能做的花束数不会减少，所以可以二分天数。判断某天是否可行：从左到右数连续已开的花，每满 k 朵做一束并重新计数。
在最早与最晚开花日之间二分；对中点按上述方法数花束，够 m 束就把右边界移到中点，否则把左边界移到中点之后；返回最小可行日期。
en: First rule out impossibility: m bouquets need m×k flowers in total. When it's possible, the answer is always the bloom day of some flower.
Later days only add bloomed flowers, so the bouquet count never drops and you can binary-search the day. To test a day, count consecutive bloomed flowers left to right, making a bouquet at every k.
Binary-search between the earliest and latest bloom days. Count bouquets for mid; if at least m, move hi to mid, else move lo past it. Return the smallest feasible day.

zh: 如果删掉的是一个 0，它左右两段连续的 1 就能接在一起。那如果数组里一个 0 都没有呢？
对每个 0，把它左边紧挨着的连续 1 的个数与右边紧挨着的个数相加，就是删掉它后的长度。全是 1 时也必须删一个，答案是长度减一。
从左到右扫描，记下当前这段连续 1 的长度，以及被上一个 0 隔开的前一段长度。遇到 1 时当前段加一；遇到 0 时前一段改为当前段，当前段清零。每步用两段之和更新答案；没有 0 时返回长度减一。
en: Deleting a 0 joins the runs of 1s on its two sides. And what if the array has no 0 at all?
For each 0, add the run of 1s immediately to its left and the run immediately to its right; that's the length after deleting it. With all ones you must still delete one, giving length minus one.
Scan tracking the current run of 1s and the run just before the last 0. A 1 grows the current run; a 0 moves current into previous and resets current. Track the max sum; with no 0, return n−1.

zh: 两片叶子间的最短路径必经过它们的最低公共祖先，所以可以在每个节点处统计“一片在左子树、一片在右子树”的配对。
每个节点向上返回一个小数组：子树中距离它为 1、2、3…的叶子各有多少片。distance 很小，超过上限的叶子可以直接丢掉。
后序遍历：叶子告诉父节点“距离 1 处有一片叶子”；内部节点对左右两侧所有距离之和不超过上限的组合累加数量乘积，再把两侧合并、距离加一后往上返回。
en: The shortest path between two leaves passes through their LCA, so at each node count pairs with one leaf on the left and one on the right.
Each node returns a small array: how many leaves sit at each distance below it. The limit is tiny, so leaves farther than it can be dropped.
Postorder: a leaf reports one leaf at distance 1 to its parent; an internal node adds count products for left/right distance pairs within the limit, then merges both sides shifted by one.

zh: 要让最小间距尽量大。如果先定下一个间距 d，判断能否放下 m 个球就容易多了。
位置排序后，第一个球放最左边，之后每个球放在离上一个球至少 d 的最近位置，这样贪心放的球最多。d 越大能放的越少，可以二分。
排序；在 1 到最大位置减最小位置之间二分 d，中点偏上取整；按贪心数能放几个球，够 m 个就把左边界移到中点，否则右边界移到中点左侧；返回左边界。
en: You want the smallest gap as large as possible. If you fix a gap d first, checking whether m balls fit becomes easy.
After sorting, put the first ball at the leftmost spot and each next ball at the nearest spot at least d past the previous one. This greedy fits the most balls, and larger d fits fewer.
Sort. Binary-search d from 1 to the span of positions, rounding mid up. Count balls greedily; if at least m, move lo to mid, else move hi below it. Return lo.

zh: 要把所有点连起来且总费用最小，最优方案一定不含环（有环就能去掉一条边更省），也就是一棵覆盖所有点的树。
任意两点之间都有边，边权是曼哈顿距离，这是一张稠密图；用 Prim 每次把离当前树最近的点加进来，O(n²) 就够，不必把所有边都建出来排序。
维护每个点到已选集合的最小距离，从任意一点开始；每次挑出未加入点中距离最小的，把距离加到总费用并标记，再用它更新其余点的距离，重复 n 次。
en: Connecting all points at minimum cost never needs a cycle (drop an edge and it gets cheaper), so you're looking for a tree that spans every point.
Every pair is an edge weighted by Manhattan distance, so the graph is dense. Prim's O(n²) version grows the tree by its nearest outside point without building all edges.
Track each point's min distance to the current tree, starting from any point. Repeatedly pick the closest unadded point, add its distance to the total, mark it, and update the others. Repeat n times.

zh: 字符串最长 16，所有切分方式最多 2 的 15 次方种，完全可以暴力枚举，重点在于怎么维护“子串不能重复”。
递归时用一个集合保存已切出的子串，新切的一段只有不在集合里才能继续。剪枝：当前段数加上剩余字符数（每个字符最多单独成段）仍不超过已知最优时，直接返回。
从起点 0 递归：到末尾就用集合大小更新答案；否则先做上面的剪枝判断，再枚举本段的结束位置，子串没出现过就加入集合、从结束位置之后递归、再从集合删除。
en: The string is at most 16 chars, so at most 2^15 ways to split. Brute force is fine; the real work is keeping pieces distinct.
Keep a set of pieces already cut; a new piece continues only if it isn't in the set. Prune when current pieces plus remaining characters can't beat the best so far.
Recurse from 0: at the end, update the answer with the set size. Else apply the prune, then for each end position whose piece is new, add it, recurse from the next index, remove it.

zh: 冲突只出现在年龄小的人分数反而更高。如果先按某一维排好序，冲突条件在另一维上会变成什么约束？
按年龄升序、同龄按分数升序排好后，一支合法球队就对应分数的一个非降子序列。要让这条子序列的分数总和最大，而不是长度最大。
按年龄、再按分数排序；设 best[i] 为以第 i 人收尾的最高总分，初值为他自己的分数；对每个 i 枚举前面分数不超过他的 j，用 best[j] 加他的分数更新；返回最大值。
en: A conflict only happens when a younger player outscores an older one. If you sort by one attribute, what constraint remains on the other?
Sort by age, then by score on ties. A valid team is then a non-decreasing subsequence of scores, and you want the largest total score, not the longest length.
Sort by (age, score). Let best[i] be the top total for a team ending with player i, starting at their own score. For each j < i with score ≤ theirs, try best[j] + their score. Return the max.

zh: 一条路径的代价只看途中最陡的那一步。普通最短路是把每步代价累加，换成“取最大”之后，哪些关键性质还保留着？
把累加换成取最大之后，沿路径的代价仍然只增不减，所以 Dijkstra 那种每次扩展当前代价最小格子的贪心依然成立。也可以二分答案再判断能否走通。
用小根堆从左上角出发，堆里存（到这里为止的最大高度差，坐标）；每次弹出最小的，向四邻扩展时新代价取当前值和这一步高度差中较大的，更优就更新并入堆。弹出右下角时返回。
en: A path costs only its steepest step. Ordinary shortest paths add up step costs; if you take the max instead, which key properties still hold?
Replacing sum with max keeps cost non-decreasing along a path, so Dijkstra's greedy still holds. Binary searching the answer plus a reachability check also works.

Min-heap from the top-left storing (max diff so far, cell). Pop the smallest; for each neighbor, the new cost is the larger of current cost and that step's difference; push if improved. Return at bottom-right.

zh: 梯子可以无视高度差，砖块则按高度差消耗。直觉上梯子该留给哪种爬升？麻烦在于往前走时，你并不知道后面会遇到多大的坎。
用最小堆保存当前由梯子负责的那些爬升，堆的大小不超过梯子数；一旦超出，就把堆里最小的那次改用砖块支付，砖块不够时就停下。
从左到右看每一次向上的高度差：先放进最小堆；若堆的大小超过梯子数，弹出最小值并从砖块里扣掉；砖块变成负数时返回当前所在楼的下标；走完则返回最后一栋。
en: A ladder covers any climb, while bricks pay the exact height. Which climbs deserve the ladders? The catch: walking forward, you can't see the climbs ahead.
Keep a min-heap of the climbs currently covered by ladders, capped at the ladder count. When it overflows, pay the smallest of those climbs with bricks; stop once bricks run out.

For each upward climb, push it onto a min-heap. If the heap holds more than the ladder count, pop the smallest and subtract it from bricks. If bricks go negative, return the current building; else the last one.

zh: p 或 q 可能根本不在树里。如果遍历时一碰到其中一个目标就立刻返回，在只有一个目标存在时会得到什么结果？
必须确认两个目标都真的出现过。做法是让遍历走完整棵树，用计数或两个标记记录各自是否被找到。
后序遍历：先递归左右子树，再检查当前节点是否为 p 或 q 并记下；当前节点是目标、或左右都找到了东西，它就是候选，否则把非空的一侧往上传。最后两个都找到才返回候选，否则返回空。
en: p or q may not be in the tree at all. If you return as soon as you hit either target, what do you get when only one of them exists?
You must confirm both targets actually exist: traverse the entire tree and use a counter or two flags to track whether each was found.

Postorder: recurse on both children, then mark the node if it is p or q. It is the candidate if it is a target or both sides found something; otherwise pass up the non-null side. Return it only if both were found.

zh: 有了父指针，从 p 和 q 分别往上走，会得到两条通向根的链，它们在某处汇合后就完全重合。
问题变成求两条链表的第一个交点。两个指针走完自己的链后换到对方起点接着走，走过的总长度相同，会恰好在交点相遇。
两个指针分别从 p、q 出发，每步沿父指针上移；走到空就跳到另一个节点继续；两指针相等时就是答案。也可以把一条链上的祖先存进集合再查另一条。
en: With parent pointers, walking up from p and from q gives two chains to the root that merge at some point and coincide afterward.
This is the intersection of two linked lists: if each pointer switches to the other's start after finishing its own chain, both travel equal distance and meet at the junction.
Move two pointers up from p and q; when one hits null, restart it at the other node; stop when they are equal. A hash set of one chain's ancestors also works.

zh: 平衡串就是所有 a 都在所有 b 前面。读到一个 a 而它前面已经有 b 时，这个冲突必须被解决。
扫描时记录目前见过的 b 的个数，以及当前前缀的最少删除数。遇到 a 只有两条路：删掉这个 a，或者删掉前面所有的 b。
删除数和 b 计数都从 0 开始；读到 b 只把 b 计数加一；读到 a 时把删除数更新为删除数加一与 b 计数中的较小者；扫描结束返回删除数。
en: A balanced string is all a's before all b's. When you read an 'a' after some b's, that conflict must be resolved.
While scanning, track how many b's you've seen and the min deletions for the prefix. On an 'a' there are only two options: delete this a, or delete every earlier b.
Start deletions and the b-count at 0. On 'b', just increment the b-count. On 'a', set deletions to the smaller of deletions + 1 and the b-count. Return deletions at the end.

zh: 两种操作分别是：任意交换两个位置，以及把两种已有字母整体互换。想想有哪些东西是这两种操作都改变不了的？
两种操作都造不出新字母，也改变不了“各字母出现次数”这组数本身，只是让这些次数换了主人。所以要比较的是：出现过的字母集合，以及排好序的次数列表。
